REAL ESTATE EXPEREINCE ONLY!!



Downunder Property Group is looking for a creative, experienced Canva Designer who understands branding, marketing and lead generation.



We're not just looking for someone who can make things look good. We want someone who understands how to create professional marketing materials that attract attention, build trust and generate leads.



What you'll be working on



Canva Designs: Professional brochures, flyers, presentation folders and branded marketing materials.



Real Estate Presentations: Listing presentations, pre-listing packages, buyer and seller guides.



Lead Magnets: Downloadable PDFs, educational guides, checklists and resources designed to capture potential clients.



Instagram &
 Content: Carousels, social media graphics, promotional materials and branded templates.



ManyChat Marketing: Designing downloadable resources and marketing materials for Instagram Comment-to-DM automations.



Branding: Maintaining a consistent, premium visual identity across all marketing channels.



Must-have skills



Advanced experience with Canva Pro



Strong graphic design skills and attention to detail



Experience creating professional, multi-page presentations and PDFs



Understanding of social media marketing and lead generation



Ability to turn written content into visually engaging, easy-to-read designs



Strong understanding of branding, typography and layout



Ability to provide fully editable Canva files



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Highly desirable



Experience with ManyChat and Instagram Comment-to-DM automations



Experience designing lead magnets and downloadable guides



Understanding of marketing funnels and conversion-focused design



Previous experience in real estate marketing



The role



Casual, remote and project-based, with opportunities for ongoing work.



Interested? We'd love to see your work!



When applying, please answer the following:



Can you share your Canva portfolio or examples of previous work?



Have you designed presentation folders, brochures or multi-page marketing guides?



Do you have experience designing lead magnets, downloadable guides and marketing materials for Instagram Comment-to-DM automations using ManyChat?



Do you understand how lead magnets are used to generate enquiries and convert social media followers into potential clients?



What is your hourly rate or project-based pricing?



What is your availability for ongoing casual work?

title: Developer Advocate - Service Management
Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA (Experienced Only)
description:
Hiring: Experienced Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



Pay: $3.00/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time, Remote

Experience: Previous Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage sourcing experience REQUIRED



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



DO NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before.



We are an established Amazon FBA business looking for an experienced, reliable, and independent Online Arbitrage sourcing VA to help us scale our inventory, especially during Q4.



We are looking for someone who understands Amazon sourcing beyond simply finding products that appear profitable in SellerAmp.



You must already know how to:



Source profitable Amazon FBA products through Online Arbitrage



Use SellerAmp SAS and Keepa confidently



Analyze sales volume, Buy Box history, competition, and price stability



Find legitimate retailers and suppliers



Calculate accurate ROI, profit margins, and dollar profit



Identify potential price tanking and listing saturation



Find profitable Amazon seller storefronts through reverse sourcing



Identify products with realistic bulk-purchasing opportunities



Work independently without constant supervision



We are NOT looking to train someone from scratch.



YOUR MAIN JOB



Our goal is to consistently find 8–10 VALID ASINs per day, with an emphasis on profitable, high-volume sourcing opportunities.



Daily and weekly expectations:



Initial evaluation period: Minimum 5 approved ASINs per day (25 per week)



Standard target after evaluation: 8 approved ASINs per day (40 per week)



High-performance target: 10+ approved ASINs per day (50+ per week)



Finding random products does NOT count.



Every submitted product must meet our sourcing requirements and pass review.



If submitted ASINs are rejected, you must replace them before the end of the workweek to meet the required weekly target.



Only approved ASINs count toward your weekly total, not simply submitted ASINs.



A lead will be evaluated based on whether it meets our documented sourcing requirements at the time of submission. We may choose not to purchase a qualifying lead for business reasons unrelated to its quality.



Q4 SOURCING PRIORITIES



We are actively looking to take advantage of major Q4 retailer promotions, seasonal discounts, and high-volume selling opportunities.



Our main priorities are SALES VOLUME, PROFITABILITY, and FAST INVENTORY TURNOVER.



We are not interested in slow-moving products that only sell a few units per month.



We want products that allow us to purchase meaningful quantities and realistically sell through inventory quickly.



Preferred Retailers



We strongly encourage sourcing from established U.S. retailers, including:



Walmart



Target



Best Buy



Home Depot



Lowe's



Walgreens



CVS



Kohl's



Macy's



Other reputable and verified U.S. retailers



Actively research holiday sales, clearance discounts, Black Friday and Cyber Monday promotions, coupons, multi-buy offers, and other legitimate sourcing opportunities.



All discounts must be currently available and usable at the intended purchase quantity.



PRODUCT PROFITABILITY REQUIREMENTS



Every product submitted should meet the following requirements:



ROI: Minimum 35% or higher



Profit Margin: Preferably 20% or higher



Minimum Acceptable Margin: 15%, but ONLY if the product has exceptional sales volume, favorable competition, and strong overall profit potential



Profit Per Unit: Minimum $2.50–$3.00, with higher-profit products strongly preferred



All calculations must account for:



Product purchase cost



Amazon referral and FBA fees



Estimated inbound shipping and preparation costs



Applicable sales tax and other relevant expenses



Verified discounts or coupons



ROI is important, but actual dollar profit, realistic competition, and sales velocity matter just as much.



A product with great ROI is not automatically a good lead if it has poor sales potential or unrealistic competition.



MONTHLY SALES REQUIREMENTS



We are primarily targeting high-demand Amazon listings.



Preferred: 1,000+ estimated monthly sales



Minimum: 500+ estimated monthly sales, provided competition is low and there is a realistic opportunity to capture sales



High sales volume alone does NOT qualify a product.



You must analyze the number of competing sellers, Buy Box distribution, pricing trends, and how much inventory we could realistically sell.



For example, a listing selling 1,000 units per month with 30 sellers may be less attractive than one selling 600 units per month with only 4–5 competitive sellers.



Use Keepa and SellerAmp together to evaluate whether demand and profitability are sustainable.



COMPETITION AND BUY BOX ANALYSIS



Before submitting any product, review:



Number of active FBA and relevant FBM sellers



Whether Amazon Retail is competing on the listing



Buy Box price and historical pricing trends



Recent seller count increases



Price tanking and listing saturation risks



Estimated monthly sales relative to seller count



Whether we can realistically compete at the projected selling price



Avoid listings with unstable pricing, excessive competition, or obvious signs that profitability will disappear when more sellers enter.



We want inventory that sells, not inventory that sits in Amazon warehouses.



QUANTITY AND INVENTORY REQUIREMENTS



Because we are focused on Q4 volume, we prefer sourcing opportunities that allow us to purchase meaningful quantities.



Ideally, find products where we can realistically purchase:



20+ units



50+ units



100+ units when sales volume and competition support it



Retailers with sufficient available inventory are strongly preferred.



However, do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing unrealistic quantities.



Example:



If a product only meets our requirements when buying 25 units, but the listing sells approximately 50 units per month and already has 20 competing sellers, that is NOT a realistic sourcing opportunity.



Consider monthly sales, seller count, competition, purchase quantity, and potential inventory turnover.



Our preferred inventory sell-through target is approximately 30–60 days, depending on the product.



The deal must make sense for our business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every retailer or supplier before submitting a product.



We previously had a VA submit a fake website impersonating a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website, and the card information was compromised.



This cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam or suspicious websites



Websites impersonating established retailers



Unverified suppliers



Websites with questionable payment methods



Sources offering unrealistic prices



Retailers with obvious authenticity or product-condition concerns



For unfamiliar websites, verify the domain, business information, independent reviews, and overall legitimacy.



If you cannot confidently verify a source, DO NOT submit it.



Any questionable supplier must be flagged for review before the lead can be approved.



ADDITIONAL PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product must:



Be a brand we are already approved/ungated to sell



NOT be a generic or unbranded product



Match the EXACT Amazon listing, including variation, size, quantity, and packaging



Be in stock at the submitted purchase price



Have a correct Amazon ASIN and retailer source link



Have accurate profitability calculations



Have realistic competition and sales potential



Not have been previously submitted by another VA



Have no obvious authenticity, expiration, or product-condition concerns



Have no known restrictions preventing us from selling the product



Do not submit duplicate, expired, inaccurate, or misleading deals.



LEAD SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS



Each submitted lead must include:



Amazon ASIN and listing link



Retailer/supplier product link



Purchase cost and applicable discounts



Estimated profit per unit



ROI percentage



Net profit margin percentage



Estimated monthly sales



Current competing seller count



Buy Box price and relevant price history



Recommended purchase quantity



Relevant sourcing risks or important observations



All leads should be organized, accurate, and easy to review.



PERFORMANCE BONUSES 💰



We reward VAs who consistently find profitable products and help grow our Amazon business.



Additional bonuses may be awarded for:



1. Exceeding Weekly ASIN Targets



Consistently finding more than 40 approved ASINs per week while maintaining quality.



2. Finding High-Profit Products



Discovering products with exceptional ROI, strong margins, and higher dollar profit per unit.



3. Finding High-Volume Opportunities



Identifying products that allow us to purchase and realistically sell larger quantities of inventory.



4. Finding Profitable Amazon Seller Storefronts



Discovering strong Online Arbitrage seller storefronts that provide valuable opportunities for further product research.



Approved storefronts may qualify for additional bonuses.



5. Consistent High-Quality Sourcing



Providing reliable leads that regularly pass review and result in profitable inventory purchases.



6. Long-Term Performance



VAs who consistently demonstrate strong sourcing ability, reliability, and accuracy will have opportunities for increased pay and additional bonuses.



IMPORTANT: Submitting random ASINs just to exceed your weekly target will NOT earn bonuses.



Quality always comes first. Five excellent, scalable products can be more valuable than ten low-quality leads.



WORK EXPECTATIONS



We expect you to:



Work consistently during scheduled hours



Communicate clearly and respond to questions promptly



Work independently without constant supervision



Double-check all sourcing calculations



Verify unfamiliar retailers before submitting leads



Avoid submitting duplicate or previously rejected products



Stay updated on major retailer promotions and Q4 opportunities



Be honest about potential sourcing risks



Prioritize products we can realistically purchase and sell



Maintain organized and accurate sourcing records



We are looking for someone who takes sourcing seriously and understands how to find profitable inventory at scale.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please answer the following:



How long have you been sourcing Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage products?



Which sourcing tools have you used? Are you experienced with SellerAmp SAS and Keepa?



How many high-quality, profitable ASINs can you realistically find in an 8-hour workday?



Do you have experience sourcing from Walmart, Target, and other major U.S. retailers?



Are you experienced in reverse sourcing and researching Amazon seller storefronts?



How do you verify whether an unfamiliar retailer website is legitimate?



Are you comfortable working Monday–Friday, 40 hours per week, at $3.00/hour plus performance bonuses?



Start your application with the word "SOURCING" so we know you read the entire job description.



We are looking for an experienced, reliable, and motivated VA who wants a long-term opportunity to grow with our Amazon business.



If you have real Amazon FBA sourcing experience and can consistently find profitable, high-volume products, we encourage you to apply.

title: Outbound Cold Caller — US Freight Brokerage (Voice Application)
description:
GuardRail Logistics LLC is a US freight brokerage hiring a full-time outbound cold caller to prospect shippers by phone.



Pay: $3.75/hour, 40 hours/week, paid bi-weekly via Wise — plus uncapped commission. The hourly base is guaranteed; the commission is where the real money is. Our producers earn far beyond the base — if you're good on the phone, you will make a lot of money here.



The work: Cold call US shippers. We provide the list, the script, and the training. You introduce GuardRail, qualify the prospect, and hand real opportunities to our closer. Every call gets logged in our CRM.



You: Clear, confident spoken English. Comfortable on the phone, high energy, coachable. Available full-time on US Pacific hours. Independent contractor.



To apply — two quick voice recordings, that's it:

1. Introduce yourself (30–60 seconds).

2. A short mock call: you're a GuardRail agent calling a US shipper for the first time — introduce the company (30–60 seconds).



No lengthy application, no resume required to start. If your recordings stand out, we talk next steps.

title: AI Operations Lead
description:
We are a group of four companies hiring one exceptional person to run operations across the board using AI tools. You will build and operate the systems that enable each company to run efficiently. You will not replace functional managers or assume responsibility for people management.

ARC Group: In-office BPO teams (10+) for mid-sized US companies. No onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

ARC Remote: Managed remote staffing for US small businesses.

Kipkeh Media: A WhatsApp media channel for the Orthodox Jewish community.

SetCo / 
: Business entity-formation services.

You will report directly to the Founder and work closely with our Chief of Staff. She builds the structures, systems, and trusted ground operations; you bring AI-powered execution, optimization, and intelligence. You offer complementary strengths, not a hierarchy.



CORE OPERATING PRINCIPLES



Read this carefully: This is a job for a professional who is exceptionally good at using AI tools, not someone who "uses ChatGPT sometimes." You will take entire workflows, lead generation, performance reporting, content planning, billing, and follow-ups, and rebuild them so one person with the right AI stack can do what used to take a team.

However, AI is a means, not the objective:

Impact over tools: We do not automate for automation’s sake. Every system you build must improve revenue, speed, accuracy, cost, visibility, or operational capacity.

Build before you automate: You don’t automate broken processes. First, understand the business objective, map the workflow, identify failure points, simplify the process, and then automate.

Human judgment: You know when NOT to automate. You understand where client relationships, management decisions, and executive judgment must remain human.



AUTHORITY & ESCALATION



You are expected to independently identify problems, recommend solutions, and implement approved operational improvements. You may modify systems and workflows within your area of ownership, but significant changes affecting clients, staffing, pricing, contracts, or company-wide processes require Founder approval.



PRIORITIES (In Order)



ARC Group Pipeline: This is the money. Build the machine that fills it.

ARC Remote: Systematize operations until the Founder only shows up for relationships and closing.

Kipkeh Operations: Manage the money workflow, creator direction, and performance intelligence.

NewLLC Automations: Set up processes alongside the Chief of Staff so we can hire an admin to handle client relations, billing, and upselling.



THE MANDATE



Process & SOP Automation: Automate and continuously improve operational workflows. Coordinate with the Chief of Staff and functional owners before materially changing established processes.

Data & AI Responsibility: You will handle sensitive business, client, and employee data. You must follow data-handling rules and never upload confidential information into an unauthorized AI platform.

Marketing: Our highest-leverage early win (see below).

Sales Support: Pipeline tracking, follow-up systems, and proposal/invoice workflows. (Closing stays with the Founder).

Recruitment: Help hire the roles behind you via screening support, structured interview workflows, and candidate tracking.

Management Oversight (Systems, not people): Build the intelligence layer our managers run on (dashboards, KPI tracking, staffing-ratio models). You make problems visible early with data. When systems flag a problem, you bring the data to the manager/Founder; they handle the human side.

Systems Design: Build workflows that don't break, with edge cases handled and clean, documented handoffs.

Data & Reporting: Turn raw, messy operational data into decisions (daily numbers, weekly analysis, forecasts).

Content Operations: Direct our on-camera creator with data-backed briefs outlining what to film, when, and why.

Billing & Invoicing: Build the money workflow from zero and run it.

Keep Up & Be Ahead: Your AI stack is never stale. You bring us tools and methods before we know we need them.



YOUR FIRST BIG WIN: BUILD OUR MARKETING ENGINE



Our Chief of Staff currently runs a manual
 lead-gen motion for ARC Group (50–100
s, no sequences, no A/B testing). It is time-consuming and inefficient. The stack is already paid for: Google Workspace + Instantly + Apollo + NeverBounce.

Your job: Turn it into a real pipeline machine.

Target: 500+
s/week with proper sequences, A/B testing, AI-assisted personalization, tracked follow-ups, and a dashboard the Founder can read in 60 seconds.

Bonus: You will also run the support system behind the Founder's LinkedIn outreach.

The Audience: 50–250 employee companies in logistics/supply chain, medical offices, and voice agents (call centers).

The Offer: In-office BPO teams, no onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

This is how we land our next BPO clients, and it is the single highest-leverage thing you can do in your first 60 days.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



The Pipeline Machine: ICP list building, Instantly sequences, A/B tests, reply triage, follow-up automation, and weekly dashboards. The engine runs; you report the numbers.

ARC Remote Systematization: Map every workflow the Founder touches and pull them off his plate one by one until it runs day-to-day without him.

The Money Workflow: Advertiser roster, rate sheets, invoices generated from published logs, overdue tracking, and a Monday money dashboard.

Creator Direction: Turn weekly view data into specific daily shoot briefs backed by numbers, not vibes.

Performance Intelligence: Daily view-curve reports. Flag underperforming posts within hours. Deliver a one-page weekly "what's working" analysis to drive next week's plan.

Management Intelligence: Dashboards, alerts, and KPI tracking. You build the visibility; managers handle the people.

Founder's Daily Digest: One morning briefing covering yesterday's numbers, today's plan, and decisions needed.



MUST-HAVES

Demonstrable AI Expertise: LLMs (advanced prompting, custom agents), spreadsheet automation (complex formulas, Apps Script), data analysis, and workflow automation (Zapier, Make, n8n, etc.). We test this live—claims without proof will not pass.

Data Skills: Proven ability to build reports and dashboards from raw, messy data.

Lead-Gen Experience:
 outreach, list building, sequencing, and follow-up tracking (or a credible plan to build this fast).

Finance Systems: Experience building/running a billing/invoicing tracker (or the ability to design one from scratch in the interview).

Communication: Strong written English. Clear, brief, and structured asynchronous communication.

Availability: Full-time (40 hours/week), Philippines-based, on a steady, fixed schedule with US-morning (EST) overlap.

Exclusivity: No job stacking, no exceptions. This must be your only full-time job. No freelance clients or side gigs that compete for your hours or attention.

Professional Setup: 16GB+ RAM, backup internet, and backup power.



NICE-TO-HAVES

Media or content-operations experience.

Experience with remote teams across time zones.

Familiarity with Orthodox Jewish community norms (modesty and kashrus guardrails apply to our channel)—or a willingness to learn fast.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Day 14:
 engine is live (500+/week sending on Instantly with sequences and A/B tests). Baseline bounce/unsubscribe rates tracked. First sprint launched; LinkedIn support running. ARC Remote audit complete, with the first workflow pulled off the Founder's plate. Money workflow started. (Trial decision point: You must be performing at band level, or we part ways).

Day 30:
 engine at full volume. Focus shifts to quality metrics: positive reply rate, meetings booked, and cost/time per qualified opportunity. Reply triage and follow-up system operating with same-day turnaround. ARC Remote SOPs delivered. Creator working from your briefs.

Day 60: The engine runs on rhythm without babysitting. ARC Remote workflows are documented, handed over, and tracking measurable hour/cost reductions. Underperformer alerts firing same-day. You are spotting what's broken across the companies before anyone else does.

Day 90: ARC Group top-of-funnel and ARC Remote run without Founder involvement. Kipkeh workflows are humming. We are actively scaling your systems across all four companies.



COMPENSATION & TERMS



Pay: $400-$500/week, paid weekly via Wise.

Growth: Full-time, long-term. Exceptional performers grow fast here, with a clear path for compensation increases across the four companies.

Trial Terms: The first 2 weeks are a paid trial. You enter at a band based on your interview, and you have two weeks to prove it was real. If you are not performing at your band's level, we part ways fast and fairly.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, you must provide direct, publicly viewable links (Google Drive, iCloud, etc.) to the following:

Updated Resume/CV: Highlighting your AI experience and the tools you are familiar with.

System Specs Screenshot: Including RAM (16GB minimum preferred; if your system can be upgraded, please state this).

Internet Speed Test Screenshot: Showing primary and backup speeds in Mbps.

Workspace & Power Photos: Showing a dedicated quiet workspace, plus your UPS, power station, or generator.

2-Minute Loom Video (Screen Share): Walk us through ONE real workflow you automated with AI tools. Show the "before," what you built, and the "after." This must be a real example, not a tutorial. No Loom = no review.

Fast-Track Hiring Process:

Candidates who submit a standout Loom video will be highly considered and fast-tracked to an Initial Interview before taking the paid test task.

Candidates who pass the Initial Interview will complete our paid test task ($25 USD via Wise).

Candidates who advance from the test task to the final Founder interview will receive an additional $25 USD.

title: Remote Compliance Specialist
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Job Type: Part-Time (36 scheduled hours per week; 6 hours/day, 6 days/week, weekends included)

Work Hours: Exact shift and rest days to be confirmed.



Job Overview:

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented, and independent Remote Compliance Specialist to support daily compliance administration and driver operations for a transportation company. This role will work closely with the existing Compliance team to assist drivers and employees, manage operational concerns, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure consistent communication and follow-through.



The ideal candidate has previous administrative experience, strong communication skills, and the confidence to make outbound calls, respond to incoming calls and messages, and ask questions to obtain the information needed to address an issue. Responsibilities include assisting drivers with operational concerns, such as application-related problems or vehicle issues, coordinating the appropriate assistance, documenting communications, and following up until issues are resolved or escalated to the appropriate person.



Candidates with transportation industry experience and familiarity with Electronic Logging Device (ELD) and Transportation Management System (TMS) platforms are preferred but not required. The ideal candidate is technologically savvy, highly organized, responsive, and capable of working independently. Strong initiative, urgency, problem-solving skills, and accountability are essential, as the role requires more than simply identifying a problem or sending a message; the candidate must take action and follow through.



Key Responsibilities:

* Support the existing Compliance team with daily administrative and operational tasks.

* Make outbound calls to drivers and employees when follow-up, clarification, or additional information is needed.

* Receive and respond to calls, text messages, and other communications from drivers and employees regarding operational concerns.

* Assist drivers experiencing application-related issues, vehicle problems, or other operational difficulties by identifying and coordinating the appropriate assistance.

* Follow up with drivers, employees, and relevant contacts to ensure that reported concerns are addressed in a timely manner.

* Take initiative in identifying appropriate next steps to resolve issues rather than simply forwarding messages or reporting problems.

* Maintain accurate records of communications, reported concerns, actions taken, and follow-up activities.

* Review information and documentation for accuracy and identify missing or incomplete details that require further action.

* Contact the appropriate individuals to obtain missing information or clarify discrepancies.

* Monitor outstanding concerns and assigned tasks to ensure consistent follow-through.

* Coordinate with the relevant internal personnel or service providers when additional assistance is required.

* Escalate urgent, unresolved, or out-of-scope issues to the appropriate supervisor or designated contact.

* Use computer applications, digital communication tools, and relevant company systems to manage information and complete assigned tasks.

* Learn and follow the client's established compliance procedures, operational workflows, and documentation requirements.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous administrative experience is required.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Confidence in making outbound calls and communicating directly with drivers and employees.

* Strong follow-up skills and the ability to maintain consistent communication until an issue is addressed.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Good computer literacy and the ability to navigate digital tools and applications.

* Ability to maintain accurate records, document communications, and organize information.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify appropriate next steps when handling operational concerns.

* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage assigned responsibilities without constant supervision.

* Ability to prioritize requests, respond promptly, and recognize when an issue requires escalation.

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification when instructions or information are incomplete.

* Ability to work 6 hours per day, 6 days per week, including weekends, subject to the final confirmed schedule.



Preferred Qualifications:

* Previous experience in transportation, trucking, logistics, or driver operations.

* Familiarity with Electronic Logging Device (ELD) systems.

* Familiarity with Transportation Management System (TMS) platforms.

* Previous experience supporting compliance administration, driver coordination, or transportation-related operations.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and has a proven track record of successfully navigating international e-commerce environments.



The ideal candidate should also have strong hands-on experience with Amazon PPC, keyword research, data analysis, and SEO-focused product listing optimization, with the ability to independently analyze data, identify opportunities, and make actionable recommendations to improve campaign performance and increase sales.

title: Accountant
description:
Job Opportunity: Remote Accountant / Bookkeeper



Company: Busy Moms Red Deer Cleaning  

Position: Accountant / Bookkeeper  

Location: Remote  

Employment Type: Salary Position  

Schedule: Flexible Hours



About the Role



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced Accountant / Bookkeeper to join our growing business.



The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing our company's financial records, tracking expenses, reconciling accounts, overseeing accounts payable and receivable, and ensuring our financial information is accurate and up to date.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, take ownership of our accounting processes, identify discrepancies, and help us maintain strong financial organization as our company continues to grow.



Key Responsibilities



- Bookkeeping & Financial Records: Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, including income, expenses, invoices, and transactions.

- Accounts Receivable: Monitor outstanding invoices, track customer payments, follow up on overdue accounts, and maintain accurate payment records.

- Accounts Payable: Track business expenses, process vendor invoices, and ensure bills are paid on time.

- Bank & Credit Card Reconciliation: Regularly reconcile bank accounts, credit card statements, and financial transactions.

- Payroll Support: Assist with payroll calculations, employee compensation records, and payroll reporting.

- Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly profit and loss statements, cash flow reports, expense summaries, and other financial reports.

- Tax Preparation & Compliance: Organize financial records for GST/HST filings, payroll remittances, and year-end tax preparation in accordance with Canadian accounting requirements.

- Expense Tracking & Budgeting: Monitor company spending, identify unnecessary expenses, and assist management with budgeting and financial planning.

- Accounting Software Management: Maintain accurate records using accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms.

- Financial Accuracy: Identify discrepancies, correct bookkeeping errors, and recommend improvements to financial processes.

- Administrative Support: Assist with other accounting and finance-related projects as needed.



Requirements



- Proven experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial administration.

- Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.

- Experience managing accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Proficiency in QuickBooks, Xero, or similar accounting software.

- Strong Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple responsibilities.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Experience preparing financial reports and reconciling accounts.

- Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.

- Ability to handle sensitive financial information with complete confidentiality.



Preferred Qualifications



- Previous accounting experience supporting a Canadian business.

- Familiarity with Canadian GST/HST, payroll, and CRA reporting requirements.

- Experience working with service-based businesses.

- Experience managing financial records for a growing company.

- Ability to analyze financial information and recommend improvements.

- Accounting or bookkeeping certification is considered an asset.



What We're Looking For



We are not simply looking for someone to enter numbers into a spreadsheet.



We want someone who takes ownership of our company's bookkeeping and accounting responsibilities, ensures our financial records are accurate, and helps us make better financial decisions.



The successful candidate will be proactive, dependable, trustworthy, and comfortable working independently while communicating regularly with management.



We value individuals who can identify problems, recommend solutions, and help create efficient accounting systems that support long-term business growth.



What We Offer



- Fully remote position

- Flexible working hours

- Salary-based compensation

- Long-term employment opportunity

- Supportive and collaborative team environment

- Opportunity to grow with an expanding Canadian business



How to Apply



If you are an experienced Accountant or Bookkeeper who takes pride in accuracy, organization, and financial management, we would love to hear from you.

title: Estimating Assistant
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Estimating Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday - Friday, 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour unpaid break.



Job Overview:

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Estimating Assistant to support Advanced Framing Structures (AFS), a Southern California commercial rough-carpentry and wood-framing subcontractor. In this role, you will process bid invitations, download and organize project documents, maintain accurate bid records in HubSpot, and prepare plan files and overlays in PlanSwift. You will work closely with the estimating team to ensure bid opportunities, deadlines, and project documents are complete, organized, and ready for review. 



The ideal candidate has strong administrative processing skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow established procedures consistently. Construction experience is helpful but not required. This is an administrative support role, not an independent estimating, pricing, or decision-making position.



Key Responsibilities:

Bid Invitation Administration

* Monitor assigned estimating
 inboxes, bid portals, and other sources for new Invitations to Bid (ITBs).

* Download bid invitations and related project documents, including plans, specifications, addenda, bid instructions, and available project information.

* Enter or update bid opportunity information in HubSpot and other company tracking systems.

* Record bid due dates, project names, General Contractor information, locations, and other required opportunity details.

* Respond to bid invitations using approved company responses and direction from the estimating team.

* Record whether AFS intends to bid, decline, or requires estimator review before responding.

* Flag duplicate invitations, missing documents, unclear due dates, addenda, or other issues for estimator review.



Bid Document Organization

* Create and maintain organized electronic bid folders using AFS naming and filing standards.

* Save plans, specifications, addenda, bid forms, and other documents in the correct project folder.

* Maintain current versions of documents and clearly identify revised or superseded plan sets when directed.

* Notify the assigned estimator when new plans, addenda, or material bid documents are received.

* Help maintain an accurate and easy-to-follow electronic record for each bid opportunity.



PlanSwift Support

* Upload/import project plan sets into PlanSwift.

* Organize and label plan pages so estimators can locate drawings efficiently.

* Verify basic page orientation and plan-file completeness before handing the file to the estimator.

* Set up plan overlays to compare revised drawings against prior plan versions using the company's established process.

* Identify and flag apparent drawing changes shown by overlays for estimator review.

* Do not independently determine the estimating, scope, cost, or schedule impact of drawing changes.



HubSpot / CRM Administration

* Create and update bid opportunities, companies, contacts, due dates, stages, and activity information in HubSpot.

* Maintain clean and consistent CRM records and avoid duplicate companies, contacts, or opportunities.

* Update opportunity status based on direction from the estimating team.

* Assist with routine CRM data cleanup, record maintenance, and reporting support as assigned.

* HubSpot experience is preferred but not required, as training may be provided to candidates with strong administrative skills.



Estimating Team Support

* Maintain bid calendars, trackers, and administrative task lists as assigned.

* Assist estimators with locating, downloading, renaming, organizing, and distributing bid documents.

* Perform routine data entry and document-preparation tasks related to estimating.

* Follow up internally when information or direction is needed to complete an assigned administrative task.

* Support other routine estimating administrative work consistent with the level and purpose of the position.



Required Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in administrative support, data entry, document control, CRM administration, accounts payable, construction administration, estimating support, or a similar role is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when handling repetitive tasks and high volumes of administrative information.

* Excellent digital file management and organizational skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, Teams, and Excel.

* Experience downloading, uploading, renaming, organizing, and managing digital documents, especially large PDF files.

* Good written English and the ability to prepare concise, professional
s and communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team.

* Ability to follow written instructions, established procedures, checklists, and naming conventions consistently.

* Good judgment in identifying missing information, conflicting dates, duplicate records, revised documents, and other discrepancies.

* Ability to verify information, check work for errors, and use organized systems to maintain accuracy rather than relying solely on memory.

* Willingness to ask questions and escalate unclear instructions rather than guess or make unsupported assumptions.

* Ability to learn new software and workflows quickly and demonstrate tasks through screen sharing when required.

* Dependable, coachable, and comfortable performing repetitive, process-driven administrative work.

* Ability to work independently within clearly defined responsibilities and maintain reliable follow-through on assigned tasks.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and a suitable professional remote-work environment.

* Ability to work the confirmed schedule aligned with AFS's Southern California operations.



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with PlanSwift; familiarity with Bluebeam or similar PDF and plan-document software is an advantage.

* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

* Previous experience in construction administration, estimating support, bid coordination, or document control.

* Familiarity with construction plans, specifications, bid invitations, addenda, and general construction terminology.

* Experience using trackers, checklists, and standardized filing systems to maintain accurate records and prevent errors.

* Note: PlanSwift and HubSpot experience is preferred but not required.



Working Conditions

* This position focuses on administrative processing, document management, CRM maintenance, and plan preparation to support the estimating team.

* The employee will not make independent bid/no-bid decisions or determine which project scope should be included or excluded.

* Establishing labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, markup, or final bid pricing is outside the scope of this role.

* Independent final quantity takeoffs, estimating approvals, pricing negotiations, and contract decisions are not part of the position.

* The employee must not submit final proposals or make commitments on behalf of AFS without authorization.

* Plan overlays are prepared to help identify drawing revisions. Determining their scope, cost, or scheduling impact is the responsibility of the estimator.

* Missing documents, conflicting information, unclear instructions, and unusual requests must be escalated to the assigned estimator or estimating leader.

* The employee is expected to maintain organized records, follow established procedures, and communicate progress or issues promptly to the estimating team.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

Friendly atmosphere

title: Online Reputation Management and Community Forum Specialist
description:
[Online Reputation Management and Community Forum Specialist (Part Time)]



TYPE OF WORK: Part Time

WAGE / SALARY: $8.00 to $9.00 per hour, depending on verified experience

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to start

LOCATION: Remote (Philippines)



ABOUT US

We are a US based brand selling automotive covers and accessories. We sell through our own website and through Amazon and eBay.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for an experienced Online Reputation Management specialist to help strengthen our brand's presence across online communities and improve branded search results.



The primary focus of this role is monitoring and participating in relevant forums, identifying reputation risks, and helping legitimate positive or neutral content outrank negative search results over time.



This isn't primarily a customer-service or review-response position. Candidates should have direct experience with online communities, branded search results, content promotion, and ethical reputation-suppression strategies.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Community Forum Management

- Find relevant forums and online communities where customers discuss our brand, products, competitors, or industry.

- Monitor discussions for brand mentions, complaints, misinformation, product questions, and reputation risks.

- Participate through useful, natural, and non-promotional contributions.

- Draft thoughtful responses that don't sound defensive, scripted, or overly promotional.

- Identify forum discussions that rank for branded searches and recommend an appropriate response strategy.

- Track discussion URLs, dates, topics, responses, engagement, and search visibility.

- Escalate legal threats, safety complaints, refund disputes, coordinated attacks, or potentially defamatory content.



Branded Search and Reputation Suppression

- Monitor priority searches involving the brand name, reviews, complaints, scams, customer service, and relevant product terms.

- Identify negative URLs, their ranking positions, content types, authority, sentiment, and likelihood of being displaced.

- Help develop ethical suppression strategies using legitimate owned, earned, and third-party assets.

- Optimize company profiles, social profiles, business listings, articles, videos, interviews, and other brand-related assets.

- Coordinate the creation and promotion of useful branded content that can occupy additional first-page search positions.

- Monitor ranking changes and recommend adjustments based on actual performance.

- Distinguish between results that may be corrected, removed, responded to, deindexed, or outranked.



Content and Reputation Assets

- Develop content briefs for branded articles, FAQs, company profiles, interviews, case studies, customer stories, and expert content.

- Support legitimate third-party placements, contributor opportunities, interviews, partnerships, and company profiles.

- Improve the credibility of reputation assets through accurate company information, identifiable authorship, firsthand experience, original media, and expert commentary.

- Coordinate with SEO, content, customer service, and leadership when public responses or new assets require approval.



Monitoring and Reporting

- Track page-one and page-two results for priority branded searches.

- Monitor new forum discussions, articles, reviews, and brand mentions.

- Maintain a weekly tracker covering negative URL positions, positive and neutral assets on pages one and two, new brand mentions, discussions requiring action, assets created or optimized, ranking changes, open risks, and recommended next steps.



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- At least two years of hands-on experience in online reputation management, community management, branded SEO, or search-result suppression.

- Direct experience monitoring and participating in established online forums or communities.

- Experience evaluating branded search results and tracking the positions of negative, positive, and neutral URLs.

- Strong written English and the ability to adapt to the tone and rules of different communities.

- Basic working knowledge of SEO, search intent, content optimization, links, authority, and indexing.

- Ability to recognize when a public response could make a situation worse and should be escalated.

- Strong research, documentation, organization, and reporting skills.

- Ability to provide specific examples of past work and clearly explain your individual contribution.



NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience managing ORM for an e-commerce or consumer brand.

- Experience improving branded search results through content, profiles, videos, digital PR, or legitimate third-party placements.

- Experience securing interviews, articles, contributor opportunities, citations, or editorial mentions.

- Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Trustpilot, BBB, social platforms, video platforms, and industry-specific forums.

- Experience using Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, rank-tracking platforms, or brand-monitoring tools.

- Knowledge of on-page SEO, internal linking, digital PR, entity optimization, and content distribution.

- Experience working with customer-service teams on complaint escalation and resolution.



PROHIBITED TACTICS

We're only interested in legitimate, sustainable reputation-management practices. The following tactics aren't permitted:

- Fake customer accounts or fabricated personal identities

- Fake reviews, testimonials, or customer experiences

- Review gating or incentives offered only for positive reviews

- Mass forum posting, automated comments, or spam links

- Harassment, intimidation, or coordinated reporting campaigns

- Misrepresenting an affiliation with the company

- Publishing false allegations about competitors

- Promising guaranteed removals or guaranteed ranking results



Candidates should be comfortable disclosing a company affiliation when required by a platform or when the relationship would materially affect how readers interpret a recommendation.



PERFORMANCE MEASURES

- Movement of priority negative URLs in branded search results

- Growth of legitimate positive and neutral assets on page one

- Quality and relevance of community participation

- Reputation risks identified before they escalate

- Accuracy and completeness of weekly reporting

- Quality of content, profile, and placement recommendations

- Compliance with company and community guidelines



Search-result suppression isn't guaranteed and may require several months, depending on the authority of the negative result and the competitiveness of the branded search.



WORK ARRANGEMENT

- Remote, part-time contractor position

- 20 hours per week to start, Monday to Friday, 4 hours a day. Hours can increase up to 40 based on performance and workload

- Your 4 hours fall within 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM US Pacific Time (10:00 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine Time). The exact block is set with your manager once you start

- Paid through Wise, on schedule

- Weekly progress reporting is required

- Some daily monitoring of brand mentions and community discussions may be needed

- During the initial training period, public responses and activity in new communities need approval before they go out



A NOTE ON APPLYING

If you have not done something, just say so in your answers. "I have not done that" costs you nothing here. What does count against you is describing work you did not personally do.



The role starts at 20 hours and can grow to 40, with the rate reviewed as the scope grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 NOT apply to 



Put COVERLAND at the start of your application, either in the subject line or as the first line of your message. Then answer all five questions below. Applications that skip questions, or answer in general terms without specific examples, will not be reviewed.



1. Brand and Project Scope

Describe one brand for which you personally handled online reputation management. Include:

- The industry or business type

- The month and year you started and finished

- Your exact responsibilities

- The number of negative results appearing within the first two pages of Google when you started

- Whether you worked independently or as part of a team

You may omit or anonymize the brand name if required by a confidentiality agreement.



2. Search-Result Movement

Choose one negative URL from that project and provide:

- The type of website on which it appeared

- Its approximate starting Google position

- Its approximate ending position

- The amount of time required

- The specific tactics you personally implemented

- How you tracked and verified the ranking movement

Do not claim that a result was suppressed if it only moved temporarily or disappeared because of a search-location change.



3. Community Forum Experience

Describe one forum or online-community situation you personally managed. Include the type of community, what you posted or recommended, whether you disclosed the brand relationship, and the outcome.



4. Strategy Scenario

A negative forum discussion ranks fourth when someone searches for a company's brand name. The discussion is several years old, but the forum has strong authority and the thread still receives occasional comments.

Explain how you would evaluate the result and what you would prioritize during the first 30, 60, and 90 days. Identify anything you would avoid doing and explain why.



5. Tools and Reporting

List the SEO, monitoring, community, and reporting tools you've used, and what you would include in a weekly ORM report. If available, attach a redacted example of a report or ranking tracker you personally prepared.



Please attach your resume.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a two-hour assessment. It is paid, whether or not you move forward.

title: Sales Executive
description:
# Business Development Executive — Shopify Plus Services



**Company:** Blackbelt Commerce®  

**Location:** Remote — South America  

**Schedule:** Full-time, dedicated role with availability during U.S. Eastern business hours  

**Market:** United States



### About Blackbelt Commerce®



Blackbelt Commerce® is a Shopify and Shopify Plus agency based in New York City. We help ecommerce brands improve their stores through custom design and development, integrations, migrations, conversion rate optimization, technical SEO, AI SEO, and ongoing support.



We are seeking an experienced salesperson to proactively find and close new U.S. clients who need expert support for their Shopify Plus stores.



### Your Mission



Build a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities and turn them into paying clients. You will own the sales process from identifying prospects and initiating contact through discovery, proposals, negotiation, and closing.



### Key Responsibilities



- Identify U.S. Shopify Plus brands that need store improvements, development, integrations, migrations, or ongoing support.

- Find and contact decision-makers, including founders, ecommerce directors, and marketing leaders.

- Generate opportunities through personalized
, LinkedIn outreach, phone calls, referrals, and partnerships.

- Conduct discovery calls to understand each prospect’s challenges, priorities, budget, and timeline.

title: GenAI Prompt Engineer
description:
GenAI Prompt Engineer

HeartStamp • Remote • Full-Time



About HeartStamp



HeartStamp is an AI-powered greeting card & invitation platform built for Millennials and Gen Z who find traditional cards cringe, generic, and emotionally hollow. Our platform lets users customize cards with AI, then either print them on demand or deliver them as interactive digital cards.



Art is one of the five pillars of every HeartStamp card (Holiday, Emotion, Art, Relationship, Text), and it's the pillar that makes a card feel like nothing else on the shelf. We're looking for someone to own that pillar.



About the Role



We're hiring a GenAI Prompt Engineer to lead the visual language of our card library: the art styles, movements, and looks that show up across every card we create. This role reports directly to our CEO and works alongside our creative director.



This is a full-time, fully remote position. We're looking for someone who treats generative AI models, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and the latest image generators, as their studio. You should already be building your own workflows to research styles, invent new ones, and produce work at a volume no single human hand could match without AI.



We move fast and ship constantly, so we need someone who can take a concept, turn it into a fully realized, production-ready style, and keep raising the bar on both quality and range as they go.



What You'll Create



Your work spans style development, production, and workflow. At a high level:



Art Style & Creative Direction



-Draw from the full history of art movements and media (painting, illustration, animation, photography, digital art, and beyond) to build new looks for HeartStamp cards



-Combine styles that don't normally get combined, creating original looks that are ours and ours alone



-Develop new art styles built specifically to resonate with Gen Z, grounded in what's actually trending in their feeds and communities, not what we assume they like



-Keep expanding our style library so our card art never goes stale or repeats itself. We have a creative staff to support. 



Production at Scale



-Write and structure image prompts in JSON so they can be generated, stored, and reused at scale across our card library

-Build prompt sets and templates that let us produce large batches of on-style card designs without starting from scratch each time

-Work with our GenAI Orchestrator (the internal system that routes render requests to our supported image models) to get new styles into production



AI-Native Workflow Development



-Use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other LLMs to design and refine art styles, not just to generate one-off images

-Build and improve your own workflows and tooling to automate the repetitive parts of prompt writing and style development

-Track the newest image generation models, including GPT-Image-2.5, xAI's Imagine, and Nano Banana, and fold what's useful into our production pipeline



What We're Looking For



Must-Have



-A strong portfolio showing command of a wide range of art styles and movements, and the ability to combine them into something new

-A demonstrated ability to create original art styles, particularly ones that resonate with Gen Z

-A genuine, current understanding of Gen Z culture: the visual trends, aesthetics, and social media movements they respond to, and why

-Comfort using LLMs like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as creative tools, to develop new art styles and automate parts of your own workflow, not just to write one-off prompts

-Experience working with JSON data, and the ability to write and structure image prompts in JSON format at scale

-Familiarity with the newest image generation models, including GPT-Image-2.5, xAI's Imagine, and Nano Banana

-Ability to produce a high volume of on-brand, high-quality art without sacrificing creative range



Nice to Have

-Familiarity with ComfyUI



Aesthetic Direction



HeartStamp's brand is smart, emotionally literate, and a little unhinged in the best possible way. Our card library should reflect the full range of art under the sun: watercolor, neon carnival, cyberpunk, Bauhaus, anime, character style transfers, and anything else that helps a card say exactly the right thing. We want someone who can push our style range further than it's ever gone, especially into territory that feels current and native to Gen Z rather than dated or generic.



We'll work closely with you on creative direction, but we want someone with strong instincts and opinions about what makes an art style actually land with our audience.



Engagement Details



-Remote: Fully remote, anywhere in the world

-Employment type: Full-time, reporting directly to our CEO

-Hours: Mon-Fri 8am-4pm EST

-Compensation: [$8-$13/hr range based on experience, talent, proficiency]



How to Apply



-Send us a brief introduction that covers the following:

-A portfolio link showing the range of art styles and movements you work in, including any original styles you've developed

-Examples of prompts or workflows you've built using JSON and LLMs like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini

-The image generation models and tools you use, including any experience with GPT-Image-2.0/2.5, xAI's Imagine, Nano Banana, or ComfyUI



We review on a rolling basis and move quickly when we find the right fit. We'd love to see your work.

title: AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor for TikTok/Reels Ads
description:
We are building **Kreo AI**, a new AI image and video generation mobile app.



Kreo AI helps users create AI videos, AI images, photo-to-video effects, AI dance videos, image edits, and viral social media content.



We are looking for a creative **AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor** who can generate high-quality AI image/video assets and turn them into jaw-dropping short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta ads, and TikTok ads.



This is not a general VA role. This role is focused on **AI content creation, short-form editing, and ad creative production**.



## Main Goal of the Role



Your main job is to create high-quality short-form video creatives using AI-generated assets.



You should be able to:



1. Generate AI images/videos using AI tools

2. Create strong visual concepts

3. Edit the assets into TikTok/Reels-style videos

4. Add hooks, captions, text overlays, music, and CTA

5. Create multiple creative variations for testing



We want videos that feel viral, modern, fast-paced, and suitable for TikTok/Reels/Meta ads.



## Responsibilities



### 1. AI Image & Video Asset Creation



You will create AI-generated assets for Kreo AI content and ads.



Examples:



* AI photo-to-video transformations

* AI dance/motion effects

* Cinematic AI videos

* AI portrait transformations

* AI image edits

* Before/after transformation assets

* App-style result demos

* Viral AI effect examples

* AI-generated visuals for ad creatives



Preferred AI tools:



* Kling

* Runway

* Seadance

* Google Veo

* Higgsfield

* ChatGPT / Claude for prompts



You do not need to know every tool, but you should be comfortable learning and testing AI tools quickly.



---



### 2. Short-Form Video Editing



You will turn AI assets into high-quality 9:16 videos for:



* TikTok

* Instagram Reels

* YouTube Shorts

* Meta Ads

* TikTok Ads



Editing should include:



* strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds

* fast pacing

* before/after reveal

* text overlays

* captions

* clean transitions

* music/sound effects

* result-first edits

* CTA ending

* mobile-first format



---



### 3. Ad Creative Production



You will create ad-style videos that can be tested on Meta and TikTok.



Example ad concepts:



* “One photo became this AI video”

* “AI turned my selfie into a movie scene”

* “Upload photo ? choose effect ? get result”

* “AI made my photo dance”

* “This is what AI can do with one image”

* “Create AI photos and turn them into videos”



The videos should be clear, exciting, and easy to understand even without sound.



---



### 4. Creative Variations



You will create multiple versions of the same concept for testing.



For example:



* different hooks

* different first 2 seconds

* different captions

* different thumbnail/cover text

* different CTA

* different music/sound

* different pacing

* different AI result examples



We are not looking for one single video only. We need someone who can create many testable creative variations.



---



### 5. Reference-Based Editing



We may provide reference videos or competitor ad examples.



Your job is to understand the structure and create an original Kreo version.



Important: We do not want to copy other brands exactly. We want to use inspiration and create original content for Kreo AI.



---



## Required Skills



* Strong short-form video editing skills

* Experience editing TikTok/Reels/Shorts

* Experience with CapCut or similar editing tools

* Good sense of pacing, hooks, and retention

* Ability to create before/after transformation videos

* Ability to add clean text overlays and captions

* Ability to create ad-style videos

* Ability to follow creative references

* Ability to generate or work with AI image/video assets

* Good communication

* Organized file delivery

* Ability to meet deadlines



---



## Nice-to-Have Skills



* Experience with AI video tools like Kling, Runway, Seadance, Veo, or Higgsfield

* Experience with AI image tools like Midjourney, DALL·E, or Leonardo

* Experience creating Meta ads or TikTok ads

* Experience with UGC-style ad creatives

* Experience promoting apps or SaaS products

* Experience with Premiere Pro / After Effects

* Experience writing hooks and captions

* Experience researching competitor ads



---



## Tools



Preferred tools:



* CapCut

* Canva

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Photoshop

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Notion



AI tools that are useful:



* Kling

* Runway

* Google Veo

* Higgsfield

* Seadance

* ChatGPT

* Claude



---



## Work Arrangement



This can start as a paid trial or part-time role.



If the quality is strong, this can become a long-term role.



Please include your expected rate for:



1. Part-time monthly work (4-5 hours/Day)

2. Full-time monthly work (8 hours/Day)



---



## Paid Trial Task



Before hiring long term, selected candidates will complete a paid trial.



For the trial, we will provide:



* one reference video format

* one AI photo/video concept

* basic brand direction for Kreo AI



Your task:



1. Create one 10–15 second vertical ad creative

2. Generate or prepare the AI visual/video asset

3. Add a strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds

4. Use fast pacing and clean captions

5. Show before/after or result reveal clearly

6. Add a CTA at the end

7. Provide 3 alternative hook options

8. Provide 3 thumbnail/cover text options

9. Explain which tools you used



The final video should feel suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.



---



## Example Creative Direction



Example concept:



**Normal photo ? AI cinematic video transformation**



Possible structure:



1. Show final AI result first for 1 second

Your main job is to help us find viral AI photo/video trends and turn them into content ideas, app template ideas, hooks, captions, and simple short-form videos.



We are looking for someone who can help us build a content system for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This is not only an admin role. We need someone creative, curious, and interested in AI apps and viral content.

-style AI videos

 Effect

### 6. Competitor Research

About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Video Editor & YouTube Growth Specialist to help us grow our YouTube channel and expand our content across social media platforms.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that great social media content is about more than simply editing a video. You should know how to capture attention, maintain viewer retention, create strong hooks, and package content in a way that makes people want to click and watch.



You’ll primarily work with video footage that we provide and turn it into engaging YouTube videos and short-form content for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
.



We’re especially interested in someone who understands how YouTube works and can contribute ideas about what makes content perform, how to improve retention, and how to grow a channel over time.







About AppAid



AppAid is a dedicated Social Security advocacy group committed to assisting individuals with disabilities who are unable to work full-time. Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



As our company continues to grow, we’re investing in our digital presence to expand our YouTube and social media channels and reach more people with helpful, engaging content about the disability benefits process. We’re looking for talented individuals to help us grow that audience and support our continued growth.





What You'll Do

Edit engaging YouTube videos and short-form social media content



Turn raw footage into compelling, polished videos designed to maximize viewer retention



Identify strong moments, hooks, and storylines within longer footage



Create engaging openings that capture attention within the first few seconds



Add captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects, music, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate



Create high-click-through-rate YouTube thumbnails



Develop multiple thumbnail or title concepts when appropriate



Repurpose longer videos into Shorts, TikToks, Reels, and other social content



Adapt editing styles and formats for different platforms



Help identify trends, formats, and content opportunities that could help grow the channel



Collaborate with our team on video concepts, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and overall content strategy



Stay up to date with YouTube and short-form video trends within the Social Security Disability niche





What We're Looking For/Required:

Strong video editing skills



Experience editing content specifically for YouTube/Shorts and/or social media



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention



Ability to create professional and attention-grabbing thumbnails



Strong visual and creative instincts



Ability to take raw footage and identify the most engaging moments



Ability to receive and implement feedback promptly, making requested revisions accurately and within a reasonable timeframe



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Strong attention to detail



Strongly Preferred:



Demonstrated experience using video editing and content strategy to grow a YouTube channel, including measurable improvements in views, watch time, subscribers, or engagement

Experience developing YouTube thumbnails



Experience with A/B testing or experimenting with different hooks, titles, thumbnails, or editing styles



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar tools







The ideal candidate is creative, curious, and focused on results. They should be able to look at a piece of footage and think:



"What is going to make someone stop scrolling?"

"What will make them keep watching?"

"What's the strongest moment in this footage?"

"How can we package this so someone wants to click?"



You should be comfortable bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you think a particular edit, hook, thumbnail, or format could perform better.





As part of the application process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short editing exercise using raw footage provided by us. The exercise will involve creating a 15–30 second social media video so we can better understand your editing style, creativity, pacing, and ability to create an engaging hook.

title: Sales & Client Relations Specialist
description:
# Sales & Client Relations Specialist



**Full-Time | Remote | US Market | Excellent English & Strong Sales Skills Required**



**Company:** Kynetik — by Nova AI Labs  

**Industry:** Consumer App Growth / Digital Marketing  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary + performance incentives, based on experience



## About Kynetik



Kynetik is a growth service operated by Nova AI Labs, an Australian technology company.



We help consumer apps grow through creative strategy, short-form content production, TikTok and Instagram distribution, and continuous performance testing.



We're looking for a **highly persuasive, confident, and results-driven Sales & Client Relations Specialist** who can turn interested prospects into qualified sales opportunities and build strong relationships with our clients.



**This is not a typical administrative or virtual assistant role. We need someone who knows how to SELL.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Sales Pitching & Lead Conversion



- Engage with inbound leads generated through Meta advertising, website inquiries, and other marketing channels.

- Confidently explain and pitch Kynetik's services to consumer app founders and business owners.

- Understand each prospect's challenges and clearly communicate how Kynetik can address them.

- Deliver compelling, natural, and personalized sales pitches through
, messaging, and video calls.

- Build trust, create interest, and communicate the value of our services.

- Handle common objections about pricing, effectiveness, competition, and expected results.

- Identify buying signals and move interested prospects toward the next step.

- Follow up strategically to improve conversions.

- Conduct initial discovery conversations and book qualified strategy calls with the founder.



### 2. Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting



- Qualify prospects based on their product, business goals, marketing requirements, and purchasing readiness.

- Prioritize high-quality prospects rather than simply increasing appointment numbers.

- Schedule and confirm strategy calls.

- Maintain professional communication before and after meetings.

- Follow up with leads who have not responded or have missed appointments.

- Ensure every qualified lead receives timely attention.



### 3. Client Relations & Communication



- Maintain professional relationships with existing clients.

- Respond promptly to routine customer inquiries.

- Communicate approved campaign updates and reports.

- Collect feedback and identify potential concerns.

- Manage follow-ups and support customer retention.

- Escalate important commercial decisions or client issues directly to the founder.



### 4. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management



- Maintain accurate lead and client records.

- Track prospects through each stage of the sales pipeline.

- Monitor follow-up schedules and pending decisions.

- Record objections, customer requirements, and sales opportunities.

- Prepare daily lead updates and weekly sales performance reports.



## Essential Requirements



### Excellent Sales & Persuasion Skills — Critical



We are looking for someone who can:



- Sell confidently without sounding aggressive or desperate.

- Understand customer pain points and position a solution effectively.

- Deliver a structured, compelling sales pitch.

- Ask intelligent discovery questions.

- Build rapport quickly with founders and decision-makers.

- Handle objections calmly and persuasively.

- Communicate value instead of relying on discounts.

- Guide conversations toward a clear next step.

- Follow up consistently without sounding robotic.

- Demonstrate genuine confidence during customer conversations.



**Previous experience in B2B sales, appointment setting, sales development, or consultative selling is strongly preferred.**



### Exceptional English Communication — Mandatory



- Near-native fluency in spoken and written English.

- Natural, confident, articulate communication suitable for US business customers.

- Excellent grammar, vocabulary, listening comprehension, and conversational skills.

- Ability to communicate persuasively without reading from scripts.

- Professional written communication with appropriate tone and clarity.

- Ability to think quickly and respond naturally during live sales conversations.



An accent is not a d
 factor. Clarity, fluency, confidence, and persuasive ability are what matter.



### Professional Experience



- Experience working with US or other international clients.

- Familiarity with CRM and appointment scheduling tools.

- Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace and online communication platforms.

- Ability to work independently and meet performance expectations.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable environment for professional calls.



**Preferred Experience**



- Digital marketing or agency sales

- Consumer apps, SaaS, or technology services

- Selling monthly service retainers

- Lead conversion from Meta advertising

- Sales discovery calls and objection handling

- Customer relationship management



## Reporting Structure & Authority



You will report directly to the founder.



This position focuses on sales, lead qualification, and client relationships.



You will not manage our creative team, assign production tasks, control publishing accounts, or make independent pricing and contractual commitments.



You may present approved services and sales proposals, but final commercial agreements and exceptions require founder approval.



## Working Hours



- Availability overlapping US business hours

- Consistent schedule agreed during hiring



## Performance Expectations



Your performance will be measured through:



- Number of qualified leads

- Qualified strategy calls booked

- Appointment attendance rate

- Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

- Quality of sales conversations

- Consistency and effectiveness of follow-ups

- CRM accuracy

- Customer satisfaction

- Contribution to closed sales and client retention

- Natural English fluency

- Persuasive communication

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a live sales role-play interview.



We will evaluate your ability to understand a customer's needs, deliver a convincing sales pitch, handle objections, and guide the conversation toward a next step.



**We are looking for a strong salesperson—not simply someone who speaks good English.**



If you are confident, persuasive, articulate, organized, and enjoy selling valuable services to business owners, we'd love to hear from you.
