We are looking for an experienced Content & Growth Manager to run the day-to-day content, social-media, community-engagement and lead-management system for three established businesses in British Columbia, Canada.

The businesses operate in separate markets:

 1. A Victoria-area real-estate business serving homeowners, buyers, sellers, relocators, upsizers and downsizers.

 2. A custom-home and major-renovation company serving homeowners, landowners, architects, REALTORS and developers.

 3. A civil excavation company building relationships with developers, estimators, general contractors and other industry partners.

These are three separate brands. They must maintain distinct audiences, voices, graphics, content calendars, folders and public identities. This is not a cross-promotion role.

You will not be expected to film and edit every piece of content yourself. You will coordinate with an owner, director, videographer and editor. Your job is to make the complete marketing system work: research, planning, briefing, coordination, writing, publishing, engagement, lead capture, CRM handoff and performance reporting.

We are not looking for someone who measures success only by how many posts were published. We want someone who understands that content should build trust, start useful conversations and create qualified business opportunities.

What you will own

 ◦ Maintain one master production calendar and three separate brand calendars.

 ◦ Research each audience, local market, competitors, search behaviour and useful content opportunities.

 ◦ Turn the owner's knowledge, opinions, project access and recorded footage into clear content briefs.

 ◦ Coordinate deadlines and deliverables with the director, videographer and editor.

 ◦ Adapt approved content appropriately for
, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and other selected channels.

 ◦ Write strong captions, hooks, titles, descriptions, calls to action, email copy and basic SEO metadata.

 ◦ Schedule, publish and quality-check all approved content.

 ◦ Manage routine comments, direct messages and community interaction in the correct brand voice.

 ◦ Monitor relevant local and industry conversations and identify appropriate opportunities to engage.

 ◦ Ask initial qualification questions, capture contact information and route genuine leads quickly.

 ◦ Maintain accurate lead source, status, notes and follow-up information in the CRM.

 ◦ Maintain organized content libraries, brand assets, permissions, passwords and reusable templates.

 ◦ Produce concise weekly reporting on completed work, audience response, leads, appointments and lessons.

 ◦ Recommend experiments based on evidence and follow them through to a measurable conclusion.

The three content programs

Capital City Group — Real Estate

The primary audience is homeowners in Victoria and the Capital Regional District who may be upsizing, downsizing, selling or relocating. Additional audiences include buyers, first-time buyers, investors and developers.

Content should emphasize:

 ◦ Local property and market intelligence

 ◦ Moving, selling and buying strategy

 ◦ Victoria-area communities and lifestyle

 ◦ Negotiation and transaction knowledge

 ◦ Construction and property-condition insight

 ◦ Selective personal content that supports trust without turning the brand into a lifestyle account

The brand's service promise is: Choose Experience, Expect Results.

Footprint — Custom Homes and Renovations

The audience includes homeowners, landowners, people searching for land, REALTORS, architects, designers and developers. Typical projects are substantial custom builds and renovations.

Content should emphasize:

 ◦ How homes are actually designed and built

 ◦ Cost, process and transparency

 ◦ Diagnosing construction problems

 ◦ Practical solutions and case studies

 ◦ Design-build and preconstruction decisions

 ◦ Evidence of meticulous, capable execution

Footprint must remain publicly separate from the real-estate brand.

Argus Excavating — Civil Construction

The objective is to strengthen Argus's professional civil-contractor presence, build relationships with estimators, general contractors and developers, increase invitations to tender and generate repeat work.

Content should demonstrate:

 ◦ Capabilities, equipment and crews

 ◦ Civil work and site-servicing knowledge

 ◦ Project planning and problem-solving

 ◦ Safety, professionalism and execution

 ◦ Project progress and completed work

 ◦ Credibility with commercial and development partners

What the owner retains

The owner will provide subject-matter expertise, opinions, access to properties and jobsites, and approval of sensitive material. The owner will also handle qualified sales conversations, estimates, negotiations and closing.

You must flag technical, financial, legal, client-sensitive or reputation-sensitive statements for approval. You will be expected to organize content into efficient approval batches rather than requesting scattered approvals throughout every day.

Required qualifications

 ◦ At least three years of relevant social-media, content-marketing or digital-growth experience

 ◦ Demonstrated responsibility for strategy and execution, not scheduling alone

 ◦ Excellent written and spoken English

 ◦ Experience managing more than one brand, client or audience at the same time

 ◦ Strong content-calendar, project-management and deadline-management skills

 ◦ Experience with community management and professional direct-message communication

 ◦ Experience qualifying leads and maintaining a CRM or equivalent lead-management system

 ◦ Ability to interpret analytics and explain what should change as a result

 ◦ Strong judgment, attention to detail and willingness to take ownership

 ◦ Reliable computer, high-speed internet and professional remote-work environment

Helpful but not mandatory

 ◦ Experience in real estate, construction, home improvement, civil contracting or professional services

 ◦ Familiarity with Follow Up Boss or another sales CRM

 ◦ Basic short-form video editing, clipping, thumbnail or graphic-design skills

 ◦ Experience coordinating videographers, editors or creative contractors

 ◦ Familiarity with email marketing, local SEO and YouTube optimization

 ◦ Experience working with Canadian, American, Australian or British clients

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you will have:

 ◦ Established reliable, separate workflows for all three brands

 ◦ Created organized calendars and content libraries

 ◦ Maintained a consistent publishing and engagement cadence

 ◦ Reduced the owner's administrative involvement in content production

 ◦ Implemented prompt and accurate lead capture and routing

 ◦ Produced reporting that connects content and conversations to qualified opportunities

 ◦ Demonstrated that you can identify problems, recommend solutions and follow through

How to apply

Start your application with the words THREE DISTINCT BRANDS so we know you read the complete posting.

Include:

 1. A short explanation of why this role fits your experience.

 2. Links to two or three accounts or campaigns you personally helped manage.

 3. For each example, explain exactly what you personally owned and what someone else produced.

 4. One example of content or engagement that produced a measurable business result.

 5. The tools you use for calendars, scheduling, analytics, CRM and team coordination.

 6. Your desired monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

 7. Your available working hours and the amount of daily Pacific Time overlap you can provide.

 8. A 60–90 second video introduction. Production quality is not important; clarity and communication are.

Do not send a generic cover letter. Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical exercise and attend a structured video interview.

---

title: Video Editor
description:
Job description:



Hey! We’re a small brand and web design studio in Brisbane, Australia. Two founders, two personal brand pages, and a growing pile of footage that neither of us has time to edit. That’s where you come in.



Who we’re looking for



Someone creative with a good eye, who thinks a little differently. You’re the kind of person who notices a cut is two frames too long and can’t sleep until it’s fixed.



One warning: we like things simple. If your favourite tools are flashing emojis, whoosh sounds and captions that bounce like a kids’ birthday party, we’re probably not a match. Our style is clean and minimal, and we follow our brand guidelines closely. Yes, we’re designers. Yes, we will notice the wrong font.



The role



Full-time, 40 hours per week

20-30 Reels per week

Turnaround: 48 hrs per video, with one round of revisions

Pay: competitive, based on skill and experience

Software: we’d prefer After Effects with Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. But if you can get the same result in CapCut, go for it. We care about the result, not the tool

We’re reviewing applications this Sunday, 11 October, so get yours in before then



All videos are vertical (9:16, 1080x1920), 30 to 90 seconds, for Instagram Reels and TikTok. We send you the raw footage and screen recordings, so you’ll never have to film us. You’re welcome.



The 3 styles you’ll edit



Please watch each reference before you apply. It takes about three minutes.



Style 1: Single-take skit with captions

Reference: 



One continuous shot, no B-roll

Slow, smooth zoom-in on the speaker across the whole video

Title at the top for the first 2 to 3 seconds, with one keyword in a highlight colour

Word-by-word captions (1 to 3 words at a time) in the centre of the frame, timed exactly to the speech



Style 2: Talking head with website/screen overlays

Reference: 



Speaker stays in the lower half of the frame

Screenshots and screen recordings appear as floating windows above the speaker, changing every 2 to 4 seconds to match what is being said

Animated cursor, zoom-ins and highlights on the exact part of the screen being discussed

Small, clean captions in a white box

You will need to find and capture the websites and images mentioned in the script



Style 3: Voiceover B-roll montage

Reference: 



Voiceover over many short lifestyle clips (about one cut every 2 seconds)

Clips must match what is being said at that moment

Large keyword text on the opening hook, then small minimal captions for the rest

Light, consistent colour grade across all clips

Ends with a call to action on screen (e.g. comment “keyword”)



What every video needs



A hook in the first 2 seconds (title text plus movement)

Captions that are 100

title: Fresh Graduates — No Experience Necessary — Support Role, Global Media Business
description:
Your first real career, in a global YouTube network. Multiple positions.



START YOUR CAREER HERE



No experience necessary — fresh graduates or those still studying preferred.



Just graduated, or about to? Struggling to get a start because everyone wants experience you don't have yet? This is for you.



No experience necessary — we'll train you completely



- No experience necessary — we'll train you completely

- Work from home — anywhere in the Philippines

- A real career with a fast path up — not a dead-end gig

- Start at a graduate wage and grow quickly as you prove yourself

- Learn scheduling first, then SEO, YouTube, thumbnails, content — with a real path into management

- Join a genuine team and build something real



We give hungry graduates their start — and we invest properly in the ones who show us they're worth it. If you're ready to work hard, learn fast, and build a career, keep reading.



WHO YOU'D BE JOINING



MrYouWho — a global tech-media network:

- 280,000+ subscribers across 16 channels

- Millions of views

- Partnerships with major international brands

- Growing fast, and building our team from the ground up



WHY THIS SUITS A GRADUATE



- No experience necessary — we prefer it. University projects, internships and OJT all count.

- Everything runs on clear, documented processes and simple tools. We've built the system — we'll train you on it.

- We'd rather teach someone fresh our way than hire someone with bad habits.

- We're not after experience. We're after good people — reliable, hungry, and willing to think.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Graduates (or graduating soon), ideally in Media, Communications, Marketing or Business — but attitude matters more than your field. A genuine interest in YouTube and social media stands out.



We want people who are:



- Reliable above all — turn up, follow the process, never cut corners

- Thinkers — you follow the process AND use your head. If something's obviously wrong, you catch it. You own the work being right, not just done.

- Owners of their learning — keen, self-driven, all-in. The more you give, the more we give back.

- Detail-focused — follow a checklist exactly, don't skip steps

- Able to commit to regular, set hours



We are NOT looking for:



- People who've worked for several years — these roles are to train fresh talent, so please don't apply

- Flashy CVs or big-word applications — we want genuine, keen people who want to work, not people who are good at selling themselves



THE WORK



- Schedule and publish content across our YouTube channels and socials (using tools like Metricool)

- Follow our process exactly — right platform, right format, links where specified, each post done properly and separately

- Track your work, hit daily deadlines, flag anything unclear rather than guessing

- Use judgement — never push out something obviously wrong just because the steps said so

- Grows into localisation, Social Media, Editing, SEO, thumbnails, blogs and content for those who deliver - We literally have endless work.



High-output from day one. Real volume, straight away — no coasting, no easing in.



- Sit back or work on autopilot? This isn't for you.

- Work hard, learn fast, think, and get rewarded for it? This is a genuine opportunity.



When you join, you're not just a contractor — you become a YouWhoer, part of a team building something real.



WHAT YOU NEED



- A quiet place to work

- A reliable computer

- Strong, stable internet

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable being tracked with
 software (standard for these roles)

- Able to commit to regular set shifts — not fitting this around other clients



PAY & HOURS



- Starting rate US $3.00/hour, paid in PHP at the current exchange rate

- A genuine starting point — rises to $4 and beyond as you prove reliable, accurate and capable

- Increases earned through results, not negotiated

- Contract role, up to 40 hrs/week, starting part-time and scaling as you prove consistent



FIRST STEP



A short assessment to test your written and thinking skills. It's how we see how you approach work — so put the effort in.



HOW TO APPLY



Read carefully — applications that don't follow this won't be read.



1. Put your DEGREE and GRADUATION DATE (or expected date) in the SUBJECT LINE

 (e.g. "MARKETING GRADUATE" or "COMMUNICATIONS — GRADUATING 2026")

 If you don't do this we won't open the application



2. Answer these in your OWN WORDS — not a stock AI answer, we can tell:



 - Why do you want to work with us specifically, and what would you bring? Be genuine, not generic.

 - Look up our channel — MrYouWho on YouTube. Watch a few videos, then tell us honestly: what do we actually do, and one specific thing you noticed about how we make our videos.

 - Describe a time you spotted a mistake or problem others missed, and what you did about it.

 - What regular hours can you commit to each week, and are you currently working or studying anything else?

 - Anything else that makes you a standout and gives us a reason to reply — surprise us.



3. At the very END of your application, write the word SCHEDULE so we know you read this properly.



Anyone we think is interesting, we'll reply to with a few more questions.



We won't reply if steps not followed.



We're genuinely excited to find the right people and bring them into the team. Bring the one thing we can't teach — passion — and we'll teach you everything else.



We'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Video Clipping & Social Media Automation Specialist
description:
I'm Terrence Ruffin, a professional bodybuilder and content creator behind Ruff Diesel. I'm looking for a specialist to build a system that automatically turns my completed YouTube videos into short-form content and publishes it to social media.



This is a systems-building role. The goal is to automate clipping and distribution with minimal manual work.



WHAT THE SYSTEM NEEDS TO DO

- Accept a completed video file or YouTube link through a simple submission process.

- Use AI to identify strong, self-contained moments from bodybuilding, training, business and lifestyle videos.

- Create vertical clips with accurate captions, effective framing and clean cuts.

- Draft platform-appropriate captions in my voice.

- Schedule and publish clips to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok using supported integrations.

- Track what has been published, prevent duplicate posts and flag failures.

- Allow review before publishing, with the option to automate posting further once quality is proven.



QUALITY MATTERS

Clips must have a clear hook and payoff, preserve the meaning of what I said, and avoid awkward cuts. The system should prioritize useful insights, stories and compelling moments.



REQUIREMENTS

- Experience with AI video clipping tools and automated publishing workflows.

- Ability to connect tools using n8n, Make, Zapier or APIs.

- Understanding of short-form editing, captions and vertical reframing.

- Evidence of similar systems you personally built.

- Clear documentation and the ability to train my assistant to manage the system.



FIRST PAID PROJECT

Use one of my completed YouTube videos to demonstrate the full workflow: video intake, AI clipping, captions, review and scheduled publishing. Explain what is automated, what requires manual input and the monthly software costs.



TO APPLY, SEND

1. A video demonstration of a similar workflow you built.

2. Three example clips produced by your system.

3. Your recommended tools and their limitations.

4. Your setup fee, ongoing maintenance rate and availability.

5. How you would prevent weak clips, incorrect captions and publishing errors.



Start your application with "Ruff Diesel Automation."



Project-based initially, with potential for ongoing maintenance. Compensation negotiable based on scope and experience; include your project quote in your application.

title: Research & Operations Assistant
description:
We're a U.S.-based company doing two things: running outbound growth campaigns for B2B software companies, and researching established small businesses for acquisition. The founder closes every deal personally. Your job is to make sure he never runs out of qualified people to talk to.



You'll work alongside our current assistant, who has been with us for over six months. This is a long-term role for someone who takes pride in getting things right the first time.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Research businesses and owners using Google, LinkedIn, Google Maps, BBB, and company websites

- Verify every fact before it goes in our system: owner name, founding year, review counts, contact info

- Coordinate our direct mail letter campaigns: prep prospect lists, track shipments, log responses

- Keep our Google Sheets tracker clean and current

- Execute tasks from written checklists (SOPs) exactly as written

- Send a short end-of-day report: what you did, what you found, what's blocked





WHAT MAKES YOU A FIT



- Excellent written English

- You'd rather say "I couldn't verify this" than guess

- You notice when two sources disagree, and you flag it

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail, and LinkedIn

- You follow instructions. All of them.

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, available 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday, with some overlap with U.S. Eastern time





COMPENSATION



- [$3/hour] starting

- Performance bonus for prospects you research who become clients

- Raises based on accuracy and reliability, reviewed every 90 days





HOW TO APPLY: READ EVERY WORD



We get hundreds of applications. Most are copy-pasted from AI tools. We delete those immediately. We want a real person who reads carefully and thinks for themselves.





STEP 1: SUBJECT LINE



Your subject line must be exactly: Reliable: [Your First Name]





STEP 2: DO THIS FIRST (THE RESEARCH TEST)



Find one accounting or CPA firm in Louisville, Kentucky that has been in business at least 15 years. Send us:



1. The firm name and website

2. The owner or managing partner's full name

3. The year the firm was founded, with TWO DIFFERENT SOURCES that confirm it (links)

4. A screenshot of the firm's Google reviews showing the review count and star rating

5. One thing about this firm you tried to find but COULD NOT VERIFY, and where you looked



There is no trick here. Number 5 is the most important answer. We want to see how you handle what you don't know.





STEP 3: THE HUMAN TEST



1. Take a piece of paper. Handwrite the word "Reliable", today's date, and your first name. Take a photo of it with your hand visible in the frame. Attach it.

2. In ONE sentence, ALL lowercase letters, tell us the last thing you got wrong at work and how you found out.

3. Answer this in FIVE WORDS OR FEWER: what would you do if two sources gave you two different founding years?

4. If you used ChatGPT or any AI tool to write your application, mention a pineapple somewhere in it.





STEP 4



Tell us your current time zone and what hours you can work.





Applications missing any step will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will move to a paid second round.

title: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT / PROJECT MANAGER / AI AGENT MANAGER
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT & PROJECT MANAGER

AI Agent Management · Multiple Clients · Business & Personal Support



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



REMOTE · FULL-TIME · INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR

$1,500/month · $750 paid on the 1st and 15th

Monday–Friday · 9 AM–6 PM Central · One-hour unpaid lunch



THE ROLE

────────────────────────────────────────



We need an experienced, highly technical executive assistant and project manager who works quickly, manages AI agents confidently, and keeps multiple clients’ work moving.



This is not a beginner position. You must already know how to manage projects, executive support, and competing priorities independently. Each client has different preferences, personalities, systems, and expectations—you need to switch between them efficiently without losing details.



Our AI agents already handle substantial work across inboxes, calendars, research, documents, task tracking, quality checks, and Slack follow-ups. You’ll direct that work, troubleshoot problems, verify results, and ensure completion while handling the responsibilities that require a person.



TECHNICAL SKILLS & SPEED MATTER

────────────────────────────────────────



Basic
 skills or occasional ChatGPT use are not enough. You should enjoy technology and have hands-on experience building useful tools and solving workflow problems.



· Know Claude, ChatGPT, and AI-agent workflows beyond surface-level prompting.

· Use AI-assisted coding to build apps, internal tools, and automations.

· Be familiar with Excel VBA and macros, including adapting and troubleshooting code with AI assistance.

· Work comfortably with OpenAI-powered systems, Slack integrations, APIs, and connected tools.

· Test what you build and verify that it works.



You don’t need to be a professional programmer. You do need technical confidence, curiosity, and demonstrated ability.



This is a fast-paced environment. Spending three hours on routine daily inbox management is not an acceptable working pace. Use AI, automation, and good judgment to work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

────────────────────────────────────────



· Manage AI agents: assign tasks, provide context, monitor progress and usage, correct errors, and improve workflows.

· Coordinate client projects, deadlines, deliverables, vendors, team members, and review cycles.

· Manage inboxes, calendars, travel, meeting preparation, documents, and follow-ups.

· Maintain project management tools, CRM, spreadsheets, and accurate records.

· Support billing, budget tracking, research, contractor coordination, and document quality.

· Handle personal and household administration, including scheduling, appointments, services, orders, expenses, and records.

· Communicate clearly, adapt to each client, protect confidential information, and escalate decisions promptly.



AI performs much of the preparation and recurring work. You own priorities, judgment, quality, communication, and follow-through.



WHAT YOU NEED

────────────────────────────────────────



· Approximately 3+ years of relevant project management, executive support, VA, or operations experience.

· Experience supporting multiple clients or executives.

· Strong organization, writing, spreadsheet skills, and attention to detail.

· Independent follow-through and the ability to work quickly under changing priorities.

· A fast, reliable computer, multiple monitors, dependable internet, and backup connectivity.

· Availability during the required hours and readiness to start immediately.



PAY & BENEFITS

title: Creative VA — Canva Listing Design & Pinterest Pins (Available to Start Now, Paid Trial)
description:
Hi! I'm Toni and I run TopSheets, a growing digital product business selling spreadsheet templates (Google Sheets + Excel) on Etsy and my own website, in four languages. I'm hiring a creative VA to handle the recurring design and content work that keeps the business visible: Etsy listing graphics, Pinterest pins, and eventually short-form social content.



**I'm hiring right now.** Trial week starts on Monday, October 12th, 2026.  Please apply only if you're available and able to start by that date.



This is batch, repetitive, template-driven work, and you'll get very fast at it. If you like production-style creative work where you get faster and more precise the more you do it, this is a great fit.



It's a part-time role built around a weekly task list: I send you the list at the start of the week, and you deliver by the end of the week. You choose your own hours. No time tracking, no fixed schedule. I care about finished work, not hours online.



# What You'll Do



**Canva listing design (the core of the role):**



I'm upgrading all of my Etsy listing pages to a new brand style, and I have a style guide to work from. Each product has 8–15 listing images, and the work for each product breaks into three repeatable steps:



1. **Redesign:** adapt the product's current listing images into the new style. This is the only truly new design work for that product.

2. **Color variations:** swap the mockup photos for screenshots of the other color-palette versions of the template, and update accent colors to match each palette. Same layout, same text, new visuals and colors.

3. **Language versions:** paste in the translations I provide (German, Spanish, French), and swap the mockup images (laptops, iPads, etc.) for screenshots of that language's template. No translation work required from you.



Once step 1 is done for a product, steps 2 and 3 are very mechanical. All future listing mockups (new templates, bundles, seasonal updates) will follow the same new style.



- **Reference:** browse my current Etsy shop here: 
. These are the listings being upgraded, so treat them as context, not the target. The new style stays clean and practical, matching a genuine spreadsheet/planner aesthetic. It is not flashy, trendy, or AI-generated-looking.

- You'll work inside a dedicated Canva workspace folder I'll share with you (edit access). 



**Pinterest:**

- Design pins in Canva using my brand templates (static + video pins)

- Deliver a set number of finished pins each week. I handle scheduling and descriptions myself.



**Social media content (growing part of the role):**

- I'm currently on Pinterest only. I plan to build Instagram and TikTok accounts down the road, and I'd like the person in this role to grow with that

- Create short-form photo and video posts (reels/TikToks) showing our templates in use: aesthetic, satisfying, planner-community style content

- I provide the screen recordings and brand kit; you bring the editing and the eye



# Requirements



- **Available to start the paid trial week on 10/12/2026**

- Strong Canva skills (portfolio required)

- Comfortable with batch/repetitive production work, keeping variations organized and on-brand

- Detail-oriented: color consistency, correct text swaps across language versions, no leftover placeholder text

- Strong written English

- Reliable internet

- Organized: consistent file naming, uses Google Drive, communicates proactively if something is unclear or delayed

- Video editing skills for Reels/Shorts, Pinterest marketing experience, experience growing a brand-new Instagram or TikTok account, or interest in the planner/stationery content niche



# Pay & Process



- **Paid trial week:** I will hire 3 candidates for a one-week paid trial ($45 flat, paid regardless of outcome). Everyone gets the same task list and reference assets. One person gets the ongoing role.

- **Ongoing:** flat weekly rate of $65/week for approximately 8–10 hours of tasks, paid weekly via [Wise/PayPal/Payoneer].

- Long-term role, with the social media piece growing over time as we build that side of the business.



# How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **CANVAS** so I know you read this posting.

2. Tell me the date you could start the trial week, roughly how many hours per week you have open for this role, and whether you currently have other clients.

3. Link a Canva portfolio or 3–5 examples of design work (listing images, social graphics, mockups). Tell me in one line what YOU did on each.

4. Link 1–2 examples of Pinterest pins you've designed, if you have any. Bonus if you can also name the Pinterest profiles you've managed or created for.

5. Link 1–2 examples of short-form vertical content (Reels/TikToks) you've edited, if you have any. Not required, but a plus. Bonus if you can also name accounts you've managed or created content for.

6. Based on the three-step listing process above and the kind of content described, roughly how many of each do you think you could realistically complete in a typical week?

   - Listing page groups (up to 15 pages per product; see my Etsy shop for examples):

   - Pins:

   - Social media posts (photo or video):

7. In 2–3 sentences, tell me: how do you stay organized when producing lots of variations of the same design (different colors, different languages, etc.)?

8. Link one Instagram or TikTok account (any brand) whose content style you love, and tell me in one sentence why. Also tell me whether you'd be comfortable managing Instagram and/or TikTok accounts down the road.

9. What's your preferred way to get paid: Wise, PayPal, or Payoneer?



Applications that don't follow these steps will not be considered. If anything here needs clarification, feel free to ask before applying. Thanks, and I'm excited to meet you!

- Consultative Approach: Strong ability to influence stakeholders and lead through consensus and expertise.

*Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

*Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

*Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

*Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment.

What Sets Us Apart?

title: Medical Virtual Assistant, Care Coordinator & Billing Specialist
description:
Medical Virtual Assistant, Care Coordinator & Billing Specialist



MindRefined is a psychiatric and mental health practice based in Florida, USA. We use modern technology and evidence-based clinical models to provide high-quality telehealth care to patients managing ADHD, anxiety, depression, and other mental health conditions. We pride ourselves on operational excellence, smooth clinical workflows, and compassionate, timely patient care.



We are seeking a skilled, dedicated, and professional full-time Medical Virtual Assistant, Care Coordinator & Billing Specialist based in the Philippines to manage our patient communications, EHR scheduling, and medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) workflows.



Position Details

Role type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Shift: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (overnight in the Philippines)

Hourly rate: $4.00 to $6.00 USD, based on experience, qualifications, and billing expertise

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Primary systems: Tebra (formerly Kareo) EHR/PM, Dialpad (VoIP), Google Workspace

Primary Responsibilities

Call Handling, Triage & Scheduling

Live calls and triage: Answer inbound calls and make outbound calls using Dialpad. Triage clinical concerns and medication or refill requests, and route urgent messages to the psychiatric nurse practitioners (NPs).

Scheduling: Manage the live scheduling calendar in Tebra. Schedule new intakes, coordinate follow-up appointments, and proactively contact patients to resolve no-shows and scheduling conflicts.

Voi
s and texts: Monitor, transcribe, and action patient voi
s and inbound text messages daily, so that no patient outreach goes unanswered.

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

Claim review and audit: Monitor and audit claims in Tebra to ensure accurate processing and resolve outstanding balances.

Deductible and copay auditing: Run routine audits on patient deductibles and coinsurance to ensure accurate up-front collections and resolve underpayments.

Rejection and denial resolution: Read, interpret, and troubleshoot clearinghouse rejection and denial codes in Tebra, and systematically resolve billing errors.

Payment and ledger entry: Record patient payments (copays, cash-pay fees, deductibles) in Tebra and keep patient ledgers balanced.

Eligibility verification: Run electronic insurance eligibility checks, including mental health benefits, and verify active coverage before visits.

IT & Security Requirements (Strict HIPAA Compliance)



Because you will handle protected health information (PHI) and financial data, you must follow strict security protocols:



Work only within a secure, employer-provided virtual desktop (cloud computer) with printing and downloading disabled.

Have a private, quiet, and secure workspace. Public cafes and shared co-working spaces are not permitted.

Have a reliable fiber internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps download and upload), plus a backup power source (UPS or generator) or a backup mobile data connection.

Use a high-quality noise-canceling headset to maintain professional call standards on Dialpad.

Required Qualifications

Experience: At least 2 years as a medical virtual assistant and US medical biller or RCM specialist. Mental health or psychiatry experience is a strong plus.

Billing expertise: Solid understanding of US health insurance terminology, CPT and ICD-10 coding, electronic eligibility checks, clearinghouse processes, and 835 ERA denial codes.

Software skills: Proven hands-on experience with Tebra (Kareo) EHR and practice management systems.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written English, with a natural telephone presence and strong active listening skills.

Analytical skills: Strong math and logical reasoning to audit ledgers, resolve claim discrepancies, and explain insurance costs to patients.

Data security: Clear understanding of HIPAA guidelines, patient privacy, and data security standards.



Preferred, not required: Licensed Philippine Registered Nurse (PHRN) or allied health background.



What We Offer

Competitive compensation: Paid bi-weekly or monthly through secure international payment channels (e.g., Wise, Deel).

Stable, consistent hours: A fixed full-time schedule on US business hours, with no rotating shifts.

Collaborative team: Direct collaboration with psychiatric providers and practice management.

Career growth: Opportunities to lead advanced work in revenue cycle management or clinic operations.

How to Apply



Please submit:



Your updated resume.

A one-minute audio or video recording (via Vocaroo or Loom) introducing yourself, your medical billing and administrative experience, and why you are a good fit for a mental health practice.

Confirmation of whether you have used Tebra/Kareo (Yes/No).

title: LinkedIn Research & Appointment Setting Specialist
description:
Remote | Part-Time | US$5/hour + 7.5% Sales Commission

10–15 hours per month | Performance-driven opportunity



Are you exceptional at finding the right people, starting meaningful conversations and getting appointments booked?



We're looking for an experienced, proactive Appointment Setting Specialist who knows how to turn thoughtful research and personalised outreach into qualified, attended appointments.



This is not a generic lead generation role.



We don't need someone to build us a marketing strategy, generate hundreds of random leads or send mass-produced messages.



We already have the strategy, the ideal client profile, the outreach framework and the messaging.



What we need is someone with the energy, initiative, persistence and commercial drive to execute it exceptionally well.



About Woman Reimagined - Woman Reimagined is a premium identity recalibration programme for accomplished women over 40 who are navigating significant transitions in their lives, careers and sense of self.



Our clients are founders, executives, entrepreneurs, creatives and leaders. These are intelligent, discerning women who have achieved a great deal and are beginning to question what they want the next chapter of their lives to look like.



The programme investment is  US$11,111.



Our founder, Elle Nagy, conducts confidential research interviews with carefully selected women to better understand their experiences, challenges, desires and aspirations.



Your responsibility is to identify the right women and invite them into these conversations.



These are genuine research interviews, not disguised sales appointments. You will not be expected to sell or close the programme.



What You'll Be Doing



- Research LinkedIn and other relevant professional networks to identify women who fit our established prospect criteria.

- Look beyond job titles and superficial profile information to recognise credible signals of a potentially relevant life or identity transition.

- Use our approved outreach framework to initiate thoughtful, personalised conversations.

- Follow up consistently, professionally and respectfully.

- Invite suitable women to confidential research interviews with our founder.

- Coordinate bookings and confirmations to maximise attendance.

- Maintain an accurate, organised record of prospects, conversations, appointments and outcomes.

- Share useful observations about response patterns and opportunities to improve execution.



Experience engaging with professional women's networks, female-founder communities, women's leadership organisations and women-centred online spaces would be particularly valuable.



Any outreach within private communities must respect their membership requirements, rules and privacy expectations.



What Success Looks Like:



Your initial minimum performance target is 4–6 qualified, attended research interviews per month.



We're interested in appointments that actually happen, with women who genuinely match our criteria and understand why they've been invited.



Quality matters enormously.



We are not interested in filling a calendar with people who have little connection to the programme's intended audience.



You will be provided with clear prospect criteria, messaging guidance and an established outreach process. Your role is to turn those resources into consistent results.



Who We're Looking For



You must have:



- Proven experience booking appointments through LinkedIn outreach, direct messaging or similar relationship-based prospecting.

- Demonstrable results from previous appointment-setting work.

- Excellent written English and the ability to communicate naturally, confidently and professionally.

- Strong research skills and sound judgment about who is worth approaching.

- The ability to personalise messages without sounding scripted, intrusive or overly familiar.

- Consistent follow-through and resilience when prospects don't respond.

- Excellent organisation and attention to detail.

- The confidence to take initiative, solve everyday problems and keep momentum moving.

- A willingness to follow an established strategy rather than constantly reinvent it.



Most importantly, you must genuinely enjoy the commercial challenge of turning outreach into opportunities.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership, loves achieving targets and is motivated by the possibility of earning significantly more through successful results.



Compensation and Earning Potential:

Base compensation: US$5 per hour

Sales commission: 7.5% on attributable Woman Reimagined enrolment revenue received by the company.



At the current programme investment of US$11,111, one full-price enrolment would generate approximately US$833.33 in commission, assuming the full programme fee is collected and commissionable.



Commission is paid as the company receives the client's payments. Where a client pays in instalments, the corresponding commission is paid on eligible instalments received, according to the commission agreement.



There is no guarantee of enrolments or commission earnings.



This opportunity is best suited to someone who values the stability of a modest hourly base but is far more excited by the earning potential of successful performance.



If your primary priority is a substantial guaranteed hourly income, this is unlikely to be the right opportunity.



If you're commercially ambitious, confident in your appointment-setting abilities and excited by performance-based earnings, we'd love to hear from you.



Hours and Working Arrangement:

- Remote

- Approximately 10–15 hours per month initially

- Flexible scheduling, with agreed reporting and communication expectations

- Opportunity for the relationship to expand as the business grows and results justify it



How to Apply:



Please answer the following questions in your application. We value specific examples and real experience more than polished, generic answers.



1. Your results



Tell us about your most relevant appointment-setting role. Who were you targeting, which channels did you use, how many appointments did you book, and what proportion attended?



2. Your prospect judgment



Imagine you find a 49-year-old woman on LinkedIn who founded and sold a successful company eight months ago. She now describes herself as an investor and board adviser.



Would you consider her a potential research-interview candidate? What would you want to understand before approaching her?



3. Your outreach ability



You've identified a woman who appears to be an excellent fit for a confidential research interview. She doesn't know Elle Nagy.



Write a short first LinkedIn message inviting her to participate. Your message should be thoughtful, natural and genuinely compelling, without pitching a coaching programme.



4. Your commercial motivation



This role offers US$5/hour plus 7.5% commission on attributable programme enrolments. What appeals to you about this structure, and what have you done in previous roles to consistently achieve or exceed appointment targets?



Applications that don't answer all four questions will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who is ready to create momentum, build meaningful connections and be rewarded for the results they help produce.



If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

title: AI Quality & Evaluation Specialist
description:

, send alerts to officers, and escalate events for operational review.

- Experience working with US-based companies or teams is a plus.

- Experience as a Team Lead or Subject Matter Expert is a plus.

- Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT and a genuine interest in understanding how AI systems work and improve.

- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to assess information, identify errors, and distinguish correct outputs from incorrect or misleading ones.

title: AI UGC Video Editor + Ad Creative Designer (Direct Response)

We use Arcads for AI UGC generation, so you don't need to solve AI actor consistency. What we need is someone who can write scripts that perform in that format and turn the raw output into ads that convert.

What you'll do

Build modular creative — multiple hooks, bodies, and CTAs that recombine into variants

Iterate on winners based on performance data we send you weekly

Real experience editing short-form UGC-style ads. Portfolio required.

Strong hook writing — you can take one product and write ten different opening lines

CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects fluency: captions, jump cuts, pacing, sound

Direct Arcads experience (if not, you'll pick it up in a day — but tell us what you've used instead)

Familiarity with Meta ad policy and what gets creative rejected

What we offer



Long-term, stable work with a small team

title: Experienced Business Funding Specialist
description:
Job Title: Experienced Business Funding Specialist | U.S. Lending | Remote

Company: MAXCREDIT

Pay: $8–$10 USD/hour



Opportunity: Long-term position with potential to grow into full-time



About the Role

MAXCREDIT helps U.S. entrepreneurs and business owners improve their credit profiles and secure financing.

We're hiring an experienced Business Funding Specialist who already understands U.S. lending and can independently evaluate client profiles, recommend appropriate funding options, and manage applications from start to finish.

This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who understands how banks evaluate applicants, not someone who simply submits applications.



Responsibilities

- Review personal and business credit profiles to assess funding readiness.

- Identify suitable lenders based on credit, income, debt obligations, and business financials.

- Develop funding strategies involving business credit cards, personal loans, business lines of credit, and other financing products.

Requirements

DO NOT APPLY IF

- You are primarily a general virtual assistant.

How to Apply

title: Remote Sales Closer - You Sell Our Ad Service TO Car Detailers | Base + Commission
description:
ABOUT UNDER7AKE

Under7ake is a Meta ads agency that works only with car detailers. We run ads that bring local car owners to a detailer's shop, and we back it with a guarantee: 10 booked appointments in the first 30 days, or we work for free. Our main package is $997 per month. We are a growing team and we need someone to talk to detailers and bring them on as clients.

 

THE ROLE

Part-time | Remote | US Central Time (4pm-9pm)

You will run one-call discovery-and-close video calls with detailers who have applied through our ads. Our system books calls in your calendar for you and you have to attend every appointment on the calendar.

Your job:

- Run the call using our script and offer

- Confirm the detailer's city is open and that they are a fit

- Explain the package and the guarantee clearly and honestly

- Close the sale and get payment started

- Update every lead in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- During no call slots, you will help with lead follow-ups, or no-show follow-ups.

 

You are an independent contractor, not an employee. You are responsible for your own taxes and government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG).

We expect you to attend to every booked call, and to update the CRM after every call.

 

YOUR HOURS

Calls are booked around the detailer's day, and detailers are usually out on jobs at midday. So calls cluster in one window:

- Late afternoon and evening, after the detailer finishes: about 4pm to 9pm US Central.

We will track what works best in your first weeks and set a regular weekly schedule from that. Expect about 30 hours a week, in blocks of about 5 hours. Calls are booked ahead of time, so you will know your schedule at least 24 hours in advance. You must be able to take these windows.

 

WHAT YOU NEED

- Has experience working US Central time

- Clear, confident spoken English (A+)

- Real experience in customer sales closing video calls. Experience matters more than a title.

- Comfortable handling objections and saying no to a bad-fit client

- Reliable internet + Back-up internet, a quiet space, good computer and a good headset.

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM, Google Meet or Zoom, and overall good with technology.

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with selling for a SMMA, or Marketing Agency. (More Points)

- Knowledge of cars or detailing.

 

PAY

- Base: $300 per month for your first 60 days, then $250 per month

- Commission per close, paid after the client's first payment clears. Your total closes in the month set your rate, and that rate applies to ALL of your closes that month:

  1 to 4 closes in a month: $200 each

  5 to 8 closes in a month: $300 each

  9 or more closes in a month: $350 each



  Example: 9 closes = 9 x $350 = $3,150 in commission.



- Discretionary December bonus after 3 or more months

- Paid monthly through Wise. We cover the transfer fee.

Commission is reversed if the client refunds within 30 days of their first payment.



EXPECTATION:

A good candidate should be able to close AT LEAST 4 sales per month. Which would earn you $1,050/mo

An overperfomring candidate should be closing 9+ sales per month. Which would earn you $3,400/mo



GROWTH

Top performers can move up to a higher commission tier or a team lead role as we add closers.

 

HOW THE TRIAL WORKS

You start with a paid 30-day trial and a clear target we agree on in writing before you begin. We train you on the offer, the script and the CRM.

 

HOW TO APPLY

Send all of these with your application:

1. A 60-second video introducing yourself, in English and talk about your experience in remote closing sales video calls

2. Your Resume in pdf

3. If you've read the job description to this point, title your application message: "REMOTE".

 

We reply to every application that complies with all 3 application tasks above.

title: Professional Video Editor – Advanced Manual Editing Skills Required
description:
About Us and the Role



Ice Cream Sunshine is a good vibes signature ice cream tour and special events company based in

Chicago. Good vibes, excellence, and fun are the core of who we are, and that extends to every person on

our team.



Ice Cream Sunshine is building a team of professional video editors who genuinely love the craft and bring

highly skilled hands on editing to every project. We are not looking for one person to carry the whole

workload as we produce 14 to 21 shorts / reels per week. We are building a bench of skilled, reliable editors

who collaborate well, communicate clearly, and keep our production moving to serve our audience. If you

are the kind of editor who notices the tiny details, are focused on the best storytelling through detailed

advanced editing techniques then we want to meet you.



You love to learn and you love to have fun. That is the kind of person who thrives on our team.



Good Vibes Only Company



We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation, and fun as a company culture. We perform with

excellence and have a good time along the way.







CANDIDATES WHO HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

Complete a full application.  Details are found in the HOW TO APPLY section.







What You Will Do



● Edit short form videos (shorts and reels) as well as longer form content, following a Creative Brief that

varies from project to project.

● Deliver polished, professional cuts with smooth pacing, clean audio, and strong storytelling that brings

joy and information to our audience.

● Work through a structured, multi round feedback and revision process to protect quality on every final

master file.

● Collaborate closely with our Associate Producer and fellow editors to hit a production schedule of 14

to 21 videos per week.

● Bring genuine fun and expertise to every cut.



What We Need From You



● 5+ years of professional video editing experience with real clients, using Final Cut Pro, Adobe

software, or other professional editing software. This means paid, professional work, not self taught or

personal editing. CapCut and Canva do not count as professional editing tools.

● Real availability overlapping 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Chicago time, plus attendance at our Tuesday team

meeting from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM Chicago time.

● A sharp eye for detail, strong storytelling instincts, and the ability to take direction from a Creative Brief

and run with it.

● A collaborative, good vibes attitude. We are a team, and we look out for each other.



Important



During our first round interview we require a live editing demo to validate editing skills are in alignment with

your portfolio using manual cuts (no AI). You must be comfortable with this skills assessment to be

considered for our team. We will evaluate shot sequence and storytelling techniques based on source

footage we provide for a simple short/reel that only has the purpose of the demonstration itself.



In Your Cover Letter, Tell Us About Your Expertise In



Video Editing: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro

Motion Graphics: / VFX Adobe After Effects

Audio: Adobe Audition

Photo / Graphics: Adobe Photoshop

Other: Tell us what else you bring to the table.



REQUIRED with your Cover Letter: Share a link to a 60 to 90 second simple video where you talk about your favorite ice cream and what you love about being a video editor.



Pay and Growth



● $5 to $8 per hour to start, plus bonuses. Some bonuses are guaranteed and some are performance

based.

● A paid test project ($15 flat fee) with a 24 hour turnaround, guided by several quality checkpoints

along the way.

● Based on business needs, the following opportunities may also become available: rate increases over

time, more hours or full time work, and growth into a lead or senior editor role.



Our Hiring Process



● Apply with your resume, portfolio, and cover letter.

● Qualified candidates receive a short survey to help us understand your skills and style.

● Our first round interview includes a live editing component so we can confirm your advanced skills

together, in real time.

● We verify past work and check references as part of our process, because we want every hire to be

the real deal.



Everyone at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always and delicious ice cream too. 🍦

title: Applied AI Engineer – 3D Automation & Rendering
description:
JOB TITLE

Applied AI Engineer – 3D Automation & Rendering (Mac Required)



ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a talented AI Engineer who is passionate about artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging technologies.



Our goal is to use AI to dramatically simplify and automate the process of creating 3D models and realistic renderings from architectural floorplans and CAD files.



We work in the manufactured housing industry and have thousands of home designs that need to be converted into accurate 3D models with customizable materials, finishes, and options.



Today, much of this work is done manually. We want to change that.



IMPORTANT: We are NOT looking for a traditional CAD designer, 3D artist, or rendering specialist. We want a strong technical developer who can use AI, programming, and automation to eliminate as much manual work as possible.



This is an opportunity for someone who wants to become an expert in AI-powered 3D modeling and rendering while helping build something innovative.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research and experiment with the latest AI tools for 3D modeling and rendering.

- Build automated systems that convert architectural plans and CAD files into accurate 3D models.

- Develop Python scripts, APIs, and automated workflows.

- Integrate AI models, computer vision, and open-source technologies.

- Use AI and procedural modeling to automate 3D geometry creation.

- Automate materials, textures, colors, and finishes.

- Develop systems for automatically generating realistic interior and exterior renderings.

- Automate configurable home options such as flooring, cabinets, countertops, appliances, siding, roofing, doors, and windows.

- Create automated processes for generating organized layers and assets for our interactive Product Builder.

- Build quality-control systems to identify errors and maintain consistency.

- Continuously test new technologies to make the entire process faster, easier, and more scalable.



REQUIRED SKILLS

- Strong Python programming and software development skills.

- Hands-on experience using AI models, AI APIs, and automation tools.

- Experience with generative AI, computer vision, or multimodal AI.

- Experience building automated workflows and connecting different software systems.

- Ability to research, evaluate, and implement new AI technologies.

- Experience using AI-assisted coding tools.

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

- Ability to work independently and build solutions from scratch.

- Comfortable using Git, Terminal, and developer tools on macOS.



MAC REQUIREMENT

- Must own and use a Mac as your primary development computer.

- Must be comfortable working in a macOS development environment.

- Must be able to install, configure, and troubleshoot Python, AI development tools, Blender, and related software.

- Applicants using only Windows or Linux computers will not be considered.



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)

- Blender Python API

- AI-powered 3D generation

- Procedural modeling

- CAD, AutoCAD, Revit, or BIM

- 3D rendering automation

- GPU computing

- Image-to-3D or floorplan-to-3D technologies

- AI model integration and deployment



You do NOT need to be a professional 3D artist or CAD designer. We care much more about your programming abilities, AI knowledge, and ability to automate complicated processes.



WHAT WE ARE TRYING TO BUILD

Our current workflow:



CAD / Plans → 3D Home → Materials & Options → Renderings & Layered Assets → Product Builder



Our goal is to automate as much of this workflow as technically possible.



Ideally, we want to take an architectural floorplan or CAD file and automatically:

1. Interpret the architectural drawings.

2. Generate accurate 3D home geometry.

3. Apply materials, colors, and finishes.

4. Create configurable interior and exterior options.

5. Produce consistent, realistic renderings.

6. Generate organized layers and production-ready assets.

7. Export everything needed for our interactive Product Builder.



We understand that AI cannot perfectly automate every step today.



Your job is to research what's possible, experiment with different technologies, build prototypes, and create a production system that continually reduces the amount of manual work required. We are open to completely new approaches if they produce better results.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who loves technology and figuring things out.



Someone who:

- Is genuinely excited about AI and follows emerging technologies.

- Enjoys experimenting with new tools and approaches.

- Has strong programming and technical problem-solving skills.

- Thinks about how to automate a task instead of doing it manually.

- Can take a challenging problem and independently research possible solutions.

- Is comfortable building prototypes, testing ideas, and learning from failures.

- Wants to become an expert in AI-powered 3D modeling and rendering.

- Is interested in building technology that could eventually scale across thousands of homes.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- We are not measuring success by how many 3D models you personally create.

- We are measuring success by how much of the modeling and rendering process you can automate.

- We want to build a repeatable system that makes each new home faster and easier to produce than the last.

- Our long-term goal is to create a highly automated production pipeline capable of generating thousands of accurate, configurable 3D homes with minimal manual involvement.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer the following questions when applying:



1. What AI-powered tools, applications, or automation systems have you personally built? Please provide examples or links.



2. What experience do you have with Python, AI models, APIs, and AI-assisted coding tools?



3. If we gave you 1,000 architectural floorplans and asked you to automate the creation of accurate 3D homes and realistic renderings, how would you approach the problem?



4. What AI tools or technologies would you investigate first for automating 3D modeling and rendering?



5. What Mac do you currently use? Please include the model, chip (M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 or Intel), and RAM.



- We are not looking for someone to manually create 3D models.

- We are looking for someone who can use AI and technology to make the entire process dramatically easier.

- If you're a talented developer who loves AI, automation, and solving challenging technical problems, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a long-term position, not a project.



What you will own



1. Escalations – the core of this job



Every ticket our agents escalate comes to you: angry customers, refund demands, "refund me or I'm calling my bank."

You close those cases before they become disputes: resolve, replace, refund or de-escalate.

You d
 quickly when to give in and when to hold firm.

You set the rules for what agents handle themselves and what gets escalated.



2. Leading the CS team:



You lead our customer service team.

You coach them so fewer tickets reach you in the first place.

You write the SOPs and macros so the team works the same way every time.

As we add stores, you grow and shape the team.

You flag recurring issues with products, suppliers or ads that cause complaints, so we can fix them at the source.

You help d
 refund policies, return rules and how we handle customers.

Experience with submitting disputes in Shopify Payments or PayPal is a plus, but not required.



6. Reporting:



Monthly report per store: escalations handled, refund rate, response times and dispute ratio.

Plus your analysis: what is causing the problems and what we should fix.



How we work:



All communication with the founders and the team runs through Slack.

Reporting, order tracking and supplier follow-up are done in Google Sheets and Excel.



Requirements – please don't apply if you can't tick these:



You have worked as an Operations Manager, Backend Manager, Support Manager or Team Lead at an e-commerce company. Not as an agent. We will ask for the company name, team size and a reference from your manager.

You have managed a team and been responsible for their output, not just your own.

Experience with high-volume stores running paid ads.

Comfortable working in Slack, Google Sheets and Excel.

Excellent written English. You will be writing to angry customers every day.

Flexible availability, including for urgent escalations.



Nice to have:



Experience handling chargebacks and disputes in Shopify Payments or PayPal.

Experience in fashion e-commerce.



What we offer:



A long-term, stable position with room to grow as we add stores.

You lead the CS team and work directly with the founders.

Full ownership: you d
 how this function is run.

Briefly tell us:



Your most recent management role and team size.

Which helpdesk tools you have used.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

• We're closed on major US holidays, and at the completion of the first 3 months of employment, you'll qualify for paid holidays.

• Work hours are Mon-Fri at 8 am till 5:30 pm (UTC-07:00 , MST, Arizona time zone)

• Every 4 to 5 weeks, you'll be working 1/2 day on a Saturday (project work/catch-up work) and get 1/2 day off the week after

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

• REQUIRED: Microsoft Azure AD/ M365 experience

Other tools we use:

 platforms

 and Instagram) and reading campaign results

Your Work Setup

-A secure computer. You will use a VPN, follow our data security practices, and sign a confidentiality agreement before accessing client information

Details

title: YouTube Content Specialist
description:
Skills to Change Institute · Work from home · Results-based hours



Who I am, and what this is

I’m Robert Gene, founder of the Skills to Change Institute and creator of eutaptics® and FasterEFT™ methods. For more than thirty years, I have used this method to help people address a wide range of long-standing problems, including addictions, relationship difficulties, emotional distress, pain, sleep problems, food and chemical intolerances, money-related patterns, limiting beliefs, and a lot more.



About the Role

I am looking for an experienced YouTube Content Specialist to help transform an established YouTube channel with 2,600+ existing videos into a well-structured, optimized platform that reaches new audiences and generates new customers. The channel focuses on the personal transformation methods eutaptics® and FasterEFT™ and contains a large library of educational and training content.

I'm looking for someone who understands YouTube growth, analytics, content optimization, and video repurposing.



What You'll Do

- Learn the Method: Complete paid training and selected Skills to Change courses to understand the method, terminology, audience, and my communication style.

- Weekly Content Production: Use Robert’s ongoing live calls and Q&As as source material to create 1 strong long-form YouTube video per week from a selected question-and-answer segment, and repurpose it into 2–3 engaging YouTube Shorts 

- Audit & Strategy: Analyze the channel and YouTube Analytics to identify what works, uncover high-potential content, and prioritize which videos to optimize first.

- Optimize Existing Content: Improve titles, descriptions, thumbnails, chapters, playlists, end screens, internal linking, and calls to action based on search intent and performance data.

- Create Shorts & Reels: Find strong hooks and moments within existing long-form videos and turn them into engaging short-form content, ideally using OpusClip. Content may also be repurposed for Instagram,
, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Visual Design: Create effective YouTube thumbnails and simple on-brand graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Track & Improve: Monitor CTR, retention, watch time, search performance, traffic sources, and subscriber growth, and continuously improve the strategy based on results.

Dental Concepts & Orthodontics, a boutique dental practice in Irving, Texas, is seeking an experienced virtual dental accounts receivable specialist with excellent spoken English.



**Your primary responsibility will be to reduce outstanding patient and insurance accounts receivable through consistent follow-up, accurate account review and successful collections.**



We are looking for someone who is comfortable discussing balances with patients, explaining billing clearly and following through until an account or claim is resolved.



**Responsibilities**



- Call patients about outstanding balances and collect payments through our approved payment process.

- Arrange payment plans within office guidelines and follow up on promised payments.

- Review patient and insurance aging reports, prioritizing overdue and high-balance accounts.

- Review patient ledgers and explanations of benefits to identify billing discrepancies before requesting payment.

- Document every call, account update, payment commitment and next follow-up date in Open Dental.

- Communicate unresolved issues to the office lead and recommend next steps.

- Maintain daily activity records and provide weekly reports showing collections, resolved claims and remaining outstanding balances.

- Protect patient information and follow office confidentiality and security procedures.



**Required Qualifications**



- Previous experience supporting a U.S. dental practice in billing, accounts receivable, insurance claims or patient collections.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with clear articulation, strong listening skills and a professional telephone manner.

- Confidence making outbound calls and discussing financial matters with patients.

- Understanding of dental insurance claims, EOBs, patient responsibility and A/R aging reports.

- Strong organization, accuracy and consistent follow-through.

- Reliable internet, a computer, a quality headset and a quiet, private workspace.

- Availability during agreed U.S. Central Time working hours.



**Preferred Qualifications**



- Experience with Open Dental.

- Proven success reducing overdue dental accounts receivable.

- Experience resolving denied claims and following up with U.S. dental insurance carriers.

- Spanish fluency in addition to excellent English.



**How Success Will Be Measured**



Success means collecting outstanding balances, resolving unpaid insurance claims and reducing aged A/R. We will review dollars collected, accounts and claims resolved, follow-up completion and documentation accuracy. Account adjustments or write-offs require management approval.



**To Apply**



Please apply through this platform and include:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your U.S. dental billing and collections experience.

2. The dental software and insurance portals you have used.

3. Your country, time zone, availability and expected hourly or monthly rate.

4. A 60–90 second voice recording in English introducing yourself and explaining how you would professionally approach a patient about an overdue balance.

5. A brief example of how you helped collect an overdue balance or resolve an unpaid insurance claim. Do not include patient names or identifying information.



Selected candidates will complete a video interview and a short role-play using a fictional patient balance and insurance claim.



**We are seeking a dependable professional who takes ownership of follow-up and helps turn outstanding balances into collected revenue.**

s and DMs to target creators using established Rude Cosmetics campaign templates.

Requirements & Qualifications

> Beauty & Trend Knowledge: Strong understanding of current cosmetics trends, viral social media beauty challenges, and beauty influencer culture.



> Workstation Setup: High-speed internet, reliable computer, and a setup capable of running continuous Google Meet video calls with screen sharing smoothly throughout the shift.



> Work Schedule: Must be available 7:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST (Los Angeles Time) consistently Monday through Friday.



> Communication: Flawless written English with a friendly, trendy, and persuasive communication style tailored for beauty creators.



> Experience: 1+ years in influencer outreach, virtual assistance, or PR in the beauty, fashion, or lifestyle sectors.



Perks

> Direct Collaboration: Work directly with an established Los Angeles cosmetics brand.

> Growth: Potential for increased hours and leadership roles as our outreach program scales.







How to Apply

To apply, please answer these exact points in your message:



1. Beauty Trend Check: Name 2 current makeup trends or product categories that are viral on TikTok right now.



2. Current Desk & Makeup Check: Look at your desk right now—what is the exact local time in your city, what drink is sitting on your desk, and what are 3 items currently inside your personal makeup bag?

4. Shift Confirmation: Confirm your setup can handle a continuous 5-hour Google Meet call with live screen sharing during 7:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST.



5. Rate Acceptance: Confirm your agreement to the $4.00 – $5.00 USD/hour rate.



6. Link to your resume/portfolio.



Please write “Rude Beauty Specialist – [Your First Name]” at the top of your message.
