title: Expert Bookkeeper
description:
NOW HIRING: Virtual Bookkeeper & Financial Operations Assistant

Remote | Part-Time | Flexible Hours



ABOUT US

Queen Clean is a growing residential and commercial cleaning company based in Montana, USA. We're looking for a detail-oriented, financially savvy virtual assistant with strong bookkeeping and QuickBooks experience to help us organize our finances, improve reporting, and identify opportunities to operate more efficiently.



We're looking for someone who can do more than basic data entry. We want a proactive, analytical person who can help us understand our numbers, improve financial processes, and make smarter business decisions.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Bookkeeping & QuickBooks Management

- Clean up, organize, categorize, and reconcile transactions in QuickBooks Online.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial records.

- Review expenses and ensure accurate financial reporting.

- Identify and correct bookkeeping discrepancies.

- Help establish organized and efficient bookkeeping systems.



Payroll & Labor Cost Analysis

- Assist with payroll administration, payroll reconciliation, and labor cost tracking.

- Calculate employee burden rates, including wages, payroll taxes, workers' compensation, benefits, and other employment costs.

- Analyze billable versus non-billable employee hours.

- Help determine the true hourly cost of employees and overall labor expenses.



Financial Analysis & Business Efficiency

- Analyze overhead, operating expenses, and business profitability.

- Identify unnecessary expenses and opportunities to reduce costs.

- Help evaluate pricing, profit margins, and the profitability of different services.

- Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and financial planning.

- Create simple financial reports, spreadsheets, and dashboards to monitor key business metrics.

- Provide recommendations for improving financial efficiency and profitability.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

- Strong experience with QuickBooks Online and bookkeeping reconciliation.

- Proficient in Excel and/or Google Sheets.

- Experience with payroll and labor cost analysis.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Comfortable interpreting financial reports and explaining numbers in simple, understandable terms.

- Able to identify financial discrepancies and recommend improvements.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and trustworthy.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently.

- Experience working with small businesses, service companies, or cleaning businesses is a plus.

- Experience with financial reporting, budgeting, or profitability analysis is highly desirable.



WORK SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

This is a remote, part-time position with flexible hours. Much of the work can be completed independently and on your own schedule, provided deadlines are met and communication is consistent.



However, we are looking for someone who can offer some availability during our regular business hours of 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (Montana, USA).



We would like to schedule weekly or monthly meetings, depending on business needs, to review our financials, discuss progress, address questions, and ensure our bookkeeping and financial goals are on track.



You do not need to work the entire 9–5 schedule, but you must be available for occasional meetings and real-time collaboration during those hours.



We're looking for someone who is self-motivated, works well independently, communicates proactively, and is comfortable collaborating directly with the business owner.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We don't just want someone to enter transactions. We're looking for someone who can help us understand our numbers, determine what our employees truly cost us, identify where money is being spent, and find opportunities to make the business more financially efficient.



This position will initially focus on QuickBooks cleanup and financial organization, with the potential for ongoing bookkeeping, payroll support, and financial analysis.



We value accuracy, initiative, clear communication, and someone who takes pride in helping a small business succeed.



HOW TO APPLY

If you're interested in this position, please complete our application form:







In your application message, please include:

1. Your experience with QuickBooks Online, bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation.

2. Any experience with payroll, employee burden rates, or financial analysis.

3. Examples of how you've helped a business improve financial organization, reduce expenses, or increase profitability.

4. Your time zone, typical working hours, and availability for meetings during Montana business hours.

5. Your desired hourly rate.



IMPORTANT: Please include the keyword QUEEN in your application message. This helps us identify applicants who have carefully read the job description and followed the instructions.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you!



Queen Clean | Montana, USA

title: Web Research & Data Entry Specialist – Excel/CSV Data Collection
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Web Research & Data Entry Specialist to collect specific information from designated websites and accurately enter that information into Excel/CSV files that we provide.

This is a structured data-entry project. You will be given the source website(s), spreadsheets/templates, and instructions explaining which information belongs in each field, column, and file.

Your main responsibility is to carefully review the source information, copy the required data, and place it into the correct location in the provided spreadsheet without changing the existing structure or formatting.

Accuracy and consistency are extremely important.



Responsibilities

- Visit the websites and pages provided.

- Locate the specific information requested.

- Copy and record the information accurately.

- Enter data into the correct Excel or CSV columns and files according to the provided instructions.

- Follow the existing spreadsheet structure, categories, naming conventions, and formatting exactly.

- Make sure information is entered into the appropriate field rather than simply copying everything into one location.

- Avoid duplicate entries.

- Check spelling, numbers, dates, names, and other details for accuracy.

- Identify information that is unavailable or unclear rather than guessing.

- Keep track of completed records.

- Review your own work before submission.

- Correct mistakes when they are identified.

- Maintain consistency across large numbers of records.



Example of the Work

You may be given a website containing multiple pieces of information about an item and an Excel file containing columns such as:

Title | Year | Category | Description | Keywords | Rating | URL | Other Data

You will review the website, identify the relevant information, and place each piece of data into the correct corresponding column.



Some information may also need to be placed into different Excel/CSV files based on categories that will be clearly marked in the instructions.



Requirements

We are looking for someone who:

- Has excellent attention to detail.

- Is comfortable working with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or CSV files.

- Can follow detailed written instructions precisely.

- Has experience with web research or data entry.

- Can work with repetitive tasks while maintaining accuracy.

- Has good English reading comprehension.

- Can recognize when information does not match the required category.

- Does not guess or invent information when data cannot be found.

- Can work independently and meet agreed deadlines.



Experience with large spreadsheets, data categorization, database entry, or web research is a plus.

Most Important Requirement

Accuracy is more important than speed.

We would rather receive fewer records completed correctly than a large number of records with incorrect information or information placed in the wrong columns.

The spreadsheet structure and categorization instructions must be followed exactly.



Quality Control

Completed work will be checked for:

- Accuracy against the source website.

- Correct placement of data.

- Missing information.

- Duplicate records.

- Formatting consistency.

- Incorrect categorization.

- Invented or assumed information.



Consistently accurate workers may be offered additional ongoing work, as this project may involve a substantial amount of data.

When Applying

Please include:

- Your previous data-entry or web-research experience.

- Your experience with Excel/CSV files.

- Approximately how many hours per week you are available.

- Whether you are comfortable following detailed categorization instructions.

- A brief explanation of how you check your work for accuracy.

Shortlisted applicants may be given a small paid sample task before being assigned a larger batch.

title: Application Specialist
description:
Position Overview: 



The Application Specialist is responsible for testing, troubleshooting, and updating the internal apps, automations, and workflows Power Plus Systems develops, making sure each one is reliable, easy to use, and ready for rollout. This role works closely with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist, partners with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and collaborates with Admin Operations, Scheduling, Finance, Estimating, and Field teams to find issues before team members do and turn feedback into improvements. The ideal candidate has a software development background, hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools, a working knowledge of webhooks and integrations, and a strong eye for user interface and user experience design. 



Pay Range: $8 per hour based on experience with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents. 





About Power Plus Systems: 



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission. 





Objectives: 



- Test company apps, automations, and workflows before rollout to confirm they work as intended across devices, browsers, and real-world scenarios.

- Perform manual testing and support automated testing to catch bugs, broken logic, and edge cases early. 

- Troubleshoot issues reported by team members, identify the root cause, and coordinate fixes with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist. 

- Test and monitor webhooks and integrations between systems such as GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, Jotform, and other company platforms to ensure data passes correctly. 

- Review apps from the user's point of view and recommend and implement UI and UX improvements that make tools easier, faster, and clearer for team members. 

- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up test case creation, debugging, documentation, and app updates. 

- Apply approved updates and improvements to existing apps and workflows, then retest to confirm nothing else broke. 

- Work with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and maintain test checklists and release notes so every rollout is consistent and repeatable. 





Competencies: 



- Solid understanding of software development concepts, including front-end and back-end logic, APIs, and how data moves between systems. 

- Hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to verify AI output before relying on it. 

- Working knowledge of webhooks, including how to read payloads, interpret response codes, and troubleshoot failed connections. 

- Familiarity with manual and automated testing methods, test cases, and regression testing for apps and workflows. 

- Strong eye for design with a clear understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles. 

- Analytical, detail-oriented approach to finding root causes rather than surface-level fixes. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical team members. 

- Ability to manage multiple testing and update projects at once while meeting rollout deadlines. 

- Comfort using browser developer tools and automation platforms such as Make or Zapier is a plus. 

- Construction, electrical, or trade-industry experience is a plus. 





Education and Experience: 



- Background in software development through a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 

- At least 2 years of experience in software development, QA testing, application support, or a related role. 

- Experience testing web apps, mobile apps, or automated workflows before release. 

- Experience working with webhooks, APIs, or system integrations. 

- Proven experience using Claude or other AI tools in a professional setting. 

- Experience with UI/UX design, design reviews, or tools such as Figma is a plus. 

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Make,

title: Medical Office Assistant / Practice Coordinator
description:
This job is for a telemedicine practice based in the US. We blend conventional, integrative, and functional medicine to treat hormone and thyroid conditions, autoimmune disease, gut health, weight loss (including GLP-1 therapy), fertility preparation, and more. We serve patients in three states.  We're a cash-pay practice ( no insurance accepted ) with a small, close-knit patient base, and we care a lot about patients feeling looked after.



About the role

This is not a "wait to be told what to do" job.  The practitioner sees patients about 15 hours a week. During those hours you keep the day running smoothly. The rest of your time goes to the back end: following up, cleaning up, and making our systems simpler and faster. You'll work with significant independence and little day-to-day oversight. The owner will rely on you heavily. The right person treats the practice like their own: they spot problems, find solutions, follow through, and leave no task open-ended. We’re looking for someone to grow with our practice for years, not months. This is a long-term, stable position for the right person. If you’re looking for a short-term gig, this isn’t the right fit.



What you'll do

Patient communication

• Answer calls, texts,
s, and portal messages warmly and professionally, always identifying yourself and the practice

• Schedule new and follow-up visits across time zones (schedule runs on Central Time)

• Send same-day appointment reminders and handle cancellations and reschedules according to our policy

• Answer clerical patient questions (lab status, billing, supplements, test kits) and route clinical questions to Rachel



Billing and payments

• Collect payment for visits and cash-pay labs and verify cards on file

• Follow up on declined cards and outstanding balances until resolved

• Reconcile the monthly lab bill against patient payments and catch billing errors



Labs, orders, and coordination

• Enter lab orders (Labcorp, Quest) and specialty tests 

• Prepare and fax imaging orders and referral letters

• Complete prior authorizations using chart notes (CoverMyMeds) - this is not frequent

• Manage incoming faxes: file results, prior auths, records requests, and refill requests, and route them correctly

• Handle medical records requests and releases of information, following each through to completion

• Communicate with pharmacies, other providers' offices, imaging centers, labs, and company representatives



Back-end and operations

• Keep every follow-up task closed out with a clear outcome

• Manage the practice inbox and keep shared documents organized and up to date

• Prepare monthly social media and
 content using provided templates and Canva ( eventually)

• Improve our workflows. Identify bottlenecks, suggest fixes, update our procedures guide, and reduce repeated work



Who you are

• Self-starter. When there's downtime, you find the next most valuable thing to do.

• Problem solver. You come with "here's what I found and what I recommend," not just "what should I do?"

• Loop closer. You follow up until things are resolved. Nothing falls through the cracks.

• Clear, personal communicator. Patients get concise, accurate, human replies, not long generic ones.

• Detail-oriented with money and medical information. You double-check orders, codes, and charges.

• Discreet and trustworthy. You handle protected health and payment information with care.



Requirements

• 2+ years in a medical office, medical virtual assistant, or healthcare admin role

• Experience with EHR systems, prior authorizations, and lab ordering

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a computer suitable for HIPAA-compliant work

• Availability during core patient hours: Monday - Friday 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM Central Standard Time

• Ability to learn new software quickly



Nice to have: experience with, RingCentral, CoverMyMeds, Fullscript, Google Workspace, Canva; functional or integrative medicine background; medical billing/coding knowledge (CPT, ICD-10).



I am very interested in finding someone to work with me long term. When you apply tell me - Where do you see yourself in two years, and what would make you stay with one employer long-term?

title: Social Media Video Editor & Content Researcher
description:
Social Media Video Editor & Content Researcher



Brand: Après-Ski Daily

Platforms: Instagram, TikTok &

Position: Part-Time ± 10 hours

Schedule: Flexible hours, as long as weekly deadlines are met



About Après-Ski Daily

Après-Ski Daily is an Alpine lifestyle and après-ski brand focused on the party scene across the European Alps.

We have built a community of 115,000+ followers across Instagram, 
 and
, generating 50 million views during the last winter season.

We are looking for a highly independent and creative video editor who understands the energy of après-ski, electronic music, festivals and party culture.

This is not a traditional editing role where someone simply receives footage and cuts it together. We are looking for someone who can independently find content, identify great moments and trends, and turn them into engaging short-form videos.

We do not have our own video footage at the moment, so you will be responsible for sourcing content and developing videos from start to finish.



Your Responsibilities

1. Content Research & Sourcing

• Independently find and collect suitable après-ski, skiing, snowboarding, festival and party footage from the European Alps (from posted content by existing venues across the Alps).

• Identify the best clips, moments and angles to create engaging videos.

• Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of suitable content without needing us to provide footage or ideas.



2. Video Editing

• Independently create 7 short-form videos per week for Instagram Reels, 
 and
 Reels.

• Edit high-energy videos focused on après-ski, parties, DJs, electronic music and Alpine nightlife.

• Use strong hooks, fast pacing, well-timed cuts, music synchronization and engaging storytelling.

• Add text overlays, captions and other editing elements where appropriate.

• Understand what makes party videos exciting, immersive and shareable.

• Maintain a consistent style that fits the Après-Ski Daily brand.



3. Publishing & Scheduling

• Submit completed videos for our review and implement feedback or requested changes.

• Schedule approved posts through Metricool.



4. Performance & Improvement

• Monitor video performance and identify which styles, hooks and formats work best.

• Use these insights to continuously improve the content.



What We Are Looking For

• Strong affinity with party video editing, especially après-ski, festivals, nightlife, DJ sets and electronic music.

• Experience editing short-form content for Instagram, 
 and
.

• A good understanding of viral video formats, hooks, pacing and audience retention.

• The ability to independently source suitable footage and turn it into complete videos.

• A creative eye for selecting exciting moments and combining clips into engaging edits.

• You do not need daily instructions to get things done.

• Reliable communication, organization and respect for deadlines.

• Good written English.



Working Hours & Compensation

• Approximately ± 10 hours per week.

• Flexible working hours. You can organize your own schedule as long as all deliverables and deadlines are met.

• Long-term opportunity for the right person, with the potential to grow alongside the brand.

We value independence, creativity and consistent quality more than simply spending a certain number of hours online.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience.

2. Links to your portfolio, especially party, festival, nightlife or high-energy short-form edits.

3. Examples of videos you have edited that performed well, if available.

4. A short explanation of how you would independently source enough suitable footage to create 7 videos per week without receiving raw footage from us.

5. Your expected monthly salary for approximately 20–25 hours per week.

Also have a look at our pages:

title: Healthcare Provider Outreach & Business Development Virtual Assistant
description:
Healthcare Provider Outreach & Business Development Virtual Assistant

Specialty Pharmacy / IVIG / Home Infusion



We are seeking a highly organized, confident, and results-driven Healthcare Provider Outreach & Business Development Virtual Assistant to help grow an established specialty pharmacy. 



We are looking for someone who can help build and manage a complete provider-acquisition system—from researching potential referral partners and identifying decision-makers to conducting outreach, following up consistently, scheduling meetings, and tracking opportunities through our sales pipeline.



The goal of this position is to help increase the number of active physician practices, hospitals, discharge planners, case managers, and healthcare organizations that work with our pharmacy.



What You Will Be Responsible For:



*Provider & Hospital Lead Generation

*Research and build targeted prospect lists. 

*You will identify the correct contacts within each organization. 



Outbound Provider Outreach:



You must be comfortable making professional outbound calls to medical offices.

Your objective will NOT simply be to ask:

“Can you send us patients?”



Instead, you will learn how to introduce our pharmacy professionally, understand the practice’s needs, identify who manages specialty pharmacy or infusion referrals, and begin building the relationship.



Outreach may include:

*Cold calling medical offices


 outreach & follow up

*Scheduling meetings for our pharmacist, owner, or business-development representative



CRM & Sales Pipeline Management

You will maintain an organized CRM containing:



Provider Marketing



You will also assist with creating and managing provider marketing campaigns, including:

*Educational
 campaigns

* Provider newsletters

* Webinar invitations

* Referral-resource distribution

* Provider follow-up sequences

* Existing-provider reactivation campaigns



Insurance & Network Research:



You will organize opportunities for pharmacy leadership to review and pursue.



Healthcare Compliance:



Because this is healthcare marketing, compliance is extremely important.



You must understand that healthcare referral marketing is different from ordinary sales.



Our strategy is based on providing exceptional service, education, responsiveness, administrative support, and patient care. 

You will be expected to follow approved scripts, marketing materials, and company policies.



What Success Looks Like:



We are not looking for someone who simply says:

“I made 100 calls today.”

We care about RESULTS.



Your performance will be measured using metrics including:



* Qualified medical practices identified

* Decision-makers reached

* Referral coordinators identified

* Provider information packets sent

* Follow-ups completed

* Qualified opportunities created

* Meetings scheduled

* New referral sources

* First referrals received

* Active referring accounts

* Reactivated accounts

* Repeat referral sources



Our ultimate goal is:



More qualified healthcare organizations consistently referring appropriate patients to our pharmacy.



Ideal Candidate:



We would strongly prefer someone with experience in one or more of the following:



* Healthcare virtual assistance

* Medical sales

* B2B lead generation

* Specialty pharmacy

* Home infusion

* Medical billing

* Insurance verification

* Prior authorization

* Physician-office outreach

* Healthcare business development

* Pharmaceutical sales support

* Medical-office administration

* Hospital outreach



Experience specifically with IVIG, specialty pharmacy, infusion therapy, biologics, physician referrals, prior authorizations, or healthcare insurance is a major advantage.



You Should Be:

* Extremely organized

* Confident on the phone

* Persistent without being aggressive

* Comfortable speaking with gatekeepers

* Excellent at follow-up

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable maintaining a CRM

* Results-driven

* Comfortable working with KPIs

* Able to communicate professionally in English

* Able to follow healthcare compliance guidelines

* Able to manage hundreds of prospects without losing track of follow-ups



Technology:



You should be comfortable learning new software quickly.



Important: This Is a Sales & Growth Position



If you are looking primarily for data entry, graphic design, social media posting, or general administrative work, this position is not the right fit.



You should genuinely enjoy:



Researching → Calling → Connecting → Following Up → Building Relationships → Scheduling Meetings → Tracking Results → Growing Accounts



You must be comfortable hearing “no,” getting past gatekeepers, following up multiple times, and continuing to build the relationship professionally.



How to Apply

1. Please submit:

2. Your resume.

3. A brief explanation of any healthcare, pharmacy, medical-office, lead-generation, or B2B sales experience.

4. Tell us whether you have experience making outbound sales calls.

5. Requested pay rate 

6. Describe how you would handle this situation:

You call a neurology office and the receptionist says, “We already have a specialty pharmacy that we use.” What would you say next?

7. Submit a short voice recording introducing yourself as though you were calling a physician’s office on behalf of our pharmacy.

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
Digital Marketing & Growth Manager

Google Ads + Social Media Growth Strategy

Remote | Full-Time



Majesty Day Spa is seeking a highly capable Digital Marketing & Growth Manager who can take ownership of our digital growth strategy, with a strong focus on Google Ads, conversion tracking, marketing attribution, and Instagram growth.



This is not an entry-level social media position.



We are looking for someone who understands both the analytical side of marketing and the creative side of growth. You should be comfortable reviewing data, optimizing advertising campaigns, improving conversion tracking, analyzing customer acquisition, and developing strategies that help an established luxury spa brand grow its social media presence and generate more revenue.



You will work closely with our Spa Director, management team, Social Media manager, Automation Specialist/Full-Stack Developer.



Primary Objectives

Your main objectives will be to:

Build and strengthen the tracking infrastructure needed to accurately measure Google Ads performance.

Improve Google Ads performance and marketing ROI.

Develop and lead an effective Instagram growth strategy.

Improve our ability to determine where leads, phone calls, bookings, and purchases originate.

Turn marketing data into actionable recommendations.

Increase qualified leads, bookings, average customer value, and revenue generated from marketing.

Provide strategic direction to the team executing social media content.



Google Ads & Tracking Responsibilities

You will be expected to understand how to design and implement a proper Google Ads tracking and attribution system.

You should be comfortable working with:

Google Ads

Google Analytics 4

Google Tag Manager

Conversion tracking

UTM parameters

Website conversion events

Call tracking

Form tracking

Landing-page tracking

Lead attribution

Revenue attribution

Cost per lead

Cost per acquisition

ROAS

Campaign reporting

Keyword research

Negative keywords

Search campaigns

Performance analysis

Conversion optimization



A major early project will be helping us build the tracking foundation and infrastructure for our Google Ads system.



You will NOT be expected to build the entire technical system alone.



You will work directly with our Automation Specialist and Full-Stack Developer, who can assist with APIs, custom integrations, automations, webhooks, dashboards, database connections, and more advanced technical implementation.



However, you must understand tracking well enough to:

Design the tracking strategy

Explain what needs to be tracked

Determine what data should be passed between systems

Identify tracking gaps

Create technical requirements for the developer

Test whether tracking is functioning correctly

Verify conversion events

Review attribution accuracy

Troubleshoot marketing tracking problems

Determine whether our advertising data is reliable



You will be expected to understand what the tracking system needs to accomplish and work collaboratively with our technical team to build it correctly.



Google Ads Management

You will also be responsible for helping manage and improve Google Ads performance.

Responsibilities may include:

Campaign audits

Performance reporting

You will not be responsible for personally editing every video / graphic. Instead, you will help lead the strategy.



Responsibilities include:

Instagram growth strategy

Content strategy

Reel strategy

Content pillars

Viral-content research

Hook development

Competitor analysis

Trend research

Engagement strategy

Collaboration strategy

Local audience growth

Influencer opportunities

Reviewing content performance

Identifying high-performing and low-performing content

Recommending improvements

Developing testing strategies

Helping the content team understand what should be created and why



You should be comfortable reviewing Instagram Insights and using performance data to make strategic recommendations.



We are especially interested in someone who understands how to grow a local service-based business, not simply an entertainment or influencer account.



Management & Strategy

title: Real Estate SaaS Customer Support Agent (Full-Time Remote)
description:
Company: REsimpli

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 40 hours/week

Compensation: Hourly rate based on experience and qualifications



About REsimpli

REsimpli is a fast-growing SaaS company helping real estate investors streamline and scale their businesses through innovative technology. Our mission is to make real estate investing simpler by providing powerful tools, exceptional support, and a customer experience that helps our users succeed.



Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Support Agent who is responsive, patient, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys helping people solve problems.



In this role, you will be responsible for providing timely and accurate support to REsimpli customers when they have questions, encounter issues, or need assistance using the platform. You will communicate with customers through live chat, email, Zoom, and other support channels to understand their needs, troubleshoot problems, provide clear solutions, and escalate issues when necessary.



You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to ensure customer issues are properly documented, communicated, and resolved.



Key Responsibilities

- Respond to customer questions and support requests through live chat, email, Zoom, and other communication channels in a timely and professional manner.

- Troubleshoot product-related questions and issues and guide customers through appropriate solutions.

- Help customers understand how REsimpli features and functionality work.

- Identify the root cause of customer issues and provide clear, accurate, and easy-to-follow instructions.

- Reproduce and document issues when appropriate to help internal teams investigate and resolve them.

- Escalate bugs, technical issues, product limitations, and complex customer concerns to the appropriate internal team.

- Follow up on escalated issues when necessary and ensure customers receive appropriate updates.

- Accurately document customer conversations, reported issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions within company systems and CRM/support tools.

- Identify recurring customer questions or issues and communicate patterns and feedback to leadership and Product.

- Follow established support workflows, SOPs, quality standards, and escalation procedures.

- Contribute to internal documentation, help resources, FAQs, and knowledge base content based on common customer questions and issues.

- Maintain a professional, patient, and solutions-oriented approach, including when working with frustrated customers.

- Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to communicate customer issues or concerns that may impact adoption, satisfaction, or retention.



What We're Looking For

- 1–2+ years of experience in Customer Support, Technical Support, SaaS Support, or another customer-facing support role.

- Familiarity with REsimpli and/or experience using the platform.

- Experience in real estate, particularly real estate investing, wholesaling, or working with real estate investors.

- Experience supporting SaaS products, CRM platforms, or business software preferred.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to understand a customer's problem, ask the right questions, and determine the appropriate solution or next step.

- Ability to explain technical concepts and software functionality clearly to customers with varying levels of technical experience.

- Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation habits.

- Ability to manage multiple customer conversations and support requests while remaining organized and responsive.

- Comfortable using chat, email, Zoom, CRM systems, ticketing systems, and other customer communication tools.

- Ability to remain calm, patient, and professional when handling frustrated or upset customers.

- Strong sense of ownership — you take responsibility for getting an issue to the appropriate resolution rather than simply passing it along.

- Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently in a remote environment.

- Willingness to learn REsimpli's product, workflows, and the needs of our real estate investor customers.



Nice to Have

- Experience supporting SaaS products or CRM platforms.

- Experience with customer support ticketing systems or help desk software.

- Experience troubleshooting software or technical issues.

- Experience working with APIs, integrations, automations, or other technical software functionality.

- Experience working with real estate investors, sales teams, or technology-based businesses.

- Experience creating or maintaining knowledge base articles, FAQs, or support documentation.



Remote Work Requirements

As a remote team member, you are expected to maintain:

- Reliable high-speed internet service.

- A professional, distraction-free workspace suitable for customer interactions.

- Equipment capable of supporting company software and video conferencing.



You will also be expected to:

- Maintain your assigned work schedule and remain available during scheduled hours.

- Respond to customer requests within established response-time expectations.

- Communicate proactively with your team and leadership.

- Follow company processes, SOPs, escalation procedures, and quality standards.

- Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions.



Benefits

Following successful completion of the introductory period, eligible team members will receive:

- Paid time off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.

- Paid holidays in accordance with company policy.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit:

1. Your resume.

2. A short introduction video recording.



Please ensure all required application materials are submitted. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



Join REsimpli and help us deliver fast, knowledgeable, and exceptional support to the real estate investors who rely on our platform every day.

title: GoHighLevel Builder and Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
ABOUT INTERCEPTLY



Interceptly helps B2B companies find and start conversations with buyers who are already showing intent. We run signal-driven outbound campaigns for our clients and our partners’ clients, and we build our own intent products, including LeadIntercept, which tracks competitor engagement at the individual level.



We are a small team that runs on AI. Most of our processes live as Claude Code skills in a shared Git repo, and GoHighLevel is the center of our marketing and client operations. You will be the person who builds in it and makes it look good.



THE ROLE



This is a hands-on role split across 3 areas:



Building in GoHighLevel. You own our GHL builds: funnels, landing pages, websites, forms, automations, and reporting.

SEO. You keep our sites fast, indexed, and ranking, and you make sure every page you build is set up properly for search.

Social media and creative. You run our company social channels and create the graphics and images that go with them.



We care a lot about design. We want pages and graphics that look sharp and modern, not like a template someone forgot to finish.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



GoHighLevel builds and automation



Design and build landing pages, funnels, and full websites in GHL, from wireframe to launch

Build and maintain automation workflows: lead capture, nurture sequences, onboarding flows, follow-ups, reminders, and internal notifications

Build forms, surveys, calendars, and pipelines, and connect them so leads go to the right place

Create dashboards and reports that show leads, conversions, pipeline, and campaign performance at a glance

Set up tracking, UTM handling, and integrations so the numbers in our reports can be trusted

Keep our GHL workspaces tidy: custom fields, tags, templates, and naming conventions



SEO



Make sure every page and site you build is set up for search: meta titles and descriptions, headings, image alt text, internal links, schema, and page speed

Run regular site audits with Ahrefs or Semrush and fix what they find: broken links, redirects, canonicals, orphan pages, and missing OG images

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing and performance issues and work through the fix list

Do keyword research for new pages and content, and track rankings over time

Recommend and carry out on-page improvements to the pages that matter most to us



Social media and creative



Plan, write, and schedule posts for our company social channels on a consistent calendar

Design graphics, carousels, banners, and images for social posts, landing pages, and ads

Repurpose blog posts, case studies, and product updates into social content

Track engagement and report on what is working each month

Keep everything on brand: colors, fonts, tone of voice, and product naming



Claude Code and AI



Use Claude Code and other AI tools daily to draft copy, speed up builds, and run our internal skills

Spot manual, repeated work and turn it into an automation or a skill



A TYPICAL WEEK



Every day: share your priorities in the morning and an end-of-day update with the team. Work through GHL build and automation tasks, and publish or schedule social content.

Weekly: at least 3 to 5 social posts with original graphics, plus progress on any open page, funnel, or website builds.

Monthly: performance reports for GHL funnels, SEO, and social.

Every 2 to 4 weeks: site audit and fixes.

As needed: new landing pages for campaigns, launches, and partners.



WHAT YOU WILL NEED



Must have



2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building funnels, landing pages, websites, and workflows

A portfolio with live links to landing pages, funnels, or websites you built. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

A strong eye for design. Your pages should look clean, modern, and professional on desktop and mobile

Experience building GHL reports and dashboards

Working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO, plus experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, or Google Search Console. You know what a canonical, a 301, and an orphan page are, and how to fix them

Experience managing company social media accounts and planning content calendars

Excellent written English. You will write copy that goes out under our name

Regular use of Claude or another AI assistant for real work, not just casual prompts



Nice to have



Graphic design skills in Canva, Figma, or Adobe tools, with samples of social graphics you created

WordPress and Elementor experience

Experience with B2B or SaaS marketing

Basic HTML and CSS for custom page tweaks

Experience with Zapier, Make, webhooks, or APIs

Experience with Claude Code, GitHub, or working from the command line



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:



Links to 3 or more landing pages, funnels, or websites you built (GHL builds preferred)

3 to 5 examples of graphics or social posts you designed

A short note on one automation or report you built in GHL and what it did for the business



Start your application with the word “Funnel” so we know you read this far.



HOW WE WORK



We document everything. If you do something twice, it should end up in our knowledge base or a skill.

We are async-first, but we expect daily overlap with UK hours for the team meeting and client work.

You will get a structured handover, plus access to our SOPs, brand guidelines, and skills repo.

title: E-commerce Product Data Specialist (Listing Enrichment, Error Fixing & Data Entry)
description:
We're a US-based online electronics and technology reseller selling across multiple marketplaces (Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy, eBay, Newegg, and others). We're looking for a detail-oriented VA to improve and maintain our product listing data. This is a long-term, full-time role with room to grow into a team lead position.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Enrich product listings: find and fill in missing attributes (specs, dimensions, model numbers, UPC/GTIN, categories, bullet points, descriptions) using manufacturer and distributor sources

- Fix listing errors and rejections from marketplace feeds and upload reports, then re-submit corrected data

- Enter and update product data in spreadsheets, our channel management platform, and marketplace dashboards

- Match products to the correct listings and flag mismatches or duplicates

- Follow our SOPs and checklists, and document any new issues you find

- Report daily on what you completed, what's pending, and what needs a decision

- Assist with other back-office e-commerce tasks as needed. Training is provided for anything new.



REQUIREMENTS:

- 1+ year of experience in e-commerce, product data entry, catalog management, or marketplace listing work (Amazon Seller Central experience is a big plus)

- Strong English reading and writing skills

- Very high attention to detail. Accuracy matters more than speed

- Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, filters, find and replace)

- Able to follow written SOPs and Loom video training

- Flexible and willing to learn new tasks as they come up

- Reliable high-speed internet, a backup internet or power option, and a computer that can handle multiple browser tabs

- Basic familiarity with electronics and IT products is a plus, but not required

- Comfortable using AI tools (like ChatGPT or Claude) to speed up research and drafting is a plus



SCHEDULE: Full-time (40 hrs/week). Some overlap with US Eastern time (at least 3-4 hours) is required. Please state your availability in your application.



PAY: $5-8/hr depending on experience. Paid weekly or bi-weekly via your preferred method.



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:

1. A short summary of your relevant experience (e-commerce, catalog, or data entry)

2. Your availability and expected hourly rate

3. The tools and platforms you've worked with

4. The phrase "DATA CHECK" at the top of your message so we know you read this post

5. A short answer: "A product listing was rejected for 'missing required attribute.' How would you approach finding and fixing it?"



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test project (about 1-2 hours) before final selection.

title: Financial Accounting Coordinator
description:
About Eureka (Designa)



Eureka, LLC (Designa) is a growing California-based company with businesses spanning furniture, workspace solutions, and modular construction.



Our established brand, Eureka Ergonomic, designs and manufactures ergonomic furniture and workspace solutions for home, commercial, hospitality, residential, education, healthcare, and other environments. Our business brings together product design, research and development, manufacturing, logistics, sales, and customer support.



We are also expanding through Eureka Modular, a growing modular manufacturing business focused on innovative modular solutions and building systems.



Our headquarters in Corona, California, is a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where teams work closely across finance, operations, sales, product, manufacturing, and management.



As we grow, we are strengthening the financial systems and processes that support our businesses. This is an opportunity to join our team at an important stage of growth and contribute directly to building accurate, organized, and scalable financial operations.



About the Role



We are looking for a Financial Accounting Coordinator to support day-to-day accounting operations while taking an active role in sales tax compliance, vendor compliance, financial documentation, and coordination with external accounting professionals.



This is a hands-on position for someone who is accurate, organized, dependable, and comfortable following financial and tax-related processes from start to finish.



The role will primarily support Eureka Ergonomic, while also assisting with the financial and back-office setup of Eureka Modular as applicable.



The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys finding discrepancies, organizing information, following up on outstanding items, and making sure financial records and compliance documentation are complete and accurate.



Key Responsibilities



Accounting & Financial Operations



Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping, account coding, and financial records in QuickBooks Online

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts and investigate discrepancies

Organize invoices, receipts, payments, revenue, costs, and supporting documentation

Support monthly financial reporting and month-end close activities

Prepare organized financial information for management and external accounting professionals

Track outstanding accounting items, missing documentation, and required follow-ups

Maintain accurate, organized, and traceable financial records

Sales Tax & Tax Compliance



Maintain sales tax codes, rates, and jurisdictions in QuickBooks

Use Tax Cloud or similar sales tax automation software to support multi-state sales tax processes

Monitor state economic nexus thresholds and assist in identifying registration requirements

Assist with state sales tax permit registrations and related documentation

Review and maintain exemption and resale certificates

Support sales tax filing and compliance processes

Maintain complete and audit-ready sales tax documentation

Vendor & 1099 Compliance



Collect and maintain vendor W-9 documentation

Monitor vendor payments for 1099 reporting purposes

Support preparation and filing of 1099-NEC forms

Maintain organized vendor tax records and supporting documentation

Follow up with vendors regarding missing or incomplete documentation

CPA & Financial Coordination



Coordinate financial information between the company and external CPAs

Organize documentation required for tax filings, financial reviews, and compliance matters

Follow up with internal teams, vendors, and accounting professionals on outstanding items

Identify missing information, discrepancies, and overdue items

Communicate matters requiring management attention in a clear and timely manner

Provide organized financial information to support professional accounting and tax work

Cost & Business Operations Support



Track logistics, warehousing, delivery, labor, and third-party costs

Prepare monthly cost comparisons and identify significant discrepancies or exceptions

Organize supporting documentation for claims and chargebacks

Track vendor quotations and cost/service comparisons for management review

Support financial coordination across Eureka Ergonomic and Eureka Modular as needed

Documentation & Process Improvement



Maintain organized and accessible financial documentation

Maintain action lists for missing information and outstanding items

Follow up with responsible parties to obtain required financial information

Help document and improve repeatable financial workflows and procedures

Support the development of organized financial processes as the company grows

What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications



Experience with QuickBooks Online, including bookkeeping and account reconciliation

Experience with sales tax setup, reporting, or compliance

Experience with TaxCloud or a similar sales tax automation platform

Understanding of multi-state sales tax and economic nexus concepts

Familiarity with W-9 and 1099-NEC processes

Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Excellent organization and follow-through

Ability to identify discrepancies, missing information, and incomplete documentation

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Ability to communicate professionally with management, vendors, internal teams, and external accounting professionals

Ability to learn company-specific financial systems and processes quickly

Bilingual English/Mandarin Chinese Required

Preferred Qualifications



California sales tax or CDTFA experience

Multi-state sales tax registration or compliance experience

Practical experience monitoring economic nexus

Experience tracking logistics, warehousing, delivery, or third-party costs

Experience working in a growing or multi-business organization



What This Role Is



This is a hands-on accounting and financial coordination role with significant responsibility for maintaining accurate financial records and supporting sales tax and financial compliance processes.



You will work closely with company management, internal teams, vendors, and external CPAs and accounting professionals.



This position is focused on accurate execution, coordination, organization, follow-through, and reliable financial documentation. It is not a CPA sign-off position and does not independently provide tax or legal advice.



What We Offer



Health Insurance

Dental Insurance

Vision Insurance

401(k)

Paid Time Off

Paid Sick Leave

Growth and advancement opportunities

Opportunity to work across Eureka Ergonomic and Eureka Modular

Fast-paced, entrepreneurial work environment

Why Join Eureka?



At Eureka, your work will directly support the company's financial operations and continued growth.



You will work across departments and have the opportunity to build practical experience in accounting, sales tax compliance, financial operations, vendor management, and business processes.



If you are someone who values accuracy, accountability, organization, problem-solving, and continuous learning, we would like to hear from you.



Apply today to join Eureka, LLC in Corona, California.

How to Apply

title: Paralegal – Criminal Defense (Law Graduate)
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Paralegal or Attorney to support our criminal defense practice. This role requires in-depth knowledge of criminal law, including motion preparation, legal research, and document management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing motions, drafting legal documents, and ensuring compliance with legal procedures. They will work closely with attorneys to ensure the defense strategy is executed effectively, and help prepare cases for court. This is a remote position requiring exceptional written English, organizational skills, and a strong grasp of U.S. criminal law procedures fundamentals.



Key Responsibilities:



• Draft, review, and be prepared to file various legal documents including motions, briefs, and memoranda.

• Prepare appendices for motions, including organizing exhibits, declarations, and supporting documentation.

• Prepare the table of contents for legal filings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with court rules.

• Conduct in-depth legal research on complex criminal law issues and generate a research summary for the attorney.

• Analyze discovery materials to identify critical issues and inconsistencies.

• Prepare memoranda and case summaries to aid in litigation strategy.

• Assist in the preparation of motions for hearings, trials, and appeals, including motions to suppress evidence, dismiss charges, or modify bail.

• Manage case files, ensuring all relevant documents and evidence are properly documented and stored.

• Prepare discovery responses, subpoenas, and other legal documents as directed.

• Coordinate with clients, witnesses, and experts to gather information and evidence for cases.

• Maintain communication with the court, opposing counsel, and clients regarding motions, hearings, and court dates.

• Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits, trial briefs, and witness lists.

• Ensure all legal documents comply with applicable state and federal rules and deadlines.



Qualifications:



• Must be a Graduate of a law school (JD).

• Proven experience in criminal defense law, specifically in motion practice.

• Strong knowledge of court rules, procedures, and legal writing standards.

• Experience preparing appendices, tables of contents, and organizing large case files.

• Excellent research, analytical, and writing skills.

• Must have strong knowledge of legal citation

• Ability to manage multiple cases and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

• Experience with legal research tools (e.g.,Lexis/Nexis and Westlaw) and document management software, such as Clio CRM software.



Preferred:



• Prior experience in criminal defense law or litigation.

• Knowledge of specific motions in criminal defense, including motions to suppress, dismiss, and motions for bond 

 reductions.

• Familiarity with Nevada local court rules and procedures in criminal defense.



Application Process:



Interested candidates should submit the following:

• An updated resume.

• A cover letter detailing your experience with U.S. criminal law and Clio software.

• Two writing samples (legal motions or briefs preferred) with how long it required the applicant to finalize the presented 

 document (in hours) from the time the assignment was given to the document presented.

title: Figma Designer + Showreel
description:
Figma designer and video editor for website portfolio showcases



I’m looking for a designer with a strong eye for presentation to turn websites I’ve worked on into high-quality portfolio assets and a polished showreel.



The websites already exist. Your job is to capture them properly and make the work look its best.



These assets will be used on my agency website, social media and in sales presentations. They need to feel professional, considered and visually impressive.



What you’ll do



• Take high-resolution screenshots and screen recordings of websites I provide. Like I have started in here: [
](
) Some I have to do in multi steps as the quality is low if using a browser tool. 

• Capture desktop and mobile layouts, key sections and relevant interactions.

• Create polished showcase assets in Figma, including website compositions, close-ups and device mockups where appropriate.

• Build a consistent visual style across the collection while respecting each website’s branding.

• Create a short showreel combining the projects, using smooth movement, strong pacing and clean transitions.

• Export finished assets ready for use and supply organised, editable source files.



The quality I’m looking for



Crisp screenshots. Strong composition. Thoughtful spacing. Good typography. Motion that helps show off the work.



I don’t want blurry captures, stretched screens, random mockup templates or excessive effects. The websites should be the focus.



You’ll need to check captures carefully for cookie banners, loading issues, missing images and awkward crops. The finished work should be ready to use without me having to spot and fix basic mistakes.



You’re a good fit if you



• Are confident working in Figma.

• Have examples of website showcases, digital portfolios or similar presentation work.

• Can create polished video using After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or a comparable tool.

• Understand how to capture responsive websites at high quality.

• Can follow a visual direction and make sensible design decisions independently.

• Communicate clearly and deliver reliably.



What I’ll provide



• Website URLs and details of the work to feature.

• Brand assets and visual references.

• Guidance on where the finished assets will be used.

• Feedback on the initial direction before you produce the full collection.



Deliverables



• An organised Figma file with editable showcase layouts.

• High-resolution exports in agreed website and social media formats.

• A finished showreel, plus versions for agreed placements.

• Editable video project files and any linked assets needed to use them.



We’ll agree the number of projects, assets, video length and deadlines before starting.



How to apply



Please send:



1. Two or three relevant examples of website showcase or portfolio design.

2. At least one showreel or motion design example.

3. A brief explanation of your role in each example.

4. The tools you use for website capture, design and video editing.

5. Your hourly rate or typical project pricing, availability and estimated turnaround for one website showcase.



Please lead with relevant examples rather than a large folder of unrelated work. If your strength is only design or only video, make that clear.



I’d like to start with a small paid trial covering one website showcase and a short motion sample. If the quality and working relationship are right, we can move on to the full collection.



The goal is to hand over the URLs and receive excellent, ready-to-use assets without having to manage every design decision.

title: Application Specialist
description:
Position Overview: 



The Application Specialist is responsible for testing, troubleshooting, and updating the internal apps, automations, and workflows Power Plus Systems develops, making sure each one is reliable, easy to use, and ready for rollout. This role works closely with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist, partners with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and collaborates with Admin Operations, Scheduling, Finance, Estimating, and Field teams to find issues before team members do and turn feedback into improvements. The ideal candidate has a software development background, hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools, a working knowledge of webhooks and integrations, and a strong eye for user interface and user experience design. 



Pay Range: $8 per hour based on experience with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents. 





About Power Plus Systems: 



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission. 





Objectives: 



- Test company apps, automations, and workflows before rollout to confirm they work as intended across devices, browsers, and real-world scenarios.

- Perform manual testing and support automated testing to catch bugs, broken logic, and edge cases early. 

- Troubleshoot issues reported by team members, identify the root cause, and coordinate fixes with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist. 

- Test and monitor webhooks and integrations between systems such as GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, Jotform, and other company platforms to ensure data passes correctly. 

- Review apps from the user's point of view and recommend and implement UI and UX improvements that make tools easier, faster, and clearer for team members. 

- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up test case creation, debugging, documentation, and app updates. 

- Apply approved updates and improvements to existing apps and workflows, then retest to confirm nothing else broke. 

- Work with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and maintain test checklists and release notes so every rollout is consistent and repeatable. 





Competencies: 



- Solid understanding of software development concepts, including front-end and back-end logic, APIs, and how data moves between systems. 

- Hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to verify AI output before relying on it. 

- Working knowledge of webhooks, including how to read payloads, interpret response codes, and troubleshoot failed connections. 

- Familiarity with manual and automated testing methods, test cases, and regression testing for apps and workflows. 

- Strong eye for design with a clear understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles. 

- Analytical, detail-oriented approach to finding root causes rather than surface-level fixes. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical team members. 

- Ability to manage multiple testing and update projects at once while meeting rollout deadlines. 

- Comfort using browser developer tools and automation platforms such as Make or Zapier is a plus. 

- Construction, electrical, or trade-industry experience is a plus. 





Education and Experience:

title: Assistant Content Project Manager – Video Editing & Social Media Content
description:
Company: Talent Tribe Media 

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Employment Type: Part-Time During Probation, with Potential for Full-Time Employment

Work Hours: TBD 

Salary: TBD 



About the Role

Talent Tribe is looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and proactive Assistant Content Project Manager with a strong understanding of video storytelling, content strategy, and social media content creation.

The ideal candidate has previous experience as a video editor, content creator, or social media content specialist and understands what makes a video engaging, informative, and effective.



This role goes beyond writing instructions for editors. You must be able to develop creative video concepts, communicate ideas clearly, and turn basic business information and promotions into compelling content that captures attention and drives action.

You will work closely with our Project Manager and video editors to develop content projects, provide clear editing instructions, review video quality, and create videos based on your own concepts.



We are looking for someone who understands both the creative and technical sides of video content. You should know how to plan a video, write a strong hook, structure a compelling story, and guide editors toward producing high-quality results.



Key Responsibilities

1. Content Planning and Project Instructions

- Develop 3–4 new video projects per day based on the business information, services, and promotional details provided.

- Write clear and actionable video briefs for editors, including:

- Video concept and objective

- Opening hook to capture attention

- Key messages and talking points

- Video structure and storytelling direction

- Suggested visuals, footage, and editing style

- On-screen text, captions, and transitions

- Call to action (CTA)

-Turn basic information into creative, informative, and engaging video concepts suitable for social media platforms.



2. Video Editing and Content Creation

- Create and edit videos based on your own project concepts and written instructions.

- Demonstrate an understanding of pacing, storytelling, visual flow, audience engagement, and effective messaging.

- Ensure videos communicate the intended message while maintaining a professional standard of quality.

- Use your video editing experience to develop practical instructions that editors can easily follow.



3. Project Adjustments and Editor Support

- Make minor adjustments to 2–3 existing projects per day to help editors stay on schedule and improve video quality.

- Clarify project instructions and provide constructive feedback when needed.

- Help editors understand the intended creative direction and make sure their work aligns with the project brief.



4. Quality Control and Project Management Support

- Assist the Project Manager in reviewing completed and ongoing video projects.

- Check whether videos follow the instructions, communicate the key message, and meet quality standards.

- Identify areas for improvement in storytelling, editing, pacing, clarity, and audience engagement.

- Help maintain an organized workflow and ensure projects move forward efficiently.



Probation Period and Workload

During the probation period, you will work up to 4 hours per day, unless additional hours are needed and approved based on workload and business needs.



Our general expectations are:

- Content planning and editing instructions: Approximately 1–2 hours maximum per project.

- New projects: 3–4 video projects per day.

- Project adjustments: Minor revisions to 2–3 existing projects per day.

- Video creation: Produce sample videos based on your own concepts and written briefs.

- Efficiency is important. You should be able to develop clear, detailed, and actionable instructions without spending excessive time on each project.



Your primary focus will be content planning, project instructions, video creation, and quality control. Other administrative or support tasks will be secondary and should be handled after the main content responsibilities are completed.

Additional hours may be assigned when necessary, subject to approval.



Qualifications and Requirements: 

We are looking for someone who has:

1. Previous experience as a video editor, content creator, or social media content specialist.

2.A strong understanding of short-form video content for platforms such as
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

3.Knowledge of video storytelling, audience retention, pacing, hooks, and calls to action.

4. The ability to turn basic business information into creative and engaging video concepts.

5. Strong writing skills and the ability to communicate editing instructions clearly.

5. An understanding of video editing techniques, visual storytelling, transitions, captions, and sound design.

6. Good attention to detail and the ability to review content objectively.

7. Strong organizational and time-management skills.

8. The ability to work independently, follow deadlines, and manage multiple projects.

9. Clear written communication skills and the ability to collaborate with editors and a Project Manager.



Bonus qualifications:

1. Experience managing video editors or coordinating content production.

2. Experience creating content for businesses, brands, or digital marketing agencies.

3. Familiarity with content calendars, project management tools, and AI-assisted content workflows.

4. A portfolio demonstrating strong video editing and content creation skills.



Skills We Value Most

We are not simply looking for someone who can write a video brief. We need someone who understands why a video works.

You should be able to answer questions such as:

- What makes someone stop scrolling?

- How do you communicate a business's message within a short video?

- How should a video be structured to maintain audience interest?

- What visuals, pacing, and editing techniques will make the content more effective?

- How can you give editors instructions that are clear enough to produce the intended result?

- We value creativity, practical thinking, efficiency, and the ability to turn ideas into finished content.



Skills Assessment

As part of our hiring process, candidates may be asked to complete a practical content creation test.



We will provide basic business information and promotional details. You will be expected to:



1. Develop a video concept from the information provided.

2. Write a detailed editing brief with a hook, key messages, video structure, and CTA.

3. Create and edit a video based on your concept and instructions.

4. Demonstrate how effectively you can turn the original information into clear, engaging, and informative content.

This assessment will help us evaluate your content planning, writing, creative thinking, and video editing abilities.

5. Candidates who demonstrate strong performance may be considered for a full-time position.



Compensation and Growth Opportunities

Compensation will be discussed based on experience, skills, and the results of the hiring assessment.

This position offers an opportunity to grow into a full-time role for someone who can consistently deliver quality content projects, support editors effectively, and contribute to improving our content production workflow.



How to Apply

If you believe you are the right fit, please submit the following: IMPORTANT 



1. Your updated resume.

2. A portfolio containing at least 2–3 videos you have created or edited.

3. A brief explanation of your experience with video editing, content creation, or content project management.

4.  The video editing software and project management tools you are familiar with.

5.Your expected hourly rate and availability.



Please include the phrase “CONTENT PROJECT PRO” in your application so we know you have read the full job posting.

We look forward to finding someone who can combine creative storytelling, strong content planning, and practical video editing skills to help our team produce better content efficiently.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and reliable team member who can help support lead generation, client outreach, follow-ups, and CRM management across multiple accounts. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential.

______________________________________________________



**Why This Role is Important**

This role is critical to helping our sales pipeline active and organized. If leads are missed, follow-ups delayed, or CRM records incomplete, opportunities are lost and team performance slows down.



Your job is to make sure that NEVER happens.

______________________________________________________



**What You’ll Be Doing**



As an Inside Sales Agent, you’ll be the frontline sales professional responsible for handling inbound and outbound leads, qualifying motivated sellers, and setting appointments for our acquisitions team. You’ll play a critical role in driving revenue by ensuring only high-quality opportunities move forward.



You’ll work closely with a supportive, performance-driven team that values consistency, ownership, and continuous improvement.



**What We’re Looking For**

Qualifications & Requirements:

* Minimum 6 months of experience as an Inside Sales Agent (REQUIRED)

* Experience handling high-volume inbound and outbound calls

* Background in real estate, wholesaling, acquisitions, or property sales is a strong plus

* Proven ability to qualify leads, uncover motivation, and handle objections

* Confident, professional, and persuasive phone presence

* Excellent English communication skills (clear, neutral accent preferred)

* Strong follow-up skills and ability to nurture leads over time

* Comfortable working with CRM systems, dialers, and lead management tools

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and consistent with data entry and notes

* Self-motivated, reliable, and able to hit daily/weekly call and appointment targets

* Team-oriented mindset with a strong sense of accountability

* Positive attitude and genuine interest in building rapport and long-term relationships



Preferred (Big Plus!)

-Experience with real estate industry

-Experience working with US-based/remote clients



Technical Requirements:

* Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 50 Mbps) with backup connection

* Reliable laptop/desktop and smartphone

* Quiet, distraction-free workspace suitable for sales calls



**Perks/Benefits**

–10 days paid time off (PTO)/holiday

– Maxicare health insurance (PH-based employees)

– Performance-based bonuses per property sold

– SV anniversary & birthday gifts

– 13th Month Pay with the potential to earn 2–3× based on performance and company results

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION:

You'll work closely with our existing SEO team to deliver organic search strategy, execution, and reporting for our clients, with real input into how this new service is packaged and priced.

Your availability and preferred working hours



We're looking to bring someone on as a trial/freelance engagement first, with the potential for this to grow into an ongoing role as we build out this service line.
