title: Bookkeeper
description:
# Full-Time Bookkeeper – Home Services Company



**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Schedule:** 40 hours per week, with occasional additional hours as business needs require

**Working Hours:** [Insert required U.S. time zone and schedule]

**Compensation:** [Insert salary range and payment details]



## About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based home services company seeking a dependable, detail-oriented full-time bookkeeper in the Philippines. You will oversee the company’s day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll coordination, invoicing, collections, commissions, and financial records.



This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, and keeps financial information accurate and organized. You will work closely with company leadership, team members in the United States and abroad, and our external accountant.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping and Financial Records



- Maintain accurate and organized records in QuickBooks.

- Categorize and reconcile transactions, accounts, and payments.

- Keep financial information current and identify discrepancies promptly.

- Prepare regular reports that give management a clear view of the company’s financial position.

- Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.



### JobNimbus and Invoicing



- Maintain the financial side of our JobNimbus CRM.

- Confirm that customer invoices are accurate, complete, and issued on time.

- Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue balances.

- Record payments and keep customer account information current.

- Assess applicable late fees according to company policies.

- Perform other collection-related activities to help ensure timely payment.

- Reconcile financial information between JobNimbus and QuickBooks.



### Weekly Payroll



- Verify hours submitted by team members in the United States and abroad.

- Identify missing, inaccurate, or unusual time entries before payroll is processed.

- Prepare and coordinate weekly payroll for U.S.-based and international team members.

- Maintain accurate payroll records and resolve payroll discrepancies.

- Protect confidential employee and payroll information.



### Commissions and Spreadsheets



- Maintain spreadsheets used to calculate commissions and other team compensation.

- Verify commission amounts against completed jobs, collected payments, and company policies.

- Provide accurate commission reports before payments are approved.

- Maintain organized and auditable spreadsheet records.



### Accountant Coordination



- Coordinate with our external accountant regarding filings and financial reporting.

- Provide requested records and supporting documents accurately and on time.

- Help ensure the accountant has the information needed for tax filings, compliance, and year-end reporting.

- Respond promptly to questions and resolve missing-information requests.



### General Financial Administration



- Manage other financial and bookkeeping responsibilities as needed.

- Improve financial processes and help maintain strong internal controls.

- Communicate financial concerns, overdue accounts, and discrepancies to management.

- Meet recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual deadlines.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.

- Experience processing or coordinating payroll.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience with invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections.

- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.

- Excellent organization, time-management, and follow-up skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to handle confidential financial and payroll information professionally.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet workspace.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively with a remote team.

- Willingness to work the required U.S. business hours and occasional additional hours when needed.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using JobNimbus or a similar home-services CRM.

- Bookkeeping experience with a U.S.-based company.

- Experience in roofing, construction, contracting, or another home-services industry.

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and basic accounting practices.

- Experience calculating sales commissions or performance-based compensation.

- Experience working directly with an external accountant or CPA.



## What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



- Keep QuickBooks and JobNimbus accurate and up to date.

- Ensure weekly payroll is prepared correctly and on time.

- Make sure invoices are issued promptly and actively followed up until collected.

- Maintain accurate commission calculations and supporting records.

- Give management timely visibility into financial issues.

- Provide complete, organized information to our accountant.

- Take ownership of financial tasks without requiring constant reminders.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your résumé or CV.

2. A brief description of your bookkeeping experience.

3. Details about your experience with QuickBooks, payroll, invoicing, collections, and spreadsheets.

4. Any experience you have with JobNimbus or another CRM.

5. Your preferred monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

6. Your availability and ability to work [insert required U.S. time zone].

7. Your internet speed and backup plans for internet or power interruptions.

8. The names of two professional references.



Please begin your application with the words **“Organized Finances”** so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Customer Service Representative/Admin
description:
We are looking for a remote customer-oriented service representative. A customer service representative, or CSR, will act as a liaison, provide services information and resolve any emerging problems that our customer accounts might face with accuracy and efficiency. The best CSRs are genuinely excited to help customers. They’re patient, empathetic, and passionately communicative. They love to talk. Customer service representatives can put themselves in their customers’ shoes and advocate for them when necessary. Customer feedback is priceless, and these CSRs can gather that for you. Problem-solving comes naturally to customer care specialists. They are confident at troubleshooting and investigate if they don’t have enough information to resolve customer complaints. The target is to ensure excellent service standards, respond efficiently to customer inquiries and maintain high customer satisfaction.



Responsibilities

• Manage large amounts of incoming calls

• Identify and assess customers’ needs to achieve satisfaction

• Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer through open and interactive communication

• Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools

• Meet personal/customer service team sales targets and call handling quotas

• Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution

• Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents

• Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies

• Schedule customer Jobs

• Take the extra mile to engage customers



Skills

• EXCELLENT English communication and presentation skills

• Proven customer support experience or experience as a client service representative; use of proprietary software

• Track record of over-achieving quota

• Strong phone contact handling skills and active listening

• Familiarity with CRM systems and practices

• Customer orientation and ability to adapt/respond to different types of characters

• Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

• College Degree



Experience level:

• 5 years Customer Service Experience in Call Center



Job Type: Full-time- this is a full-time position that needs to be engaged during the entire shift. You will not have the ability to use this as a 2nd job.



Shift:

• Monday- Friday CST 8am to 6pm 10 Hours Per Day- 1 Hour Break*



*Please note this is 10pm to 8am Philippines time half the year and half the year it would be 9pm to 5am.



Salary: 35,000-40,000 PHP Per Month plus possible bonuses TBD. Salary is paid each week.

You will have paid time off for the holidays we are closed in the U.S.

title: GoHighLevel Automation & Social Media Marketing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a skilled, proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage marketing automation and social media for multiple growing health and wellness businesses in the United States.



This role combines two important areas: GoHighLevel (GHL) automation and social media marketing across
, Instagram, and TikTok.



You'll work directly with the business owner to build effective marketing systems, grow our social media presence, and help turn marketing efforts into leads, customers, and revenue.



We're looking for someone who can take ownership of projects, work independently, and consistently deliver results.



Key Responsibilities

1. GoHighLevel Automation & CRM Management

- Build, manage, and optimize advanced workflows and automations in GoHighLevel.

- Create automated
 and SMS marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and follow-up systems.

- Develop marketing funnels, landing pages, forms, and lead capture systems.

- Manage CRM pipelines, contact segmentation, tagging, and lead tracking.

- Integrate GoHighLevel with other platforms using Zapier, Make, APIs, or similar tools.

- Troubleshoot existing automations and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.

- Help develop systems that convert leads into booked appointments and paying customers.



2. Social Media Management 
, Instagram & TikTok)

- Manage our business social media accounts across
, Instagram, and TikTok.

- Develop and maintain a consistent social media content calendar.

- Research content ideas, industry trends, and competitor strategies.

- Create engaging social media posts, graphics, short-form videos, Reels, and TikToks.

- Write compelling captions, hooks, and calls to action.

- Edit video content using tools such as CapCut, Canva, or similar applications.

- Schedule and publish content consistently across all platforms.

- Repurpose existing content into multiple formats for different platforms.

- Monitor engagement and help grow our social media presence.

- Track social media performance and recommend improvements.



3. Content Creation & Marketing Support

- Take content ideas from initial concept through creation, editing, approval, and publishing.

- Work with the business owner and team members to develop relevant, engaging content.

- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva AI, and other applications to accelerate content creation.

- Help develop educational, promotional, and brand-building content.

- Assist with Meta Ads creative, marketing campaigns, and other digital marketing projects.

- Ensure content aligns with our brand identity, messaging, and marketing objectives.



Required Skills & Qualifications

- Strong, hands-on experience with GoHighLevel is essential.

- Demonstrated experience building complex GHL automations, workflows, funnels, and CRM systems.

- Experience managing business social media accounts on
, Instagram, and TikTok.

- Strong content creation skills, including graphics, captions, and short-form video editing.

- Proficiency with Canva, CapCut, or similar content creation tools.

- Experience creating and managing social media content calendars.

- Strong familiarity with AI tools and how to use them to improve productivity and content creation.

- Understanding of digital marketing fundamentals, lead generation, and customer engagement.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.



Ideal Candidate

We're especially interested in someone who:

- Has advanced GoHighLevel skills and can build sophisticated automations without extensive guidance.

- Understands what makes social media content engaging and effective.

- Can take a basic content idea and turn it into a polished, published post.

- Is creative, resourceful, and comfortable experimenting with new approaches.

- Uses AI extensively to work smarter and faster.

- Is proactive about identifying opportunities and recommending improvements.

- Can manage multiple projects and consistently meet deadlines.

- Understands that our ultimate goal is to generate leads, acquire customers, and grow our businesses.



What We Offer

- Long-term, full-time remote position supporting growing US-based businesses.

- Direct collaboration with the business owner.

- Opportunities to work with AI, automation, and modern marketing technologies.

- Variety of projects and opportunities for professional growth.

- Autonomy and responsibility for meaningful business outcomes.



How to Apply

1. A brief introduction describing your experience with GoHighLevel and social media marketing.

title: MULTISKILLED WEBSITE & DIGITAL CONTENT SPECIALIST
description:
HIRING — MULTISKILLED WEBSITE & DIGITAL CONTENT SPECIALIST



Remote position | Pay: US $4.00 per hour



We are seeking a creative, skilled, and dependable professional who can build premium, modern websites and manage engaging digital content across our brands.



You must have a strong eye for design, take initiative, communicate clearly, and deliver polished work on time.



Skills and responsibilities



* Website design and maintenance: Build attractive, mobile-friendly WordPress websites, landing pages, online stores, and blogs. Manage updates, backups, security, speed, and basic troubleshooting.

* Content creation and blogging: Write and edit website copy, blog articles, product descriptions, captions, and promotional content in clear English.

* Graphic design: Create professional social media graphics, flyers, banners, presentations, and branded promotional materials.

* Social media management: Maintain
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube accounts; plan content, schedule posts, respond to comments, and track performance.

* Video production and editing: Create promotional videos, reels, shorts, and product advertisements with captions, music, transitions, and consistent branding.

* Photography and photo editing: Demonstrate strong composition, product presentation, lighting, retouching, and image enhancement skills. Please state whether you can also provide original photography or filming in your location.

* SEO and analytics: Apply basic search engine optimization and use performance data to improve websites and content.



Relevant tools — tell us which you can confidently use



* Websites: WordPress, Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, WooCommerce, HTML/CSS, cPanel, and domain/hosting management.

* Design: Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, and Figma.

* Video: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and/or Final Cut Pro.

* Social media: Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, Later, and platform analytics.

* SEO: Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and PageSpeed Insights.

* Writing and productivity: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Grammarly, ChatGPT, Trello, Asana, and/or ClickUp.



You should demonstrate proficiency across the core skill areas. You do not need to use every alternative tool listed.



Requirements



* A portfolio showing actual past or current work.

About Good Luck Grams

Good Luck Grams creates custom keepsake posters for gymnastics meets across the country. Our “Grams” are displayed throughout the venue before competition begins, giving families a meaningful way to encourage their gymnast. After the meet, each family takes their Gram home as a lasting keepsake.



We work with gyms and meet directors nationwide, managing everything from design through production, shipping, and meet day display. Our busy season runs November through April, with order volume growing every year.



Key Responsibilities

Design & Production

- Make text corrections directly to existing JPG files without recreating the entire Gram.

Quality & Accuracy

- Proofread every file for spelling, correct gym, and correct details before marking it complete.

- Keep each order's data matched to the correct spreadsheet row so details and photos never get mixed up between Grams.

- Flag anything unclear using the designated notes field rather than letting it slide.



Workflow & Communication

- Work within a shared Google Drive, organized by meet, using the designated business
.

- Comfortable working independently from a template and a spreadsheet of order data.

- Reliable internet and a personal computer capable of running Photoshop smoothly.



Personal Attributes

- Strong, consistent attention to detail. This is the single most important skill for this role.

- Methodical when working row by row through a spreadsheet, so the right photo and details always land on the right Gram.

- Takes initiative and doesn't need to be micromanaged.

- Able to overlap with North American working hours when needed for check-ins or urgent requests.

title: Senior Shopify Developer (Full Time, 8+ Years, Front End, Back End and QA)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a group of direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands on Shopify Plus, running constant tests and offers. We need one senior developer who owns everything technical on our stores: theme code, custom features, apps and integrations, A/B tests and tracking.



The most important part of this job is quality. Nothing goes live until it is tested on mobile and desktop, in every market, with every discount and cart combination. If you ship and let customers find the bugs, this role is not for you.











WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. THEMES

   Build, customize and maintain Shopify themes (Liquid, JavaScript, CSS, Online Store 2.0 sections and blocks).



2. CART, CHECKOUT AND DISCOUNTS

   Cart drawer, bundles, tiered offers, free gifts. Shopify Functions and checkout UI extensions.



3. BACK END AND INTEGRATIONS

   Admin and Storefront APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, custom apps, and connections to fulfillment,
 and review tools.



4. A/B TESTS

   Set up, QA and end Intelligems tests (price, offer, content, shipping). Every test arm must show and charge the right price.



5. QA

   Test every release before it goes
 devices, browsers, markets, currencies, languages, discounts. Keep a written QA checklist and a release log.



6. TRACKING

   Meta pixel and Conversions API, GA4, Google Ads, UTMs. Tracked purchases must match real orders.



7. SPEED

   Core Web Vitals, app and script cleanup, image loading. Mobile first.



8. APPS

   Install, audit and remove apps. Know what every script on the site does.



9. BUG FIXING

   Fix bugs fast, find the root cause, and make sure they do not come back.



10. DOCUMENTATION

   Document everything you build and change.











HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



- Zero customer-facing bugs from your releases

- Every test and offer charges exactly what the site shows

- Critical bugs fixed within 24 hours

- Tracked purchases match store orders

- Mobile page speed improving month over month











REQUIREMENTS



- 8+ years of web development, at least 5 of them on Shopify ecommerce stores

- Expert in Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Shopify theme architecture

- Back end: Shopify APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, Node.js or similar, custom apps

- Shopify Functions and checkout extensibility on Shopify Plus

- Hands-on Intelligems (or similar) price and content testing

- Strong QA habits: you test your own work before anyone else sees it

- Meta pixel, CAPI and GA4 setup and debugging

- Git, staging themes, version control

- Excellent written English

- Deadline discipline. If something will slip, you flag it before the due date, not after











NICE TO HAVE



- Multi-market, multi-currency and multi-language stores

- High-volume stores

- Klaviyo, bundle and upsell apps

- Hydrogen or headless experience











WHAT WE OFFER



- 3000 USD per month, long term, full time

- Several brands and real volume to work on

- Direct access to the decision makers. No layers, no politics











HOW TO APPLY



Generic applications are deleted. Answer all six points or do not apply.



1. Put the word CHECKPOINT at the very top of your message.



2. Links to 3 live Shopify stores you built or worked on, and exactly what you did on each.



3. One Shopify Function or checkout extension you built. What it did and how you tested it.



4. How you QA a cart discount change before it goes live. List your steps.



5. A bug of yours that reached customers. What happened and what you changed after.



6. Your available working hours in GMT+8 and your earliest start date.



Shortlisted candidates complete an unpaid trial task. Passing it is the gate to the final call with the team.

title: Head of Marketing — Paid Media, Retention & Ecommerce
description:
A profitable, growing US-based specialty tea CPG brand (~15% YoY, 130K+ lifetime orders, warehouses in the US, Canada, UK, and EU) selling primarily through Shopify and TikTok Shop, built on authentic sourcing, education, and a founder-creator with millions of followers who is, today, the company's entire marketing engine. The brand ships frequent new product lines (two launches in the next four months alone) and runs a quarterly subscription program (~2,000 members) that is the growth core. The founder built the entire business on organic content and the company has never run paid ads. Marketing today is a set of good ideas with no owner:
, loyalty, referrals, collabs, community, contests. Your job is to become that owner, and to build the machine around the founder's audience instead of depending on it.

One thing to know before you apply: nothing customer-facing here is AI-generated. All creative is real and hand-made. That is the brand's identity, not a policy. See "How this company uses AI" below; it will d
 whether this role is for you.



The role

You own marketing end to end. This is a content-led brand: high-quality entertainment and infotainment IS the acquisition engine, and everything you do in paid,
, and lifecycle has to interact coherently with the organic machine, not run beside it. You understand how paid and organic feed each other and you manage brand awareness as one system.

The mandate runs in a deliberate order. First, find the leaks and build the scoreboard: subscription drop-off, paused members, one-time buyers, and the KPI system to see it all. Second, stand up paid media and get the
 and lifecycle machine performing. Third, once the fundamentals run, expand into organic collaboration: creator collabs, bigger content plays, deeper integration with the founder's production. The wrong hire walks in asking for a big ad budget. The right hire walks in asking where the money is leaking and what the data says.

You are a player-coach, weighted toward player early. You personally run media strategy and media buying (today's AI-powered buying tools make this a one-person job at this scale) until the marketing arm grows enough to justify dedicated hands, at which point you help define that hire. The
 specialist reports to you and executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction. You'll also coordinate with the rest of the small team around marketing: a Shopify/ecommerce operations person and the founder's YouTube account manager.

On creative: you are close to a creative director who never creates. The founder is the creator. He likes performing, he WANTS to make ads, and he already has some in production. Your job is to make that enthusiasm strategic and intentional: understand the brand's edges and preferences deeply enough to direct
, paid media, and collab work cohesively without ever violating the ethos, and to tell him exactly what the data says he should make next. He will make you one great ad at a time, not fifteen mediocre ones.

This is not a strategy-deck job. You make tactical judgment calls on messaging, audiences, offers, and budget the same day they come up, and you push initiatives to done. The unofficial title is "the person who makes marketing ideas stop dying in the parking lot."



What you'll do

Find the leaks and build the scoreboard

Diagnose subscription drop-off: who leaves, when (the drop after box two and three is the known weak point), and why

Quantify how much meat is on the bone: lapsed members, paused subscriptions, one-time buyers who never subscribed,
 list segments that never converted



Think in the levers that multiply the business: LTV, AOV, CAC, churn, and net-new customers. When the data to see a lever doesn't exist, you fix the measurement system so it does

Run the win-back loop for paused and lapsed members, working with the internal AI survey systems that surface why people pause



Run paid media yourself

Launch paid ads from zero (Meta first, TikTok second) with an intro test budget, personally owning media strategy and buying with modern AI-powered tools



Approach ads from first principles: early paid is a learning instrument. Breaking even early on is a perfectly good outcome; the bar is don't bleed money while collecting the data that verifies hunches and shapes the growth plan, then refine and iterate from there



Run the full range deliberately: put cash behind organic content that's already working, test odd angles, and run boring direct-response ads. You have to be comfortable with both the weird and the boring

Build the creative testing plan around the founder's content and the ads he has in production; brief him on what to make next based on what the data says



Own holiday-season ad buying (Oct through Feb is the season)

Earn the budget: scale spend only as unit economics prove out, and be the person telling the founder when NOT to spend



Own
, lifecycle, and loyalty

Set strategy for and manage the
 specialist, who executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction

Evolve loyalty into a VIP program and fold the referral program into its tiers

Multiply LTV and AOV: bundles, premium tiers, subscription upgrades, win-backs

Expand the organic machine (stage two, after the fundamentals run)



Lead creator collab strategy, including YouTube collaborations: you set the strategy and direct it, with outreach and legwork resources added as the workload materializes

Surface-manage the content production workflow (the founder has a YouTube account manager) enough to keep it moving and connected to the rest of marketing

Deepen the paid-organic loop as both sides mature



Run the machine

Build the marketing calendar and own cross-channel coordination across Shopify and TikTok Shop: a constant new-product launch cadence (next two launches already scheduled for mid-September and November) and the holiday season

Direct the founder's creative production: batched, specific asks with clear briefs, on his rhythm

Run the AI marketing stack for analytics and orchestration, and teach: make sure the whole team understands what the numbers say and why



Be our eyes and ears on the marketing org: as channels prove out, you define the next roles the team needs and help us scope them



Who survives here

The founder runs this company as a creator and an artist. He will not work 70-hour weeks, he will not sit in frequent syncs, and he does not want to be managed hard. There are standing weekly team calls and brand-alignment checks; beyond that, you get batched, well-prepared asks and a lot of autonomy.

The person who thrives: a first-principles thinker who asks "what are the alternatives" and comes at problems from angles, cares deeply about brand ethos and being genuine, and is flexible and adaptable when the picture changes. Low ego, systems-builder, gets energy from ownership rather than access, treats the founder as a scarce production resource and designs the work around that constraint. A sense of humor is close to required: the brand runs on it. The person who fails: needs frequent alignment meetings, wants to "workshop the vision" repeatedly, bulldozes the founder's constraints in the name of growth, or is too proud to run boring ads.



How this company uses AI

The company runs a deliberate split: aggressive AI adoption in operations, a hard wall around anything creative or customer-facing. This role sits exactly on that line and has to hold it.



The wall (creative side)

- Nothing customer-facing is AI-generated. No AI images ever, no AI-written copy shipped as-is. This is brand identity, not a preference: the entire premise of the brand is that everything is real. Real sourcing trips, real photos, real people.

- The standard is cultural, not just a rule. Real example: product photos came back with dust on them right before a launch, the founder was unreachable, and the team spent hours manually retouching the dust out rather than AI-recreating the images, because they knew that is what he would want. That instinct is the hiring bar.

- AI-assisted drafting is tolerated only when the shipped output is written by hand or aggressively reviewed by hand. AI passing as human is the sin. A previous team member put an obviously AI-generated image into an internal test
; it never shipped and it was still treated as a serious culture violation.



The embrace (operations side)

- The company builds internal AI agents aggressively: live inventory and logistics answers for the CS team, a demand-prediction model for new products, and a customer survey loop that maps the customer journey.

- The founder's stated goal is a middle road: full transparency with the team about how AI is used, so nobody feels they are training their replacement, and AI kept as far from the creative side as possible.



What this means for you

- You manage the AI marketing setup: agent-driven ad analytics and orchestration (think "this ad is overperforming in one region, redivert budget"), AI-powered media buying, research, segmentation, reporting, workflow. Analytics and orchestration, yes. Generating ads, images, or copy that ships, no.

- You are also the translator: part of the job is making sure everyone on the team understands what the AI spend analytics say and why, in plain language.

- The founder believes AI slop is destroying trust in faceless content and low-tier influencer marketing, and that this brand's realness becomes MORE valuable as that happens. He has watched an agency lose his business by sending an unchecked AI-generated proposal. Pitching AI-generated creator content or mass AI outreach in your interview ends the interview.

title: Cold Caller Trainer | Process Trainer | BDR Trainer | New Hire Trainer | Onboarding Specialist
description:
About StoryGen

StoryGen (storygen.agency) is a growing B2B lead generation agency specializing in outbound sales and appointment setting. We help businesses build stronger sales pipelines by developing and managing dedicated Business Development Representative (BDR) teams.



Cold calling is central to our operations, and we combine proven sales techniques with structured workflows, modern technology, automation, and AI-powered tools to drive results.

As our team continues to expand, we're focused on building a training program that helps BDRs develop the skills, confidence, and consistency needed to succeed.



About the Role

We're hiring a BDR Trainer / Cold Caller Trainer to lead new-hire training, support BDR development, and improve overall calling performance.



In this role, you'll guide new team members through onboarding, introduce them to our sales processes and tools, and prepare them to handle real conversations with business decision-makers.



Your responsibilities will extend beyond initial training. You'll evaluate recorded calls, deliver constructive feedback, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide ongoing coaching to help BDRs strengthen their performance.



You'll also collaborate with Account Managers and leadership to refine training resources, improve coaching methods, and build repeatable processes that support a growing remote sales team.



Your impact will be measured through new-hire readiness, faster ramp-up times, improved call quality, stronger process adherence, and consistent BDR performance.



We're open to applicants with different professional backgrounds. While previous sales training experience is an advantage, we also welcome individuals who have demonstrated leadership, mentoring, coaching, or facilitation skills through work experience, internships, academic organizations, or other activities.



Key Responsibilities

1. BDR Onboarding & Training

- Facilitate onboarding sessions and structured training programs for newly hired BDRs.

- Train team members on cold calling techniques, sales scripts, prospect qualification, objection handling, and effective conversation flow.

- Familiarize new hires with the sales platforms, tools, and daily workflows used across campaigns.

- Communicate performance expectations, activity targets, KPIs, and call quality standards.

- Monitor training progress, provide timely feedback, and address learning gaps.

- Assess each BDR's readiness before transitioning into independent campaign execution.



2. Call Reviews & Performance Coaching

- Listen to recorded sales calls and evaluate communication effectiveness, script delivery, and overall call execution.

- Provide practical coaching on confidence, tone, active listening, objection handling, and prospect engagement.

- Help BDRs develop natural conversations rather than relying solely on scripted responses.

- Recognize recurring performance issues and implement targeted improvement plans.

- Offer additional coaching and guidance to BDRs who need support meeting performance expectations.

- Encourage consistent execution of proven calling techniques and quality standards.



3. Training Resources & Documentation

- Develop, organize, and regularly update training guides, onboarding materials, and internal learning resources.

- Create call frameworks, objection-handling references, coaching templates, and practical sales playbooks.

- Maintain up-to-date script libraries and training documentation.

- Document effective sales techniques and incorporate them into future training sessions.

- Revise learning materials to reflect changes in company processes, technology, and outbound strategies.

- Build structured resources that make training more consistent and easier to scale.



4. Sales Enablement & Continuous Improvement

- Coordinate with Account Managers and leadership to identify training priorities and performance challenges.

- Analyze common skill gaps and recommend coaching initiatives to address them.

- Support the adoption of AI-powered call analysis, training, and coaching tools.

- Gather feedback and use performance insights to continuously improve the training program.

- Help establish standardized training practices as the BDR team grows.



Qualifications & Skills

We're interested in candidates who enjoy developing people, communicating ideas clearly, and helping others improve their performance.



Previous experience as a professional trainer is not required. Recent graduates and early-career professionals are encouraged to apply if they can demonstrate relevant skills through previous employment, internships, student leadership, volunteer work, or extracurricular activities.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to explain concepts clearly and confidently.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Experience coaching, mentoring, training, or guiding others

- Strong leadership skills, whether formal or informal

- Confident and clear communicator

- The ability to give clear, constructive, and actionable feedback

- A structured and organized approach to training

- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset

- Strong attention to performance and measurable improvement

- Good documentation and training-content creation skills

- A positive and motivating presence while maintaining high standards and accountability



How to Apply

As part of our selection process, applicants will be required to complete an assessment and submit the following through the application link:



- Updated Resume

- Internet Speed Test Result

- Short Loom Audio Recording (Guide questions will be provided within the assessment)



Ready to Join StoryGen?



If you enjoy helping people learn, building their confidence, and turning feedback into measurable improvement, this could be a great opportunity for you.



Join us in developing high-performing BDRs and building a training program that supports long-term team success.



Apply here:

description:

channels directly. As our team grows, you will lead our channel specialists. You will report directly to our

founder and work as a trusted partner in growing the business.



You will run Instagram,

until our YouTube expert joins. Our LinkedIn Expert and Newsletter Growth Manager own LinkedIn and

We do not want AI produced content or AI generated strategy. We are hiring your expertise, your creative

judgment, and your proven ability to take a brand new business and make it thrive across social media.



This is a ground floor opportunity for someone who wants to build something meaningful and grow with

us for the long term. As the company grows, so will this role and the team you lead.





CANDIDATES WHO HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

Complete a full application.  Details are found in the HOW TO APPLY section.





WHAT YOU WILL DO

and a clear plan and KPIs for every channel.

● Run our social channels directly: plan the content calendar, write hooks and captions, publish, and

manage community engagement every day.

videos, and a growing, monetized
 presence.

and click through rate, and turn them into smarter content decisions.

● Drive results beyond followers: use UTM tracking and clear calls to action to turn social attention into

tour bookings, private tours, gift card sales, and newsletter sign ups.

● Build partnerships that expand our reach, including creator and influencer collaborations, user

generated content, and spotlights with our partner ice cream shops.

● Direct our video team with clear creative briefs, so every video has a purpose.

● Lead our LinkedIn Expert and Newsletter Growth Manager, help hire future specialists, and build the

workflows, SOPs, and brand standards for a growing department.

● Deliver one clear weekly report across all channels, with results, insights, and next steps.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



● 6+ years of hands-on marketing and social media management experience, with proven results backed

by real data and analytics.

● A track record of launching or growing a brand from the early stages across multiple social platforms.

● Deep, current knowledge of how each platform works: its audience, content formats, algorithm, and

what drives reach and engagement.

● Strong short form video instincts, including hooks, pacing, trends, and the first three seconds that stop

the scroll.

● Experience turning social media into measurable business results, not just likes and followers.

● Experience leading and developing marketing specialists, freelancers, or a team.

● Your own expertise, strategy, and creative ideas, not AI produced content or plans.

● A consistent track record of long term engagements with employers or clients, typically two years or

more.

● Works independently, communicates proactively, and follows through on every commitment.

● A positive, can do attitude, warmth with people, and a genuine love of teamwork and good vibes.

● Clear, confident, professional spoken and written English, and professionally presentable on video

calls.



Preferred: experience with paid social and Meta Ads Manager,
 
, and marketing

tourism, hospitality, food, events, or consumer brands.



This role is open to candidates in any country at the stated USD pay, as long as you meet every

requirement and can work during our US Central Time hours.



SCHEDULE & PAY



● 30 to 35 hours per week, Monday through Friday, fully remote

● Core hours 10 AM to 4 PM US Central Time, with some flexibility in hours and timing based on business needs

● Weekly team meeting, Tuesdays 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM US Central Time (required)

● Optional online team events, held at various times

● $6 to $9 per hour, plus potential bonus based on results

● Independent contractor

GOOD VIBES ONLY COMPANY



We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation, and fun as a company culture. We perform with

excellence and have a good time along the way.

Subject line: Write your own
 subject line. Make us want to open your
.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Fashion Brand, Reels/TikTok/Paid Social)
description:
Easy Clothes USA is a fast-growing women's fashion brand based in Los Angeles. We sell online and are very active on Instagram, TikTok and paid social. We are looking for a truly exceptional short-form video editor to join our marketing team.



Please read this carefully. We are NOT looking for an average editor or someone doing this as a side gig. We want someone who lives and breathes short-form content, has real taste in fashion and visuals, and takes pride in every frame they deliver.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit vertical short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

- Turn raw footage (collection launches, promotions, UGC, everyday content) into polished, scroll-stopping videos

- Create paid social ads focused on conversion: strong hooks, clear offers, clear calls to action

- Create organic content that feels natural and native to each platform

- Create variations of videos for testing (different hooks, lengths, angles)

- Work with our Head of Marketing and creative team on briefs and feedback



WHO YOU ARE

- 2+ years of professional short-form video editing experience

- A great eye for fashion, typography and visual style

- You understand the difference between organic content and paid ads, and you edit differently for each

- You know what makes a great hook and how to keep viewers watching

- You keep up with trends, sounds and formats on TikTok and Instagram

- Expert in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut or After Effects

- Fast, reliable, organized and great at taking feedback

- Good written English and a computer that can handle 4K footage



DETAILS

- Part time, 20 hours per week

- $550 USD per month

- Long-term role with room to grow as the brand grows

- Remote, with some overlap with US Pacific Time for meetings



HOW TO APPLY: EDITING EXERCISE REQUIRED

To apply, you must complete our editing exercise. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



DEADLINE: Monday, October 12, 2026



Download the raw footage here:





The folder contains raw footage for three scenarios. Create ONE vertical video for each (3 videos total):



1. COLLECTION LAUNCH

A video that introduces a new collection on Reels, TikTok or Shorts. Show us how you set the mood and identity of the collection, pick the strongest fashion moments, and handle pacing, music, text and transitions. Polished, but still native to social.



2. PAID SOCIAL AD

A conversion-focused ad for a sale/promotion. Show us your opening hook, how you communicate the offer, product visibility, on-screen text and call to action, while still feeling like a fashion brand. We want to see how your approach changes when the goal is sales instead of storytelling.



3. EVERYDAY UGC CONTENT

The footage here is casual and less produced. Turn it into an engaging, natural, social-first video we could post between bigger launches.



You do not need to use all the footage. Choosing the best moments is part of the test. There is no required length, song, font or style. We want to see your own creative instincts. Don't make it complex just to show off. We care about whether your choices make sense for the goal of each video.



For each video, add a few sentences or bullet points covering:

- Intended platform and use

- Creative objective

- Your editing approach and why you made those choices

- Other variations you would test if editing for us regularly



HOW TO SUBMIT

1. Create a Google Drive folder with your 3 videos and your notes

2. Set sharing to "Anyone with the link can view" (we will not request access, so if we can't open it, we can't review it)

3. Send us the folder link through your OnlineJobs application with:

   - The words "FASHION EDITOR" at the start of your message

   - A link to your portfolio

   - Your weekly availability and the software you use



All submissions must be received by Monday, October 12, 2026.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Creative judgment, editing quality, fashion and visual sense, finding strong moments in raw footage, pacing and storytelling, hooks and retention, typography, clear product and offer messaging, and overall fit with the Easy Clothes brand.



Your submitted videos are used for internal evaluation only and will not be published or used commercially without a separate agreement.



We can't wait to see your work!

title: Appointment Setter Who Books (Not Logs) | US Accounting Firm | Tue–Fri 10am–2pm Mountain | Performance Pay
description:
This is a booking job, not a calling job. We count dials, but we pay for meetings that show. If you’re the setter who gets more yeses than the people around you and you’re tired of a flat hourly that pays the same whether you book or not, read on. If you want a quiet shift leaving voi
s, this isn’t it.



About us - Powers Advisory is a US accounting firm doing bookkeeping, job costing and taxes for construction contractors across the United States. The owner, Parker, is a hands-on founder who answers his own phone. You would be the first voice our prospects hear, and the reason they get on his calendar.



The Job - Call US contractor owners from a list we build for you (name, company, trade, city, phone, licensed for years, so these are real businesses). Short conversational script, you make it your own after week one. Your one goal on every call: get the owner to say yes to a free 20-minute “Books Diagnostic” kickoff, and book it live on the founder’s Calendly while they’re still on the phone. You don’t quote prices beyond one sentence we give you, and you don’t need to: the offer is free and good, your job is to make the owner want it in 40 seconds. Every dial logged in a shared Google Sheet, one-line summary at the end of each shift.



The numbers we expect - 100 dials per 4-hour shift. 15 to 20 real owner conversations. 2 booked per shift once you’re warmed up. We review recordings weekly and we’ll tell you exactly where calls are being lost. Setters who hit the numbers get more hours and a raise at 90 days. Setters who don’t after 30 days are replaced. We’d rather say that here than surprise you.



Hours - Part-time, 16 hours a week: Tuesday through Friday, 4 hours a day, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Mountain Time. In Manila, that is 12:00 midnight to 4:00 AM (1:00 to 5:00 AM from November through March). This is a fixed overnight block; please apply only if you can work it every week, long term.



Pay - $7 to $10 USD per hour base depending on experience, plus $15 for every booked meeting that shows up, plus $100 extra any month you hit 20 shows. A setter doing 10 shows a week clears roughly $1,200 to $1,400 a month at 16 hours a week. Paid weekly via Wise. Paid 10-call trial first ($20), then 30 days, then ongoing.



Requirements - 

Fluent, clear, easily understood spoken English with a neutral accent. Our customers are US tradespeople on noisy job sites; they must understand you the first time, every time. The voice memo below tests this and nothing else gets you past it.

At least one year of US outbound phone work with real booking or sales numbers you can state: appointment setting, telemarketing, or phone sales. Chat or
 support does not count.

Comfortable with blue-collar business owners. Direct, warm, quick on your feet. You hear “we already have a bookkeeper” and you have a next sentence.

Quiet workspace, stable internet, headset, on time every shift.

Google Sheets and Calendly (we train the specifics).



How to apply (all four, or you’re skipped) - 

1. Most recently updated resume.

2. Your numbers from your last US phone role: what you were booking or selling, dials per day, bookings or sales per week, and how long you held the job.

3. A 30 to 45 second voice memo reading this naturally, as if on a real call:

“Hi, is this Mike? This is Sam calling for Powers Advisory. Quick one, I know you’re busy. We do books, job costing, and business taxes for contractors like yours, one flat fee starting at $599 a month, taxes included. Right now we're offering a free 48-hour books diagnostic. Is knowing your real margin by job something you’d want to see?”

4. In the same memo, without stopping, answer this objection in your own words: “Yeah, we’ve got a bookkeeper already.”



**Put the word DIAGNOSTIC in the first line of your application so we know you read this far.

Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with designers, video editors, and other creative team members to support larger or more advanced content pieces.

Qualifications: 



- Portfolio or examples demonstrating social media content creation, including both written and visual content. 



- Strong written English with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences, platforms, and brand voices. 



- Experience creating content for platforms such as Instagram,
, YouTube, and/or TikTok. 



- Comfortable using Canva or similar content-creation tools to produce simple, polished social media graphics and Stories. 



- Understanding of social media content strategy, audience engagement, hooks, calls to action, and platform-specific content. 



- Experience with social media scheduling or publishing tools is preferred. 



- Strong judgment when creating and responding to content involving faith, mental health, privacy, sensitive personal experiences, and community engagement. 



- Ability to distinguish strategic social content from simply repeating information already contained in a flyer, announcement, or promotional asset. 



- Ability to balance creativity with organizational goals, brand guidelines, and audience needs. 



- Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through. 



Work begins on a freelance and project-based basis, and there are no guaranteed minimum hours or workload at launch.

Open questions / items needing client decision

title: Medicare Care Management Program Coordinator
description:
# Medicare Care Management Program Coordinator



**Remote | Full-Time | RN or Physician Required | U.S. Healthcare Experience Required**



Willow Park Health is a growing behavioral health practice providing psychiatric and therapy services to senior living communities in New York.



We are seeking an **experienced Medicare Care Management Program Coordinator** to help us rapidly launch, manage, and scale:



* Behavioral Health Integration (BHI)

* Principal Care Management (PCM)

* Chronic Care Management (CCM)

* Transitional Care Management (TCM)

* Community Health Integration (CHI)

* Collaborative Care Model (CoCM)



## Responsibilities



* Build and implement Medicare care-management workflows

* Identify and track eligible patients

* Coordinate patient enrollment and consent

* Develop and maintain care-management registries

* Coordinate care plans and monthly follow-up

* Track required activities and billable time

* Ensure documentation meets Medicare/CMS requirements

* Coordinate with PMHNPs, nurses, therapists, PCPs, and care coordinators

* Perform pre-billing documentation and compliance reviews

* Support billing, claims, and denial resolution

* Monitor program KPIs and identify workflow gaps

* Help scale the program across multiple senior living communities



## Must-Have Requirements



**Applicants must meet the following requirements:**



* **Registered Nurse (RN) or Physician (MD)**

* **Direct experience with U.S. Medicare care-management programs**

* Hands-on experience with **CCM and/or BHI**

* Strong working knowledge of **Medicare/CMS care-management requirements**

* Experience with patient eligibility, enrollment, consent, care plans, and monthly follow-up

* Experience tracking **billable care-management activities and time**

* Understanding of relevant **CPT/HCPCS codes and billing requirements**

* Experience reviewing clinical documentation for billing and compliance

* Experience working with a **U.S.-based healthcare practice**

* Experience using an EHR/EMR or care-management platform

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail

* Ability to work independently and manage a high-volume patient registry

* Ability to work **U.S. Eastern Time business hours**

* Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote-work environment



**This is not a general VA or medical administrative position. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on Medicare care-management expertise.**



## Preferred Experience



Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



* PCM, TCM, CHI, and/or CoCM

* Psychiatry or behavioral health

* Medicare and geriatric populations

* Assisted living or senior living

* Primary care

* Medicare billing and claims

* Care-management registries and KPI tracking

* HIPAA-compliant remote healthcare operations

* SimplePractice or similar EHR systems

* Launching or scaling a CCM/BHI program



## How to Apply



Please answer the following:



1. Are you an **RN or physician**? Please specify your degree/license.

2. Which programs have you personally worked with: **BHI, PCM, CCM, TCM, CHI, and/or CoCM?**

3. How many years of U.S. Medicare care-management experience do you have?

4. What were your specific responsibilities?

5. Approximately how many care-management patients did you manage each month?

6. Did you personally handle eligibility, enrollment, consent, care plans, time tracking, documentation, billing, and/or claims?

7. Which CPT/HCPCS care-management codes have you worked with?

8. Which EHR/EMR and care-management platforms have you used?

9. Briefly explain how you would help us **launch a BHI/CCM program within your first 30 days**.

10. Please send a **1-minute video introduction** describing your relevant Medicare care-management experience.



**Please do not apply if your experience is limited to general virtual assistance, scheduling, or medical administration. Direct Medicare care-management experience is required.**

Call back old customers and past quotes

Weekends off

Clear, confident, neutral American-sounding English. Customers must understand you easily.

Real phone experience: BPO, call center, appointment setting, or cold calling

Stable internet: minimum 15 Mbps, hardwired preferred

Nice to have (not required)



Experience with home services (junk removal, moving, cleaning, landscaping, HVAC, roofing)

Sales instinct: you can turn a price-shopper into a booked job



Pay



$350 – $520 USD/month depending on experience

5%  commission if the meeting you book to get hired turns into a paying job

Performance bonuses for booked jobs once you’re up to speed

Raises based on results, reviewed at 90 days

Paid training during your first week



HOW TO GET THIS JOB: READ CAREFULLY



We don’t hire based on resumes. We hire people who can actually book meetings on the phone. So your application is a real call.



The challenge



Find an apartment community or property management company in Middle Tennessee, USA (Nashville, Murfreesboro, Franklin, Clarksville, Smyrna, Lebanon, Gallatin, Hendersonville, and nearby). Google Maps works fine.

Call them using the script below.

Book a 10–15 minute meeting for our owner, Trey, to stop by the property. Meetings can be booked any day Monday through Friday, during business hours Central Time.



Book a meeting and you’re hired. If that meeting turns into a paying job, you also earn commission on it.



Once you book a meeting, send me a message with:



The word “DUMPSTER” at the very start so I know you read the whole post

Property name, address, and phone number

The name, title, and
 of the person you spoke to

The meeting day and time you booked

2–3 sentences about your phone experience (inbound, outbound, or both, and what kind of business)

Your internet speed, and confirmation that you have backup internet and backup power

Confirmation that you can work 8 AM – 5 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday



We’ll confirm every meeting with the property directly. Fake or made-up meetings = instant disqualification.



Rules



Be polite and professional. You’re representing Dirty South Junk Removal.

If they say no, thank them and move on. Do not call the same property twice.

Only book meetings Monday through Friday. No weekends.



THE SCRIPT



Intro



“Hey, my name is [YOUR NAME]. I’m with Dirty South Junk Removal.



Listen, I know you guys probably already have somebody you use when bulk items start piling up: mattresses, couches, furniture, stuff people dump from off-property, things residents leave around the dumpster, or items left behind during apartment trash-outs.



Just out of curiosity, how often are you guys having to call your current vendor out to handle that stuff?”



[LET THEM ANSWER]



“Okay, awesome. So it sounds like it is something that comes up and you guys do need somebody for it.”



Why I’m calling



“We work with a lot of property managers throughout Middle Tennessee. And just so you know, we’re not calling trying to immediately replace your current vendor.



A lot of properties started using us simply because they needed another reliable option, especially when something needs to happen fast. Maybe ownership is coming to the property. Maybe there’s an inspection nobody knew about. Maybe you have units that need to turn ASAP. Or your normal vendor is just slammed and can’t meet your timeline.



That’s where we’ve been able to fill the gap.”



Price / value



“Another reason properties have started using us is cost. With some of the properties we work with, we’ve been able to save them around $500 a month compared with what they were previously spending on junk removal.



We’re a local, veteran-owned company, and we don’t have the massive overhead some of the larger companies have. So we can keep our operation profitable while passing a lot of those savings back to the properties we work with.”



Legal disposal



“We also have a solid-waste permit, so you know where your junk is actually going. It goes where it’s supposed to go, not dumped at somebody else’s apartment community.



You’ve probably seen guys who will haul away a mattress or couch unbelievably cheap. Sometimes there’s a reason they can do it that cheap. That couch gets picked up from your property and suddenly ends up beside somebody else’s compactor or in another property’s open-top dumpster.



We make sure everything we haul is properly disposed of.”



Ask for the meeting



“The owner, Trey, actually asked me to reach out. What we’d love to do is have him swing by sometime this week.



He’ll bring some goodies for the team, introduce himself, drop off some information, and take maybe 10–15 minutes to look around the property with you. He can see where your problem dumping areas are and get an idea of what you guys normally deal with.



He’s also helped properties reduce illegal dumping, not just clean it up after it happens. There are a few things he’s learned working with apartment communities that properties can do to discourage residents and outsiders from dumping in certain areas.



So even if you absolutely love your current vendor, it could still be worthwhile to meet Trey and have another local company in your back pocket.



What day works best for you this week, Monday through Friday? Is morning or afternoon better?”



[LET THEM ANSWER]



If yes



“Perfect. I’ll get that scheduled. What’s the best
 for the calendar invite?”



[GET
]



“Awesome. I’ll send that over so you have it on your calendar. We’ll also follow up either the day before or the morning of, just to remind you that Trey is swinging by. If anything changes before then, just let us know and we can always move it around.



Thank you so much. I hope you have a blessed day. Bye-bye!”



If they say: “We already have somebody.”



“Absolutely, and we’re not asking you to get rid of them. Honestly, we’d rather just become your backup option.



If your normal vendor can’t get there quickly enough, their price comes back higher than expected, or you have an emergency before an inspection or ownership visit, you have somebody else you already know you can call.



That’s really why Trey wants to introduce himself. What day this week would work for a quick introduction?”



If they say: “We don’t have much junk.”



“That’s actually great. And Trey doesn’t need to come out and give you some big sales presentation. It’s really just an introduction, so that when something does happen, you already have somebody local you can call instead of trying to find a company at the last minute.



What day this week would work for him to stop by for about 10 minutes?”



If they say: “Just send me information.”



“Absolutely, I can do that. What’s the best
 for you?”



[GET
]



“Perfect. And actually, since Trey is already going to be in the area, why don’t I have him stop by for just a few minutes and put a face to the name? He can drop the information off personally, introduce himself, and then get out of your hair.



What day this week works best for you?”



I review every application that follows the instructions. If you booked a real meeting, you’ll hear from me within a few days:

title: Digital Marketer for Kathleen Wood Partners
description:
Digital Marketing Strategist — Social Media, Growth & Community



Kathleen Wood Partners is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Strategist who can help us strengthen our online presence, grow our community, and turn our digital channels into a consistent source of qualified leads and new clients.



We are not looking for someone who simply posts content on social media.



We need someone who understands how to look at a consulting business, understand its audience and offers, identify opportunities, and develop a clear strategy for growth.



About Kathleen Wood Partners

Kathleen Wood Partners is an innovative and award-winning growth strategy firm dedicated to propelling Founder-led businesses to new levels of success.



Our marketing needs to reflect the strength of our expertise while helping us:

* Increase brand awareness

* Reach more qualified founders and business owners

* Generate potential client opportunities

* Build an engaged community

* Strengthen Kathleen Wood’s personal brand

* Position Kathleen Wood Partners as a trusted authority

* Create a consistent strategy across
, Instagram, and LinkedIn



What We’re Looking For

You should have strong experience with:

*
 marketing

* Instagram marketing

* LinkedIn marketing

* Organic social media growth

* Content strategy

* Personal brand marketing

* Lead generation

* Community building

* Marketing funnels and calls to action

* Analytics and performance tracking



Experience working with consulting companies, coaches, professional services firms, founder-led brands, or B2B businesses is strongly preferred.



We want someone who can think strategically and tell us:



What should we be doing?

Why should we be doing it?

How will it help grow the business?

How will we measure whether it is working?



Your Responsibilities

You will help us develop and execute a digital marketing strategy for Kathleen Wood Partners, including:



* Reviewing our current website and social media presence

* Identifying gaps and opportunities

* Developing a social media growth strategy

* Creating a content strategy for
, Instagram, and LinkedIn

* Identifying opportunities to generate leads from our content

* Developing strategies to grow and engage our community

* Recommending content pillars and campaign ideas

* Improving our calls to action and customer journey

* Helping turn followers and engagement into conversations and potential clients

* Reviewing analytics and adjusting the strategy based on results

* Creating a clear marketing plan rather than simply posting content



IMPORTANT — Please Review Us Before Applying



Before submitting your application, please research Kathleen Wood Partners.



Review:

* Our website - 

* Our
 presence

* Our Instagram

* Our LinkedIn presence



We do not want generic applications or copy-and-paste marketing proposals.



In your application, answer these questions:

1. After reviewing Kathleen Wood Partners, what are the top 3 opportunities you see for improving our social media and digital marketing?

2. What do you think we are currently missing?

3. If you were hired, what would your first 30 days look like?

4. How would you use
, Instagram, and LinkedIn differently for our business?

5. How would you help us turn our audience into a community and eventually into qualified leads or clients?

6. Please share 2–3 examples of companies or personal brands you have helped grow. Include actual results whenever possible.



Examples may include:

* Growth in qualified leads

* Increased engagement

* Revenue generated

* Audience/community growth

* Improved conversion rates

* Successful campaigns

* Client acquisition



Please explain what you personally did to achieve those results.



Who Will Stand Out

You will stand out if you come to us with ideas.



We want someone who can look at Kathleen Wood Partners and say:



“I studied your business. Here is what I see. Here is what I would change. Here is what I would test. And here is how I believe we can grow.”



We value strategic thinking, creativity, initiative, accountability, and measurable results.



If your experience is primarily posting graphics, writing captions, or scheduling social media without developing the underlying strategy, this position will probably not be the right fit.



We are looking for someone who understands marketing, business growth, positioning, community building, and client acquisition — not just social media management.



If this sounds like you, we’d love to review your application.

title: Virtual Receptionist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Virtual Receptionist to serve as the front-line point of contact for a U.S. medical, dental, or clinical practice. This role requires someone who is comfortable speaking directly with American patients, managing appointment schedules, working inside an EHR, and supporting patient follow-up and insurance-related tasks.



The ideal candidate has hands-on U.S. healthcare front-desk experience and can independently manage patient calls, scheduling, recall/reactivation, and insurance verification.



Key Responsibilities

Answer live inbound calls from U.S. patients in a professional, friendly, and patient-focused manner.

Handle patient questions, appointment requests, cancellations, rescheduling, and general front-desk inquiries.

Book, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments directly within the practice's EHR system.

Maintain accurate patient demographics, appointment details, and other information in the EHR.

Run recall and reactivation lists, including:

Pulling the appropriate patient report/list.

Calling patients who are due for follow-up or have become inactive.

Speaking with patients about scheduling their next visit.

Rebooking patients and documenting the outcome.

Perform or assist with insurance verification for U.S. patients prior to appointments.

Collect and verify patient information required for visits.

Follow up with patients regarding appointments, paperwork, referrals, or other practice requirements.

Accurately document patient interactions and scheduling activity in the appropriate system.

Maintain patient confidentiality and follow applicable privacy and practice procedures.

Provide a professional and welcoming patient experience on every call.

Required Qualifications

Previous experience working as a front-desk receptionist, scheduler, patient coordinator, or virtual receptionist for a U.S. medical, dental, or clinical practice.

Demonstrated experience answering live inbound patient calls for a U.S. healthcare practice.

Hands-on experience booking and rescheduling patients inside an EHR.

Must be able to name the EHR system(s) used in previous healthcare roles.

Experience running a recall or reactivation workflow, including pulling a report/list, calling patients, and successfully rebooking them.

Experience performing insurance verification for a U.S. medical, dental, or clinical practice.

Strong spoken English that is clear and easily understood by American patients.

Excellent phone etiquette, listening skills, and patient communication.

Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry.

Ability to handle multiple calls, scheduling requests, and administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable working independently in a remote setting.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Senior Customer Success Manager (Enterprise SaaS) – Remote (Philippines-Based)

Compensation up to 60,000 php per month



THE COMPANY

DTiQ is a global leader in intelligent video-based surveillance and loss prevention solutions, helping businesses improve operations and protect their assets. With over 20 years of experience and more than 45,000 customers worldwide—including well-known brands like Adidas, Burger King, Hard Rock Café, KFC, McDonald’s, US Polo, and Yankee Candle—DTiQ supports over 8 million customer experiences every day.



We are proud to offer a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are encouraged to learn, develop new skills, and build long-term careers.



For more information on DTiQ visit our website (
) or our LinkedIn page (www.
/company/dtiq).



THE ROLE

We’re looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Customer Success Manager based in the Philippines that has experience working in the hospitality industry, to support our growing portfolio of enterprise SaaS clients in the QSR (Quick Serve Restaurant) space. This is a fully remote role where you’ll collaborate closely with a US-based team and play a key role in driving customer value, retention, and growth.



Application Link: 



What You’ll Do

• Manage and grow relationships with large enterprise customers, ensuring long-term success and satisfaction

• Lead and organize Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with key stakeholders

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Support teams (including US-based colleagues)

• Identify opportunities for account growth, expansion, and increased product adoption

• Act as the voice of the customer and advocate for improvements with internal teams

• Deliver a high standard of service with strong attention to detail and follow-through



What We’re Looking For

• Experience working in the hospitality industry 

• 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role

• Proven experience managing enterprise-level SaaS accounts

• Experience working with US-based clients or companies (comfortable with time zone overlap)

• Strong background in SaaS environments, ideally in companies with $25M+ ARR

• Demonstrated ability to lead QBRs and drive customer engagement strategies

• Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written)

• Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail

• Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and urgency

• Collaborative team player who thrives in fast-paced, remote environments



Why Join Us

• Work directly with a global, high-growth SaaS company

• Competitive compensation aligned with top Philippine market rates

• Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements

• Opportunities for career growth and exposure to international clients

• Be part of a supportive, respectful, and high-performing team



HOW TO APPLY



Application Link: 



As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.



What to expect:

We understand that this process may be different from traditional application methods commonly used in the Philippines, such as submitting resumes via email or by job postings. Our HRIS system will require you to:

• Create a profile with a username and password for you to access throughout the recruiting process and if hired, it will be used for timekeeping and payroll.

• Re-enter details already included in your resume (this helps us standardize globally). We recognize this may seem repetitive but it ensures your profile is properly integrated into our global system which is necessary to schedule interviews and onboard.

• Upload supporting documents such as your CV.



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates. The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment. This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity and allows us to comply with legal regulations. This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day-to-day with our team. Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations. DTiQ will manage your daily work, performance and career development. If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you.



Is my data secure?

Yes, the system complies with international data privacy standards and your information will only be accessed by authorized personnel.



What if I experience technical issues?

If you have any trouble in the Rippling system, please reply to this message so we can assist you properly.



We truly appreciate your time and effort in completing these next steps. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out – I’m here to help.



At DTiQ, we value dedication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. If you are looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply and be part of our global team.

title: Personal Executive Assistant / Operations & Hiring Coordinator (Healthcare Tech Startup)

1. SUPPORTING THE FOUNDER

- Inbox and calendar management: triage
, draft replies, schedule and reschedule across time zones

- Book travel, build itineraries, handle reservations and expense tracking

- Run weekly check-ins, publish agendas beforehand and notes with owners afterwards

- Onboard new team members: accounts, access, equipment, and a first-week plan

- 3+ years as an executive assistant, chief of staff, ops coordinator, or similar, ideally in a startup

- Real experience coordinating other people's work and following up without being asked

- Some recruiting exposure: screening, scheduling, or managing a hiring pipeline

- Excellent written and spoken English, since you'll represent us to candidates and partners

- Strong with Google Workspace; comfortable in Notion, Slack, and ATS or project tools, and quick to learn new ones

- Extremely organised. Nothing falls through the cracks

- Comfortable holding people accountable politely but firmly

- Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information, including hiring and pay discussions

- Reliable internet and a quiet space for calls

- Able to overlap with US business hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in healthcare, SaaS, or an early-stage startup

- Experience hiring on OnlineJobs.ph or similar platforms

- Light bookkeeping or basic design skills



THE DETAILS

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 100% remote

- Long-term role with real scope to grow as the team grows

- Performance and pay review after 3 months, paid monthly



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with the subject line "EA Ops - Elva" so we know you've read the full post, and include:

1. The founder or executive you most recently supported, and what you handled for them

2. A time you coordinated a team or project to a deadline, and how you handled someone falling behind
