**Schedule:** 40 hours per week, with occasional additional hours as business needs require

**Working Hours:** [Insert required U.S. time zone and schedule]

**Compensation:** [Insert salary range and payment details]



## About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based home services company seeking a dependable, detail-oriented full-time bookkeeper in the Philippines. You will oversee the company’s day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll coordination, invoicing, collections, commissions, and financial records.



This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, and keeps financial information accurate and organized. You will work closely with company leadership, team members in the United States and abroad, and our external accountant.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping and Financial Records



- Maintain accurate and organized records in QuickBooks.

- Categorize and reconcile transactions, accounts, and payments.

- Keep financial information current and identify discrepancies promptly.

- Prepare regular reports that give management a clear view of the company’s financial position.

- Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.



### JobNimbus and Invoicing



- Maintain the financial side of our JobNimbus CRM.

- Confirm that customer invoices are accurate, complete, and issued on time.

- Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue balances.

- Record payments and keep customer account information current.

- Assess applicable late fees according to company policies.

- Perform other collection-related activities to help ensure timely payment.

- Reconcile financial information between JobNimbus and QuickBooks.



### Weekly Payroll



- Verify hours submitted by team members in the United States and abroad.

- Identify missing, inaccurate, or unusual time entries before payroll is processed.

- Prepare and coordinate weekly payroll for U.S.-based and international team members.

- Maintain accurate payroll records and resolve payroll discrepancies.

- Protect confidential employee and payroll information.



### Commissions and Spreadsheets



- Maintain spreadsheets used to calculate commissions and other team compensation.

- Verify commission amounts against completed jobs, collected payments, and company policies.

- Provide accurate commission reports before payments are approved.

- Maintain organized and auditable spreadsheet records.



### Accountant Coordination



- Coordinate with our external accountant regarding filings and financial reporting.

- Provide requested records and supporting documents accurately and on time.

- Help ensure the accountant has the information needed for tax filings, compliance, and year-end reporting.

- Respond promptly to questions and resolve missing-information requests.



### General Financial Administration



- Manage other financial and bookkeeping responsibilities as needed.

- Improve financial processes and help maintain strong internal controls.

- Communicate financial concerns, overdue accounts, and discrepancies to management.

- Meet recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual deadlines.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.

- Experience processing or coordinating payroll.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience with invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections.

- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.

- Excellent organization, time-management, and follow-up skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to handle confidential financial and payroll information professionally.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet workspace.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively with a remote team.

- Willingness to work the required U.S. business hours and occasional additional hours when needed.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using JobNimbus or a similar home-services CRM.

- Bookkeeping experience with a U.S.-based company.

- Experience in roofing, construction, contracting, or another home-services industry.

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and basic accounting practices.

- Experience calculating sales commissions or performance-based compensation.

- Experience working directly with an external accountant or CPA.



## What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



- Keep QuickBooks and JobNimbus accurate and up to date.

- Ensure weekly payroll is prepared correctly and on time.

- Make sure invoices are issued promptly and actively followed up until collected.

- Maintain accurate commission calculations and supporting records.

- Give management timely visibility into financial issues.

- Provide complete, organized information to our accountant.

- Take ownership of financial tasks without requiring constant reminders.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your résumé or CV.

2. A brief description of your bookkeeping experience.

3. Details about your experience with QuickBooks, payroll, invoicing, collections, and spreadsheets.

4. Any experience you have with JobNimbus or another CRM.

5. Your preferred monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

6. Your availability and ability to work [insert required U.S. time zone].

7. Your internet speed and backup plans for internet or power interruptions.

8. The names of two professional references.



Please begin your application with the words **“Organized Finances”** so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Senior Bookkeeper
description:
First things first...

This is a 100% remote position that requires 0–10% travel and has a salary range of 1,700-1,900/month USD, plus 13th-month pay. This is a full-time, monthly salaried position. You will be required to work Central Standard Time business hours. 



We are looking for a seasoned accounting professional who can take ownership of daily accounting operations, confidently solve problems, and deliver accurate financials with minimal oversight. 



Does working on a variety of projects, contributing to different types of workflows, never having the same day twice in a row sound exciting to you? Are you a financial wizard with a passion for precision and a love for meaningful work? Us too.. That’s why we started Atomus Partners!



If you're ready to elevate your career in accounting, we have an exciting opportunity that awaits you!



What We Do

Atomus -- the Latin word for atoms, which are the basic building blocks of the universe. At Atomus Partners, we operate as a back-office nucleus, allowing the organization to focus on what it does best - its core business. We remove the common challenges small and medium-sized businesses often struggle with in developing, growing, and maintaining a highly functional back office (HR, Administrative, Finance/Accounting, IT), and help them to see beyond today.



What You’ll Do

Reporting to our Accounting Manager, our Senior Bookkeeper will independently manage day-to-day accounting operations, take ownership of month-end close activities, and ensure accurate, review-ready financial reporting. Your days will be filled with:



Client and Team Support:

• Independently manage accounting deliverables and collaborate with the Accounting Manager to ensure accurate financial reporting and dependable service. 

• Maintain organized files, ensure deliverables are complete and on time, and support the Accounting Manager in executing key initiatives throughout the year. 

• Work alongside cross-functional partners and external vendors to ensure smooth payroll processing, accurate reporting, and successful year-end preparation. 

• Communicate confidently and professionally with U.S.-based clients, participating in calls, proactively following up on outstanding items, and resolving routine accounting questions. 



Financial Mastery:

• Manage day-to-day activity in QuickBooks Online including transaction coding, accounts payable and receivable workflows, and maintaining clean, organized ledgers. 

• Perform bank and credit card reconciliations, review activity for accuracy, and ensure accounts are supported and properly documented. Independently prepare and post adjusting journal entries such as accruals, prepaids, deferrals, and depreciation. 



Balance Sheet Ownership:

• Own the review and reconciliation of balance sheet accounts to ensure completeness and accuracy. Identify variances or unusual patterns, independently research and resolve discrepancies, and escalate complex issues to the Accounting Manager with proposed solutions. 

• Maintain schedules and take ownership of month-end close processes, ensuring financial statements are accurate, complete, and ready for Accounting Manager review. 



Process Enhancement:

• Identify opportunities to streamline existing workflows, improve documentation, and reduce manual steps.

• Bring forward ideas and participate in projects to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in the accounting function.



What will make you successful in this role (skills)

• Excellent English, written and verbal skills required.

• Accounting education preferred.

• Proven Expertise: With at least 5 years of full-cycle US bookkeeping experience, fully utilizing GAAP accounting, you have strong skills in financial reporting, accurate reconciliations, and independently reviewing and analyzing balance sheets and financial statements to identify and resolve discrepancies before final review. 

• Technical Proficiency: You are tech-savvy, with a minimum of 3 years of experience in QuickBooks Online and strong expertise in Excel. You skillfully navigate multiple internal systems to manage time efficiently and ensure seamless client communication, and deliverables.

• Experience with accounts payable platforms such as 
, Ramp, or Melio; experience with Xero is a plus.

• Success in leveraging task management systems to stay organized, manage deadlines, and maintain clear priorities.

• Extreme Attention to Detail: Attention to detail is so important in what we do every day. So much, that we want to make sure you read this posting in its entirety. When you submit your resume, there will be a question that says “Please include any additional information that you feel has not been previously covered”, please enter your favorite color here.

• Accounting Judgment: Strong understanding of how transactions impact the financial statements, with the ability to identify unusual balances, research discrepancies, and determine appropriate accounting treatment without step-by-step guidance. 

• Integrity and Confidentiality: Uphold the highest ethical standards, ensuring confidentiality of sensitive financial information.

• Communication Extraordinaire: Your clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal, set the stage for effective client interactions. You are confident in communicating directly with U.S.-based professionals, asking thoughtful questions, and clearly explaining accounting matters. 

• Multi-Tasking Maven: Thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple tasks and deadlines with finesse.

• Independent Initiative: Demonstrated ability to independently manage accounting responsibilities, proactively identify and resolve issues, meet deadlines without constant follow-up, and deliver accurate, complete work with minimal oversight. 

• Collaborative Champion: Your collaborative spirit and positive attitude make you an invaluable team player.

• Continuous Improvement Advocate: Embrace change and champion process enhancements, keeping up with evolving client and organizational needs.



Why Us?

Working at Atomus Partners means living our core values: Commit to Quality, Create Solutions, Collaborate as One, Cultivate Raving Fans, and Climb Higher. You will be challenged daily to develop solutions. Atomus Partners is not for those who just want to clock in, go through the motions, and clock out, as you’ll learn more and grow in 1 year than in 3-5 years at other companies. If you share our core values and liked what you read on this job posting, please apply.



What is in store for you:

Collaborative team culture in a dynamic working environment

Medical insurance reimbursement for the employee and one dependent

20 Leave credits consumed at your discretion

Talent engagement & development programs

WFH arrangement



How to Apply:

Please submit your application here with a direct link to your CV/Resume.

Important: To demonstrate your attention to detail, please include your favorite color in the subject line of your application message.



Note: Applications without a CV link and the correct subject line will not be considered.

title: Marketing Graphic Designer
description:

We blend private equity rigor with small business grit and help scaling companies make high-stakes leadership hires that actually stick.



Position Overview:

We are looking for a fast, precise Marketing Graphic Designer whose primary focus is pitch deck design. Our decks go out to candidates and clients on tight timelines, so the person in this seat owns a guaranteed 24–48 hour turnaround on deck requests during business hours.



Beyond decks, this role produces social graphics, flyers, and business development collateral that keep our brand consistent everywhere it appears. This is a high-volume, deadline-driven role suited to a designer who produces clean, modern work quickly and communicates clearly in a remote setting.



Primary Responsibilities - Pitch Deck Design:

-Design and build candidate-facing and client-facing pitch decks from written copy and varying levels of brand asset development 

-Deliver every deck request within a guaranteed 24–48 hour turnaround during business hours (Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm CST)

-Translate written content into clear, visually organized slides with strong hierarchy, data presentation, and narrative flow

-Build and maintain deck templates and reusable slide libraries so quality holds up at speed

-Turn revision rounds quickly and accurately, frequently within the same business day

-Hand off decks as editable, well-structured files the team can update without breaking the design



Additional Responsibilities:

-Create social media graphics across platforms, including static and animated content

-Design flyers, one-pagers, and print-ready collateral

-Produce business development deliverables such as proposals, leave-behinds, and event materials

-Support ongoing branding needs across digital collateral

-Maintain design systems and ensure visual consistency across every asset

-Execute against creative briefs and stakeholder direction with minimal back-and-forth



Qualifications:

-3 or more years of graphic design experience, ideally with marketing teams or agencies

-Portfolio that demonstrates presentation and pitch deck design 

-Track record of holding a 24–48 hour turnaround on design requests without quality slipping

-Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, especially Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop

-Strong Google Slides and Canva skills, including master slides and template construction

-Strong layout, typography, and visual storytelling skills

-Highly responsive, organized, and self-managing in a remote work environment

-Full availability during Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm CST



Nice-to-Haves:

-Motion graphics and video editing ability (After Effects, Premiere) for animated social content

-Background working with service-based brands or B2B clients

-Experience with collaborative design tools such as Figma or Google Workspace

-Familiarity with fast-paced agency or founder-led teams



What Success Looks Like:

-Deck requests consistently land inside the 24–48 hour window, with no chasing required

-Deck templates and a reusable slide library are in place and actively used by the team

-Social, flyer, and business development requests move through a predictable intake-to-delivery rhythm

-Stakeholders can send a brief and receive a near-final draft on the first pass

title: HIRING: Experienced Real Estate Broker price opinion Specialist – Pay Per Assignment
description:
We are hiring an experienced U.S. Real Estate Broker Price Opinion (BPO) Specialist for ongoing freelance, project-based work. This is a pay-per-assignment position, NOT hourly.



Candidates must have previous experience preparing U.S. residential, vacant land, and commercial BPO reports. Experience with Clear Capital or similar BPO platforms is strongly preferred.



Responsibilities:



* Research subject property information using county GIS, tax records, MLS data when authorized, and public real estate websites.

* Find three verified sold comparables and three active listings when required.

* Research property characteristics, market conditions, and neighborhood trends.

* Prepare complete BPO research packages, including comparable adjustments and market commentary.

* Assist with residential, vacant land, and commercial BPOs.

* Complete provided BPO templates accurately.

* Provide verifiable sources for all comparable properties.

* Submit organized, accurate work ready for final review.



Payment Per Completed Assignment:



* Residential BPO: $5–$8

* Vacant Land BPO: $7–$10

* Commercial BPO: $12–$20

* Complex commercial assignments: Negotiable



Performance Requirements:



* Residential turnaround: Within 24 hours.

* Vacant land turnaround: Within 24 hours.

* Commercial turnaround: Within 24–48 hours.

* Maintain at least a 95% first-review acceptance rate.

* Provide accurate, verifiable comparable sales and listings.
